papers.title: Auto-Research Arena: Benchmarking and Advancing Auto-Research in Language Modeling
papers.summary: As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress. We introduce Auto-Research Arena, a multi-target benchmark for evaluating autonomous research systems and discovering ideas in language modeling. Arena supports diverse research objectives within a shared experimental environment by separating admissibility from improvement: model quality and resource constraints determine whether a result qualifies, while the selected target measures progress among admissible results. We instantiate Arena in language model pretraining with nine targets spanning model, data, training, and inference efficiency, and evaluate seven research harnesses using two foundation models. Arena clearly differentiates existing harnesses across research objectives, with several sophisticated methods outperformed by our simple sequential search baseline, indicating substantial headroom in current auto-research systems. Beyond evaluation, Arena reveals a substantially broader frontier of model and system ideas aligned with active research directions. Reusing these discoveries in a new quality-driven search yields lower training loss under matched data and FLOPs and lower held-out BPB at the same model size. Together, Arena provides a common framework for benchmarking autonomous research and expanding its scope in language modeling. The code is available at https://github.com/Auto-Research-Arena/auto-research-arena

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且框架新颖，但实证严谨性仍待加强。
pros: 提出“可接受性/改进”解耦的多目标评测框架，贴合自动科研系统需求

papers.title_zh: 自动研究领域：语言建模领域的基准测试和推进自动研究
papers.summary_zh: 随着自主研究系统的能力变得越来越强大，基准必须评估其性能并支持有意义的研究进展。我们推出了 Auto-Research Arena，这是一个用于评估自主研究系统和发现语言建模思想的多目标基准。 Arena 通过将可接受性与改进分开来支持共享实验环境中的不同研究目标：模型质量和资源限制决定结果是否合格，而选定的目标则衡量可接受结果中的进展。我们在语言模型预训练中实例化了 Arena，具有涵盖模型、数据、训练和推理效率的九个目标，并使用两个基础模型评估了七个研究工具。 Arena 清楚地区分了跨研究目标的现有工具，其中几种复杂的方法优于我们简单的顺序搜索基线，这表明当前自动研究系统具有巨大的空间。除了评估之外，Arena 还揭示了与活跃研究方向相一致的更广泛的模型和系统思想前沿。在新的质量驱动搜索中重用这些发现可以降低匹配数据和 FLOP 下的训练损失，并在相同模型大小下降低保留的 BPB。 Arena 共同提供了一个通用框架，用于对自主研究进行基准测试并扩展其在语言建模方面的范围。代码可在 https://github.com/Auto-Research-Arena/auto-research-arena 获取

papers.title: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.summary: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且效果亮眼，但证据完整性待验证。
pros: 提出按tile误差分级的三档近似框架，较单一精度策略更细粒度

papers.title_zh: 分类：在视频扩散变压器中跳过、略读或细化注意力图块
papers.summary_zh: 对数以万计的视觉标记的关注主导了视频扩散变压器（DiT）的推理。现有方法通过稀疏性、低精度或两者兼而有之来降低此成本，但对所有保留的图块使用单一精度。我们观察到，近似引入的输出误差在各个图块之间变化很大。许多图块可以被跳过而几乎没有误差，其他图块必须进行计算，但除了低精度之外几乎没有什么增益，并且一些图块即使在低精度下仍保留很大的误差。我们提出了 Triage，一种免训练的注意力方法，为每个图块分配三个近似层之一：通过用其块均值替换它来跳过它，在 NVFP4 中略读它，或使用 NVFP4 残差校正对其进行细化。轻量级路由器根据块统计数据预测每个层下每个图块的错误，并仅当预测的误差减少证明额外计算合理时才将图块移动到更准确的层，并通过单一价格设置此权衡。融合内核在 RTX Blackwell GPU 的 FP4 张量核心上一次性执行所有三层。在 Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo 和 LTX-2.5 中，Triage 的端到端生成速度比密集 FlashAttention 提高了 2.32 倍，并且在五种设置中，它的运行速度比每个基线都快，同时 PSNR 比最高 PSNR 基线高 0.3-3.0 dB。

papers.title: InterQ-RL: Interaction-Aware Correction of Execution Mismatch in Quantized Agentic RL
papers.summary: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning (RL) relies on long closed-loop rollouts, making generation and KV-cache costs a major bottleneck. Quantized rollout reduces these costs, but its low-precision executor also serves as the behavior policy and can induce execution mismatch with the learner. Existing quantized-RL methods are designed primarily for single-turn generation. They align the learner forward with quantized rollout or correct the current-token rollout-learner ratio, without modeling the policy history that produces each agent state. Even after quantization alignment, residual rollout-learner mismatch accumulates along the state-reaching policy history, so a current action may look locally aligned despite a mismatched history. We introduce InterQ-RL (Interaction-aware Quantized Reinforcement Learning) to correct this post-alignment mismatch. It applies bounded execution-prefix correction over the state-reaching policy history, allocates correction strength across action segments by effective support under a fixed displacement budget, and requires no additional model forward pass. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones from 4B to 30B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with all quantized arms sharing the same rollout with 8-bit weights, activations, and KV cache (W8A8-KV8). Across four environment-backbone settings, InterQ-RL achieves the strongest quantized endpoint result, matching BF16 to within 0.7 points and exceeding it in two settings. It matches or exceeds the learning speed of alignment alone while avoiding its late performance regression.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法有新意但证据仍需加强。
pros: 聚焦量化执行与学习器失配这一长期被低估的多轮RL瓶颈，问题定义有价值。
提出基于状态到达历史的交互感知校正，并强调无需额外前向，兼顾效果与效率。
cons: 仅凭摘要看，理论保证、统计显著性与消融充分性仍不明确，跨任务泛化与稳定性证据可能不足。

papers.title_zh: InterQ-RL：量化代理强化学习中执行不匹配的交互感知修正
papers.summary_zh: 多轮代理强化学习 (RL) 依赖于长时间的闭环部署，使得生成和 KV 缓存成本成为主要瓶颈。量化推出降低了这些成本，但其低精度执行器也充当行为策略，并可能导致与学习器的执行不匹配。现有的量化强化学习方法主要是为单圈生成而设计的。它们使学习者与量化的推出保持一致，或者纠正当前代币推出与学习者的比率，而不对产生每个代理状态的策略历史进行建模。即使在量化对齐之后，剩余的推出-学习者不匹配也会沿着状态达到的策略历史累积，因此尽管历史不匹配，当前的操作可能看起来是局部对齐的。我们引入 InterQ-RL（交互感知量化强化学习）来纠正这种对齐后的不匹配。它在影响国家的政策历史上应用有界执行前缀校正，通过固定位移预算下的有效支持在行动部分之间分配校正强度，并且不需要额外的模型前向传递。我们在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上评估从 4B 到 30B 的密集和专家混合 (MoE) 主干，所有量化臂共享相同的 8 位权重、激活和 KV 缓存 (W8A8-KV8)。在四种环境主干设置中，InterQ-RL 实现了最强的量化端点结果，将 BF16 匹配到 0.7 点以内，并在两种设置中超过了它。它匹配或超过了单独对齐的学习速度，同时避免了其后期性能回归。

papers.title: Context Is Not Free: Carbon-Aware LLM Routing for Multi-Turn LLM Web Services across Geo-Distributed Data Centers
papers.summary: The sustainability of the Web has drawn growing attention, as large language model (LLM)-based web services leave a substantial carbon footprint. These services typically run in geo-distributed data centers whose grid carbon intensity varies across regions and over time, so routing each query to a cleaner region or a smaller model can reduce emissions. A conversation, however, is a stateful web session: each turn reuses the key--value (KV) cache of its history, which resides only where earlier turns were served. Serving a turn on another deployment requires recomputing this history, whose carbon cost grows with the conversation and can outweigh the saving of the move. Existing carbon-aware LLM routers treat a conversation's queries as independent and ignore this cost. We present CarbonRouter, an online framework that jointly selects the model, GPU type, and region for each query to minimize carbon emissions. CarbonRouter introduces a cache-aware carbon cost model, which charges history recomputation to every candidate deployment using cached-token counts from the serving backends, and uses a lightweight gate that keeps a session on its cached deployment when it would likely move back at the next turn and rebuild its history again. We evaluate CarbonRouter in trace-driven experiments on two real-world conversation datasets with five LLMs, three GPU types, and four regions, where it achieves the lowest carbon of all policies. CarbonRouter reduces CO$_2$ by 16.1\% on average relative to FairCarbon, a state-of-the-art carbon-aware router with the same action space, while also improving predicted answer quality and estimated latency. Moreover, the saving rises further to 23.1\% for sessions longer than 30 turns.

quality.verdict: 问题重要且方法实用，但实证说服力仍有限。
pros: 抓住多轮会话KV缓存迁移重算这一被忽视的关键碳成本

papers.title_zh: 上下文并非免费：跨地理分布式数据中心的多轮 LLM Web 服务的碳感知 LLM 路由
papers.summary_zh: 由于基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的网络服务会留下大量的碳足迹，因此网络的可持续性引起了越来越多的关注。这些服务通常在地理分布式数据中心中运行，其网格碳强度随地区和时间的推移而变化，因此将每个查询路由到更清洁的区域或更小的模型可以减少排放。然而，对话是有状态的 Web 会话：每个轮次都重用其历史记录的键值 (KV) 缓存，该缓存仅驻留在先前轮次服务的位置。为另一次部署提供服务需要重新计算这段历史，其碳成本随着对话的增加而增加，并且可能超过移动所节省的成本。现有的碳感知 LLM 路由器将对话的查询视为独立的，并忽略此成本。我们提出了 CarbonRouter，一个在线框架，它为每个查询联合选择模型、GPU 类型和区域，以最大限度地减少碳排放。 CarbonRouter 引入了缓存感知碳成本模型，该模型使用来自服务后端的缓存令牌计数对每个候选部署进行历史重新计算，并使用轻量级门在其缓存部署上保留会话（当它可能在下一回合返回并再次重建其历史记录时）。我们在两个真实对话数据集（具有五个法学硕士、三种 GPU 类型和四个区域）的跟踪驱动实验中评估了 CarbonRouter，它在所有策略中实现了最低的碳排放。相对于 FairCarbon（具有相同操作空间的最先进的碳感知路由器），CarbonRouter 平均减少了 16.1% 的 CO$_2$，同时还提高了预测答案质量和估计延迟。此外，对于超过 30 回合的会话，节省率进一步上升至 23.1%。

papers.title: BellowsKV: One Latent for Many Layers, Expanded on Demand
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) now serve as the backbone of agents that reason over many turns, call tools, and pursue long-horizon tasks. To avoid recomputation, a model stores the attention keys and values of all past tokens in a key-value (KV) cache. Each layer maintains its own cache, so KV-cache memory can become the main bottleneck for GPU serving. Most compression methods operate within a single layer, by quantizing the cache entries, reducing the channel dimension, or evicting less important tokens. All three lose substantial accuracy at high compression ratios. Cross-layer methods share one compressed cache across adjacent layers to go beyond this limit. However, these methods also degrade sharply at high compression ratios. We find that the KV-cache representations of adjacent layers are quite different, whereas the input hidden states of adjacent layers are highly similar. We also find that, under the same memory budget, reducing the dimension of this shared latent loses far more accuracy than quantizing it. Based on these findings, we propose BellowsKV, a training-free method that maps the hidden states of n adjacent layers to one shared latent per token. At inference time, each layer reads its own keys and values from this latent through a layer-specific projection. We keep the latent at full dimension and compress it in two other ways: BellowsKV-Quant stores the latent at low precision, which is nearly lossless because the latent has no dominant outlier channels; BellowsKV-Evict makes one shared eviction decision per block, because the layers rank token importance very similarly. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B and Qwen2.5-7B, BellowsKV-Quant retains about 99% of full-cache accuracy at 3.6x compression and 97-98% at 13-14x, where the strongest cross-layer method retains at most 84% at 16x. Code: https://github.com/MorrisZJ/BellowsKV

quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据仍需更全面
pros: 抓住跨层KV差异与隐藏态相似性的关键观察，方法设计有针对性

papers.title_zh: BellowsKV：一个潜在的多层，按需扩展
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 现在成为智能体的支柱，可以进行多次推理、调用工具并执行长期任务。为了避免重新计算，模型将所有过去标记的注意键和值存储在键值 (KV) 缓存中。每层都维护自己的缓存，因此 KV 缓存可能成为 GPU 服务的主要瓶颈。大多数压缩方法在单层内运行，通过量化缓存条目、减少通道维度或驱逐不太重要的令牌。在高压缩比下，这三种方法都会损失相当大的精度。跨层方法在相邻层之间共享一个压缩缓存以超越这一限制。然而，这些方法在高压缩比下也会急剧退化。我们发现相邻层的 KV 缓存表示有很大不同，而相邻层的输入隐藏状态非常相似。我们还发现，在相同的内存预算下，减少共享潜在变量的维度比量化它损失的准确性要高得多。基于这些发现，我们提出了 BellowsKV，一种无需训练的方法，它将 n 个相邻层的隐藏状态映射到每个标记的一个共享潜在变量。在推理时，每一层通过特定于层的投影从该潜在层中读取自己的键和值。我们将潜在变量保持在全维度，并以另外两种方式对其进行压缩：BellowsKV-Quant 以低精度存储潜在变量，这几乎是无损的，因为潜在变量没有占主导地位的异常值通道； BellowsKV-Evict 对每个块做出一个共享驱逐决策，因为各层对代币重要性的排名非常相似。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 中，BellowsKV-Quant 在 3.6 倍压缩时保留约 99% 的全缓存精度，在 13-14 倍压缩时保留 97-98%，其中最强的跨层方法在 16 倍压缩时最多保留 84%。代码：https://github.com/MorrisZJ/BellowsKV

papers.title: Attention under Bounded Key-Query Similarity: Space Complexity and Transformer Anisotropy
papers.summary: A growing body of work on KV-cache compression aims to reduce the memory requirements of autoregressive generation. These methods compress the stored context while approximately preserving attention computation, enabling generation with reduced memory consumption. Almost tight theoretical results on the worst case space complexity of attention have recently been obtained, but they are achieved by instances where queries can be perfectly aligned with keys. This directly contradicts the observed anisotropy of the key/query geometry in real transformers. In particular, it has been shown empirically that key/query cosine similarities are small even for most correlated pairs, i.e., near-perfect alignment of queries with keys does not happen in practice. In this paper, we study the space complexity of attention approximation under the assumption that key/query cosine similarities belong to a small interval around zero, i.e., a query cannot align too much with any key. We give a nearly space optimal algorithm and a corresponding space lower bound. Surprisingly, the distribution of key/query cosine similarities in our lower bound exhibits the anisotropy property empirically established and studied in the literature. Additionally, we show that the simple uniform sampling algorithm is nearly optimal for a typical range of parameters, supporting its surprising effectiveness on real datasets.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，理论贡献扎实且具现实关联。
pros: 将注意力空间下界建立在更贴近真实Transformer各向异性假设上，问题设定有新意
同时给出近最优算法与下界，并解释均匀采样在实践中有效，理论与经验联系紧密
cons: 摘要未体现充分实验验证与端到端系统收益，实际部署价值仍需更多证据

papers.title_zh: 有界键查询相似性下的注意力：空间复杂度和变压器各向异性
papers.summary_zh: 越来越多的 KV 缓存压缩工作旨在减少自回归生成的内存需求。这些方法压缩存储的上下文，同时近似保留注意力计算，从而能够减少内存消耗的生成。最近获得了关于注意力的最坏情况空间复杂度的几乎严格的理论结果，但它们是通过查询可以与键完美对齐的实例来实现的。这直接与实际 Transformer 中观察到的键/查询几何形状的各向异性相矛盾。特别是，经验表明，即使对于大多数相关对，键/查询余弦相似性也很小，即，查询与键的近乎完美的对齐在实践中不会发生。在本文中，我们在假设键/查询余弦相似度属于零附近的小区间（即查询不能与任何键对齐太多）的情况下研究注意力近似的空间复杂度。我们给出了近空间最优算法和相应的空间下界。令人惊讶的是，我们下界中的键/查询余弦相似度的分布表现出文献中根据经验建立和研究的各向异性特性。此外，我们还表明，简单的均匀采样算法对于典型的参数范围几乎是最佳的，这支持了其在真实数据集上令人惊讶的有效性。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Long-Session Degradation in Full-Duplex Speech Models
papers.summary: End-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue models enable natural, real-time spoken interactions with interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. Prior evaluations have assessed diverse interaction capabilities and identified some degradation patterns across conversational turns. However, how model behavior evolves over extended sessions remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we address this gap by systematically characterizing long-session degradation and developing efficient methods to mitigate it. We introduce a closed-loop evaluation framework for long-session stability and apply it to several publicly available full-duplex speech models, revealing degradation over time in responsiveness, spoken content quality, and voice consistency. To mitigate this degradation, we propose a self-distillation-based training framework for lightweight LoRA adaptation that improves long-session stability with a small amount of additional training. We further introduce a two-resolution context (TRC) architecture that preserves recent interactions in full detail while compressing older interaction history into key-value representations. We evaluate our methods on three models with distinct architectures, assessing long-session stability, information retention, and computational efficiency. Across all three models, we show that LoRA adaptation mitigates performance degradation over ten-minute sessions, while adding TRC extends these gains beyond the training session length and reduces KV-cache growth by more than 90%.
papers.comment: The project page is available at https://kimjunho333.github.io/dmlsd-fdsm/

cons: 摘要未充分说明统计显著性、失败案例与跨数据域泛化，严谨性与可复现性仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: 诊断和缓解全双工语音模型中的长会话退化
papers.summary_zh: 端到端全双工语音对话模型可实现自然、实时的语音交互，包括中断、反向通道和重叠语音。之前的评估已经评估了不同的交互能力，并确定了对话轮次中的一些退化模式。然而，模型行为如何在长时间的会话中演变仍然没有得到充分的了解。在这项工作中，我们通过系统地描述长期会话退化并开发有效的方法来缓解这一差距，从而解决了这一差距。我们引入了一个用于长时间会话稳定性的闭环评估框架，并将其应用于几个公开可用的全双工语音模型，揭示了响应能力、语音内容质量和语音一致性随时间的退化。为了减轻这种退化，我们提出了一种基于自蒸馏的轻量级 LoRA 适应训练框架，通过少量的额外训练提高了长会话稳定性。我们进一步引入了一种双分辨率上下文（TRC）架构，该架构可以完整保留最近的交互细节，同时将较旧的交互历史压缩为键值表示。我们在具有不同架构的三个模型上评估我们的方法，评估长会话稳定性、信息保留和计算效率。在所有三个模型中，我们表明 LoRA 适应可以减轻十分钟会话中的性能下降，而添加 TRC 将这些收益扩展到训练会话长度之外，并将 KV 缓存增长减少 90% 以上。

papers.title: End-to-End MXFP8 Reinforcement Learning on Blackwell: What Matching Buys, When It Pays Off, and How It Fails
papers.summary: Low-precision arithmetic can make reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models cheaper, but RL requires the sampler and the learner to agree. Several frameworks now run FP8 on both sides. We implement end-to-end MXFP8 RL in verl (Megatron/Transformer Engine training; vLLM and SGLang rollout; dense and MoE models) and measure on B200 GPUs, with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, what this design buys, when it is faster, and how it fails. (1) Matching. For an MXFP8 learner, a sampler on the learner's grid is more consistent than a higher-precision BF16 sampler: in one engine at fixed weights, train-rollout KL is 11% lower with half of the sampler's linear layers on the grid and 16% lower with all of them, and the synchronized weights we checked equal the learner's FP8 forward weights byte for byte. On the MoE model, an FP8 pipeline whose sampler uses another grid has twice the shared-grid pipeline's KL from the first step. Without a quantized KV cache, BF16 end to end remains 2.5-10x more consistent. (2) Speed. MXFP8 training adds a fixed cost per micro-batch and saves a per-token cost, so in our dense setting it pays off only above about 4.5k tokens per micro-batch; a micro-batch sweep on identical data confirms the per-micro-batch cost, and a trace shows the GPU waiting for the host for most of the added time. End to end, MXFP8 cuts MoE step time by 10.7% and generation time by 24%, and slows a short-sequence dense workload by 5%. (3) Correctness. We state seven conditions every weight synchronization must preserve and checks that test them against the live engine. Each of the seven failures we met on hardware broke one condition, five silently; the checks caught two at their first opportunity, each missed by the other checks, and CPU fault-injection tests reproduce five. All runs are single-seed and at most 60 steps long; we make no claim about final model quality.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但证据深度不足支撑强结论
pros: 聚焦端到端MXFP8在RL中“匹配性”问题，问题定义清晰且实用
给出速度收益阈值与故障条件检查框架，对工业落地有直接参考价值
cons: 实验仅单种子且最长60步，缺少统计稳健性与最终质量验证，外推性有限
主要在有限模型与硬件组合上验证，跨框架/任务泛化证据不足

papers.title_zh: Blackwell 上的端到端 MXFP8 强化学习：匹配能带来什么、何时获得回报以及它如何失败
papers.summary_zh: 低精度算术可以使大型语言模型的强化学习（RL）更便宜，但 RL 需要采样器和学习器达成一致。现在有几个框架在两侧都运行 FP8。我们在 verl 中实现了端到端 MXFP8 RL（Megatron/Transformer 引擎训练；vLLM 和 SGLang 推出；密集和 MoE 模型），并使用 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 B200 GPU 上进行测量，了解该设计购买了什么、何时更快以及如何失败。 (1)匹配。对于 MXFP8 学习器，学习器网格上的采样器比更高精度的 BF16 采样器更加一致：在固定权重的一个引擎中，网格上一半采样器线性层的训练滚动 KL 降低了 11%，所有采样器的线性层降低了 16%，并且我们检查的同步权重等于学习器逐字节的 FP8 前向权重。在 MoE 模型上，采样器使用另一个网格的 FP8 管道的 KL 是第一步的共享网格管道的 KL 的两倍。如果没有量化的 KV 缓存，BF16 端到端的一致性可提高 2.5-10 倍。 (2)速度。 MXFP8 训练增加了每个微批次的固定成本，并节省了每个令牌的成本，因此在我们的密集设置中，每个微批次只能获得约 4.5k 个令牌以上的回报；对相同数据的微批次扫描确认了每微批次的成本，并且跟踪显示 GPU 在大部分添加时间中等待主机。端到端，MXFP8 将 MoE 步骤时间缩短了 10.7%，生成时间缩短了 24%，并将短序列密集工作负载减慢了 5%。 (3)正确性。我们规定了每个权重同步必须保留的七个条件，并检查以针对实时引擎对其进行测试。我们在硬件上遇到的七个故障中，每一个都破坏了一个条件，其中五个是默默的；检查一有机会就发现了两个，但其他检查却错过了每个，而 CPU 故障注入测试则重现了五个。所有运行都是单种子运行，最多 60 步长；我们对最终模型的质量不做任何声明。

papers.title: FrontGI: Architecture-Aware Parallel GNN Inference on Chiplet-Based Multicore Systems
papers.summary: The realm of high-performance computing has expanded to include machine learning tasks of many forms. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are becoming increasingly popular, with their applications expanding across diverse domains. As the scale of graph data continues to grow, including larger numbers of nodes, edges, and higher embedding dimensions, standardized libraries such as DGL and PyG have been developed to facilitate GNN computation. These libraries allow the computation to be described a a high level of abstraction, providing high productivity on the part of the developer. However, with the rapid increase in the number of processor cores and the evolution of multicore architectures, these libraries often show poor scalability and fail to execute GNN inference efficiently on the latest multicore systems, particularly those with upwards of a hundred cores. To address this limitation, we introduce FrontGI, a fast and scalable set of techniques that advances the frontier of GNN inference on large-scale graphs (over 100,000 vertices) by leveraging graph-property- and architecture-aware design. FrontGI employs different parallelization strategies optimized for diverse graph structures, maximizing the utilization of multi-level cache hierarchies in multicore systems. We evaluate a number of GNN models with FrontGI on a 128-core AMD EPYC system. Compared to state-of-the-art libraries, FrontGI achieves up to 3.35$\times$, 3.20$\times$, 2.89$\times$ and 3.10$\times$ speedups over DGL for GCN, GraphSAGE, GIN, and SGC models, respectively, and even greater improvements over PyG, across a range of large-scale, high-dimensional graph datasets with diverse structural properties.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 工程价值较强，但学术说服力仍偏弱。
pros: 聚焦百核Chiplet多核下GNN推理扩展性，问题具现实意义
在多模型多数据集上报告约3倍加速，潜在系统优化收益明显
cons: 方法创新点主要像并行与缓存优化组合，算法/系统新颖性有限
摘要缺少消融、开销分解与统计稳健性信息，严谨性难判断

papers.title_zh: FrontGI：基于 Chiplet 的多核系统上的架构感知并行 GNN 推理
papers.summary_zh: 高性能计算领域已经扩展到包括多种形式的机器学习任务。图神经网络（GNN）正变得越来越流行，其应用扩展到不同的领域。随着图数据规模的不断增长，包括更多的节点、边和更高的嵌入维度，已经开发了 DGL 和 PyG 等标准化库来促进 GNN 计算。这些库允许以高抽象级别描述计算，从而为开发人员提供高生产力。然而，随着处理器核心数量的快速增加和多核架构的演进，这些库往往表现出较差的可扩展性，并且无法在最新的多核系统上高效地执行 GNN 推理，特别是那些具有一百个以上核心的系统。为了解决这一限制，我们引入了 FrontGI，这是一组快速且可扩展的技术，它通过利用图属性和架构感知设计，推进了大规模图（超过 100,000 个顶点）上的 GNN 推理的前沿。 FrontGI采用针对不同图结构优化的不同并行化策略，最大限度地利用多核系统中的多级缓存层次结构。我们在 128 核 AMD EPYC 系统上使用 FrontGI 评估了多个 GNN 模型。与最先进的库相比，FrontGI 在 GCN、GraphSAGE、GIN 和 SGC 模型的 DGL 上分别实现了高达 3.35$\times$、3.20$\times$、2.89$\times$ 和 3.10$\times$ 的加速，甚至在一系列具有不同结构属性的大规模、高维图形数据集上比 PyG 有了更大的改进。

papers.title: When and Why to Use TMA: A Workload-Grounded Characterization of Tensor Memory Acceleration on NVIDIA Hopper GPUs
papers.summary: The Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), introduced on NVIDIA Hopper, is used pervasively in production GPU kernels yet its usage is conspicuously selective: expert kernel developers in CUTLASS, FlashAttention-3, and FlashInfer apply TMA to some tensor operands within a kernel but fall back to cp.async, direct global loads, or distributed shared memory (DSM) for others. Vendor documentation describes the API, and recent microbenchmarking work characterizes TMA throughput in isolation, but neither answers the question practitioners actually face: given a memory operand in a kernel, should it use TMA, and if so, with or without cluster multicast? We address this gap with a workload-grounded characterization study on H100. We catalog the TMA, multicast, DSM, and cp.async choices made inside FlashAttention-3 forward, isolate the discriminating features through targeted microbenchmarks (transfer-size crossover, multicast scaling), and produce rules of thumb for the load-mechanism choice on Hopper. We further compare TMA multicast against DSM as competing cluster-broadcast primitives, and isolate the FlashAttention-3 paged-key-value (KV) TMA-vs-cp.async dispatch on H100 across page size, datatype, model shape, and execution phase. Our results yield concrete, predictive guidance on when TMA pays off and when multicast helps or hurts on Hopper, and we extend the analysis to server Blackwell (SM100) via a CUTLASS GEMM study on B200 that shows the qualitative dispatch rules carry across generations while absolute crossovers shift with tensor-core and bandwidth scaling.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中实践痛点，结论有用但创新偏经验性
pros: 聚焦TMA选择这一真实工程决策空白，研究问题明确且实用价值高
方法上结合真实工作负载与定向微基准，并跨H100到B200验证规则迁移性
cons: 核心贡献以经验规则归纳为主，理论新颖性与可证性有限，外部工作负载泛化仍有风险

papers.title_zh: 何时以及为何使用 TMA：NVIDIA Hopper GPU 上基于工作负载的张量内存加速特性
papers.summary_zh: NVIDIA Hopper 上引入的张量内存加速器 (TMA) 广泛用于生产 GPU 内核，但其使用具有明显的选择性：CUTLASS、FlashAttention-3 和 FlashInfer 中的专家内核开发人员将 TMA 应用于内核中的某些张量操作数，但对于其他操作数则回退到 cp.async、直接全局加载或分布式共享内存 (DSM)。供应商文档描述了 API，最近的微基准测试工作单独描述了 TMA 吞吐量，但都没有回答从业者实际面临的问题：给定内核中的内存操作数，它是否应该使用 TMA，如果是，使用或不使用集群多播？我们通过对 H100 进行基于工作负载的特征研究来解决这一差距。我们对 FlashAttention-3 中的 TMA、多播、DSM 和 cp.async 选择进行分类，通过目标微基准（传输大小交叉、多播扩展）隔离区分特征，并为 Hopper 上的负载机制选择生成经验规则。我们进一步将 TMA 多播与 DSM 作为竞争集群广播原语进行比较，并在 H100 上跨页面大小、数据类型、模型形状和执行阶段隔离 FlashAttention-3 分页键值 (KV) TMA-vs-cp.async 调度。我们的结果对 TMA 何时获得回报以及多播何时对 Hopper 有利或有害产生了具体的预测性指导，并且我们通过 B200 上的 CUTLASS GEMM 研究将分析扩展到服务器 Blackwell (SM100)，该研究显示了跨代的定性调度规则，而绝对交叉随着张量核心和带宽缩放而变化。

papers.title: SPARTA: A Sparse Ternary LLM Accelerator with Adaptive Attention and Unified Datapath for Long-Context Edge Inference
papers.summary: LLMs on edge devices are constrained by limited memory and bandwidth. Although 1.58-bit ternary weights greatly reduce model storage, long-context inference is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache traffic and attention. Existing accelerators also use separate datapaths for ternary linear layers and attention, incurring hardware and execution overhead. We present SPARTA, a sparse ternary LLM accelerator for efficient long-context edge inference. SPARTA integrates: (1) a phase-aware sparse dataflow exploiting heterogeneous sparsity across compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode; (2) a unified compute fabric mapping ternary SpMM/SpMV and bit-serial attention onto shared processing elements to exploit zero-weight and zero-bit sparsity; and (3) an adaptive two-stage attention engine combining page-level Top-k selection to reduce K-cache accesses with token-level Top-p pruning to reduce V-cache traffic. SPARTA reduces KV traffic by 4.1-4.8x over full attention and 1.3-1.5x over a state-of-the-art sparse-attention scheme, with task-dependent quality loss. Compared with NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, SPARTA achieves 3.9x higher generation throughput and 8.3x higher end-to-end energy efficiency on average; versus AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, the gains are 5.0x and 81.7x. It also delivers 1.6-12.0x higher throughput, 2.0-4.2x higher energy efficiency, and 1.3-51.4x higher area efficiency than FIGLUT, TeLLMe, and MCBP.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 方向重要且方案完整，但证据仍需更扎实。
pros: 面向长上下文边缘推理，联合优化三值稀疏计算与KV缓存瓶颈，问题定位准确
统一数据通路与两级自适应注意力设计有一定新意，且给出多基线下吞吐/能效提升
cons: 摘要仅称存在任务相关精度损失，缺少对质量退化边界与可接受性的系统量化

papers.title_zh: SPARTA：具有自适应注意力和统一数据路径的稀疏三元 LLM 加速器，用于长上下文边缘推理
papers.summary_zh: 边缘设备上的法学硕士受到有限内存和带宽的限制。尽管 1.58 位三元权重大大减少了模型存储，但长上下文推理越来越受到 KV 缓存流量和注意力的瓶颈。现有的加速器还使用单独的数据路径来实现三元线性层和注意力，从而产生硬件和执行开销。我们提出了 SPARTA，一种稀疏三元 LLM 加速器，用于高效的长上下文边缘推理。 SPARTA 集成了：(1) 相位感知稀疏数据流，利用跨计算限制预填充和内存限制解码的异构稀疏性； (2) 将三元 SpMM/SpMV 和位串行注意力映射到共享处理元素上的统一计算结构，以利用零权重和零位稀疏性； (3) 自适应两阶段注意力引擎，将页面级 Top-k 选择与令牌级 Top-p 修剪相结合以减少 K-cache 访问，以减少 V-cache 流量。 SPARTA 与完全注意力机制相比，KV 流量减少了 4.1-4.8 倍，与最先进的稀疏注意力方案相比，减少了 1.3-1.5 倍，并且存在任务相关的质量损失。与 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 相比，SPARTA 的平均生成吞吐量提高了 3.9 倍，端到端能效提高了 8.3 倍；与 AMD Ryzen 7 9700X 相比，增益分别为 5.0 倍和 81.7 倍。与FIGLUT、TeLLMe 和 MCBP 相比，它的吞吐量提高了 1.6-12.0 倍，能效提高了 2.0-4.2 倍，面积效率提高了 1.3-51.4 倍。

papers.title: MCF: A Memory- and Communication-Aware Co-Designed Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.summary: This paper presents Memory- and Communication-Aware Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference (MCF) that optimizes long-context inference through communication-aware and stage-adaptive KV-cache layout transitions. At the core of MCF is {Memory-Aware Replication and Scheduling} (MARS), a dynamic orchestration mechanism for chunked prefill. MARS exploits early-stage memory headroom by selectively replicating highly reused KV blocks, improving locality and hiding KV propagation latency behind attention computation. As prefill progresses and memory pressure increases, MARS progressively drains redundant replicas and converges the KV cache into a sharded decode-ready layout, avoiding expensive layout conversion at the prefill--decode boundary. For decoding, MCF adopts a query-centric execution model in which KV shards remain stationary while lightweight query tensors are routed across workers. This changes communication from KV-cache-dependent transfer to query-dependent transfer, reducing communication growth with context length. MCF further integrates a hardware-software co-designed execution layer based on an FPGA compute-NIC datapath, enabling metadata-driven KV routing and collective operations directly in the network path. Experiments show that MCF improves TTFT, throughput, and scalability over state-of-the-art distributed inference systems, with larger benefits as context length and cluster size increase.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、方案新颖，但证据完整性仍待验证。
pros: 联合优化内存布局与通信路径，系统级设计完整且契合长上下文瓶颈
从预填充到解码的阶段自适应KV策略思路清晰，具备可扩展性潜力

papers.title_zh: MCF：用于长上下文 LLM 推理的内存和通信感知协同设计框架
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出了长上下文 LLM 推理 (MCF) 的内存和通信感知框架，该框架通过通信感知和阶段自适应 KV 缓存布局转换来优化长上下文推理。 MCF 的核心是内存感知复制和调度 (MARS)，这是一种用于分块预填充的动态编排机制。 MARS 通过有选择地复制高度重用的 KV 块、改进局部性并将 KV 传播延迟隐藏在注意力计算后面，来利用早期内存空间。随着预填充的进行和内存压力的增加，MARS 逐渐耗尽冗余副本，并将 KV 缓存汇聚到分片的解码就绪布局中，从而避免在预填充-解码边界处进行昂贵的布局转换。对于解码，MCF 采用以查询为中心的执行模型，其中 KV 分片保持静止，而轻量级查询张量在工作线程之间路由。这将通信从依赖于 KV 缓存的传输更改为依赖于查询的传输，从而减少了上下文长度带来的通信增长。 MCF 进一步集成了基于 FPGA 计算 NIC 数据路径的硬件-软件共同设计的执行层，从而直接在网络路径中实现元数据驱动的 KV 路由和集体操作。实验表明，与最先进的分布式推理系统相比，MCF 提高了 TTFT、吞吐量和可扩展性，并且随着上下文长度和集群大小的增加，优势更大。

papers.title: Prefetch-Steered Routing: Deterministic Cache-Aware Expert Selection for Offloaded Mixture-of-Experts Decoding
papers.summary: When a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model does not fit in GPU memory, batch-1 decoding is dominated by copying expert weights from host memory. Cache-aware routing reduces these copies by biasing the router toward resident experts, but combined with asynchronous prefetching it makes the model's outputs depend on transfer timing, so a harness that does not simulate that timing no longer evaluates the deployed model. We propose prefetch-steered routing (PSR): routing conditions on a deterministic logical cache, into which at most n experts predicted by the next layer's router are inserted per layer and token; physical copies affect only latency. On OLMoE-1B-7B with 50% and 25% of experts resident on an RTX 4090, PSR decodes 2.2-2.3x faster than exact routing with LRU and 25-30% faster than the Cache-Prior operating point, with mean benchmark differences of +0.1 and +0.5 points (95% lower bounds -0.8 and -0.3). In greedy generation its lead over Cache-Prior depends on the workload and reverses on HumanEval at 50% residency. On Moonlight-16B-A3B, PSR is 1.9x faster than exact routing with LRU at 37.5% residency and, at the latency of Cache-Prior, significantly better on three of eight benchmarks. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, where copies are cheap relative to computation, PSR keeps its advantage over Cache-Prior on the likelihood benchmarks but not its speed. Distillation-trained gates did not help. Speculative decoding with block-level expert selection was slower than PSR with a 1B autoregressive drafter on OLMoE, but with a block drafter on Qwen3.6 it was 2.1-2.9x faster than any autoregressive configuration with at most its GPU memory on the 64 prompts we timed.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法实用，但泛化边界仍需加强
pros: 直击离线MoE解码中“缓存感知路由+异步预取”导致评测失真的关键痛点
提出确定性逻辑缓存的PSR并在多模型多驻留率下给出较系统的速度与质量对比
cons: 收益对模型与工作负载敏感，部分场景速度或任务指标反转，通用性与稳定优势尚未充分证明

papers.title_zh: 预取引导路由：用于卸载专家混合解码的确定性缓存感知专家选择
papers.summary_zh: 当专家混合 (MoE) 模型不适合 GPU 内存时，batch-1 解码主要通过从主机内存复制专家权重来控制。缓存感知路由通过将路由器偏向常驻专家来减少这些副本，但与异步预取相结合，它使模型的输出依赖于传输时序，因此不模拟该时序的工具不再评估已部署的模型。我们提出预取引导路由（PSR）：确定性逻辑缓存上的路由条件，每层和令牌最多插入下一层路由器预测的n个专家；物理副本仅影响延迟。在 OLMoE-1B-7B 上，50% 和 25% 的专家驻留在 RTX 4090 上，PSR 解码速度比使用 LRU 的精确路由快 2.2-2.3 倍，比 Cache-Prior 操作点快 25-30%，平均基准差异为 +0.1 和 +0.5 点（95% 下限 -0.8 和 -0.3）。在贪婪生成中，它相对于 Cache-Prior 的领先优势取决于工作负载，而在 50% 驻留率时则与 HumanEval 相反。在 Moonlight-16B-A3B 上，PSR 比使用 LRU 的精确路由快 1.9 倍，驻留率为 37.5%，并且在 Cache-Prior 的延迟下，在八个基准测试中的三个上明显更好。在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，副本相对于计算来说很便宜，PSR 在似然基准上保持了相对于 Cache-Prior 的优势，但在速度上却没有。经过蒸馏训练的门没有帮助。使用块级专家选择的推测解码比在 OLMoE 上使用 1B 自回归绘图器的 PSR 慢，但在 Qwen3.6 上使用块绘图器时，它比我们计时的 64 个提示上最多其 GPU 内存的任何自回归配置快 2.1-2.9 倍。

papers.title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, 16 references. Author's preprint; to be submitted to a peer-reviewed journal

quality.label: 一般
quality.verdict: 科普性尚可，但学术创新与实证明显不足。
pros: 覆盖训练、微调、RAG、工具使用等关键概念，面向工程读者友好
提醒数据污染与LLM评测偏差等常见陷阱，具一定实践价值
cons: 更像综述/教程而非研究论文，缺乏方法创新与可验证实验
技术点罗列较浅，缺少定量比较、边界条件与失败案例分析

papers.title_zh: 大型语言模型：为工程师提供的简单语言概述
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 是在大量文本集合上进行训练的神经网络，通过预测接下来会发生什么来生成文本。使用 ChatGPT 和其他生成人工智能 (AI) 工具的工程师需要清楚地了解培训变化和提示添加了哪些内容。本文从 Transformer 开始，它连接上下文中的单词，然后进行预训练，模型学习预测文本。然后，它解释了如何微调模型以适应请求，并使用人类答案排名从人类反馈中进行强化学习。接下来，检索增强生成（RAG）提供文档，而思维链提示则鼓励中间步骤和代理使用工具。 FlashAttention 通过减少注意力过程中的数据移动来降低训练和运行成本；量化低秩自适应（QLoRA）可以节省微调内存。读者可以获得生命周期图和比较方法及其局限性的表格。用于判断法学硕士评估声明的简短清单标记了培训中的测试材料（数据污染）和基于模型的评分（法学硕士作为法官）。它还涵盖了非常长的输入（长上下文）和幻觉，即错误或不受支持的主张。分别检查事实的准确性和答案是否听起来有帮助。

papers.title: Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts Models: Expert Bytes, Kernel Bandwidth and the Best Draft Length
papers.summary: Speculative decoding checks several drafted tokens in one verification pass. On a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, consecutive tokens often select the same experts. A deduplicating engine reads each selected expert once per pass, so it requests fewer bytes than a per-slot engine, which reads it once per token. We write a step's time as the bytes each kernel requests over its effective bandwidth, plus fixed time. Under geometric acceptance, we derive from this step time when speculation is faster than plain decoding. The best draft length is a monotone staircase in the acceptance rate. We bound how a bandwidth error moves each result, and we check the main steps in Lean. Deduplication is faster exactly where its share $\bar u(n)$ of the per-slot bytes is below its ratio $r(n)$ of the per-slot bandwidth. On llama.cpp Metal, MLX-LM and llama.cpp CUDA, which we modified to deduplicate, the per-slot kernel has the higher effective bandwidth (r = 0.32 to 0.75). Thus deduplication is faster only from 5 to 8 tokens per pass, or never. We fit the bandwidths on one layer's expert operation, run alone, in under an hour per model. Bytes from routing traces over these bandwidths predict the time that deduplication saves. The measured saving lies inside its error bound at every point on CUDA and MLX-LM and at 36 of 48 points on Metal. The crossover is the first pass size at which deduplication is faster. The prediction places it within one pass size in 10 of 12 configurations of engine, model and depth. We computed these predictions after the measurements. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite, operation times measured before its speculative runs give the best draft length on CUDA within one at all 22 acceptance values.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，方法扎实但外推性仍有限。
pros: 提出以字节-带宽分解刻画MoE投机解码收益，判据清晰可操作
理论、误差界、Lean形式化与多后端实测相互印证，工程指导价值高
cons: 核心结论依赖几何接受率与单算子带宽拟合，跨模型与动态负载下稳健性仍待加强
实验主要围绕特定引擎改造与少量模型，通用性与长期维护成本评估不足

papers.title_zh: 混合专家模型的推测解码：专家字节、内核带宽和最佳草稿长度
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码会在一次验证过程中检查多个起草的令牌。在专家混合 (MoE) 模型中，连续的令牌通常会选择相同的专家。重复数据删除引擎每次都会读取每个选定的专家一次，因此它比每槽引擎（每个令牌读取一次）需要更少的字节。我们将步骤的时间写为每个内核在其有效带宽上请求的字节数加上固定时间。在几何接受下，我们从这一步时间推导出推测比普通解码更快的时间。最佳草稿长度是接受率的单调阶梯。我们限制了带宽误差如何移动每个结果，并检查精益中的主要步骤。当每时隙字节的份额 $\bar u(n)$ 低于每时隙带宽的比率 $r(n)$ 时，重复数据删除速度更快。在我们修改为重复数据删除的 llama.cpp Metal、MLX-LM 和 llama.cpp CUDA 上，每插槽内核具有更高的有效带宽（r = 0.32 至 0.75）。因此，重复数据删除的速度每次只需 5 到 8 个令牌，或者永远不会。我们将带宽安装在一层专家操作上，单独运行，每个模型不到一小时。这些带宽上的路由跟踪字节数可以预测重复数据删除节省的时间。在 CUDA 和 MLX-LM 上的每个点以及 Metal 上的 48 个点中的 36 个点上，测得的节省量均位于其误差范围内。交叉是重复数据删除速度更快的第一遍大小。预测将其置于 12 种引擎、模型和深度配置中的 10 种的一次传递大小之内。我们在测量后计算了这些预测。在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上，在其推测运行之前测量的操作时间给出了 CUDA 上的最佳草稿长度，在所有 22 个接受值的 1 内。

papers.title: Prefix Keys and Values Matter Late: RIPE Caching for Self-Speculative Decoding in Looped Language Models
papers.summary: A looped language model runs one block of layers $R$ times per token, so its key-value (KV) cache holds $R$ planes per recurrent layer, and self-speculative decoding (draft with a few loops, verify with all $R$) reads them all. We find that prefix keys and values matter late: at equal perturbation size, loops 25-32 are $e^{15.0}$ (Huginn-0125) and $e^{12.8}$ (Raven-Llama) times more sensitive than loops 2-9, and the planes approach the last one geometrically, at 0.88 and 0.81 per loop. Whether the deepest plane alone suffices then depends on how ripe the late planes are: on Raven, storing only it is indistinguishable from a bf16-to-fp32 change; on Huginn, 1% of positions carry 74% of its error. We turn this into RIPE, which stores the deepest plane everywhere except a window of recent positions kept at full depth. On Huginn, a 64-position window removes 89% of the tail positions at 11.9% of the full cache's memory (1024-token context), and any window at least as long as the draft block makes batched verification block-independent by construction. Nine pre-registered GPU batches back these results. Simple models of acceptance, decoding cost and memory, two of them checked on held-out measurements, account for the measured self-speculative speed-ups ($2.09\times$ with the full cache, $2.58\times$ with the deepest plane) and decompose the $2.24\times$ fixed-memory throughput gain of one shared plane.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法简洁有效且具实用价值。
pros: 抓住循环模型KV缓存“后期更关键”的结构性现象，并给出量化证据
RIPE设计简单可部署，兼顾显存占用、验证并行性与吞吐收益
cons: 结果主要基于两类模型与特定批设置，跨架构泛化与长上下文稳定性仍需更强外部验证
理论模型虽能解释观测，但对分布漂移和极端提示场景的鲁棒性论证仍偏有限

papers.title_zh: 前缀键和值很重要：循环语言模型中自推测解码的 RIPE 缓存
papers.summary_zh: 循环语言模型每个令牌运行一个层块 $R$ 次，因此它的键值 (KV) 缓存在每个循环层中保存 $R$ 平面，并且自推测解码（带有几个循环的草稿，使用所有 $R$ 进行验证）会读取所有这些平面。我们发现前缀键和值很重要：在相同的扰动大小下，循环 25-32 比循环 2-9 敏感 $e^{15.0}$ (Huginn-0125) 和 $e^{12.8}$ (Raven-Llama) 倍，并且平面在几何上接近最后一个，每个循环为 0.88 和 0.81。仅最深的平面是否足够取决于后期平面的成熟程度：在 Raven 上，仅存储它与 bf16 到 fp32 的更改没有区别；在 Huginn 上，1% 的仓位带来 74% 的误差。我们将其转化为 RIPE，它存储除了保持全深度的最近位置窗口之外的所有位置的最深平面。在 Huginn 上，64 位置窗口会删除 11.9% 的完整缓存内存（1024 个令牌上下文）中的 89% 的尾部位置，以及至少只要草稿块通过构造使批量验证块独立的任何窗口。九个预先注册的 GPU 批次返回这些结果。接受、解码成本和内存的简单模型（其中两个对保留的测量进行检查）解释了测量的自推测加速（完整缓存为 2.09 美元，最深平面为 2.58 美元），并分解了一个共享平面的 2.24 美元固定内存吞吐量增益。

papers.title: T2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning & Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题定义到位，实用潜力高，但证据仍待更严谨验证。
pros: 将草稿模型设计显式建模为“延迟-对齐”联合优化，问题设定有方法论价值
从目标模型出发做结构化剪枝并蒸馏，兼顾部署效率与兼容性，工程落地潜力强
cons: 摘要对优化细节与实验公平性披露不足，缺少训练/搜索开销与泛化边界，严谨性风险仍在

papers.title_zh: T2D：目标到草稿模型修剪和适应以实现高效推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码显着加速了大型语言模型 (LLM) 中的自回归文本生成，但其功效很大程度上取决于两个关键因素：草稿和目标模型之间的分布对齐，以及草稿模型在推理过程中的延迟。然而，现有方法通常利用独立预训练的小型草案模型或寻求将目标模型修剪为手动选择的架构，从而无法明确平衡草案模型对齐和令牌生成效率之间的权衡。为了解决这一差距，我们将草稿模型设计制定为优化问题，并提出了 T2D，这是一种使用延迟感知结构化修剪和知识蒸馏直接从目标模型构建草稿模型的框架。通过这种方式，T2D 获得了针对测量的推理延迟和目标模型响应的交叉熵损失联合优化的草稿模型，从而实现了最佳的推测解码性能。通过对多域推测解码基准和不同规模的多个目标模型系列进行广泛的实验，我们演示了 T2D 如何修剪高达 92% 的目标模型，以获得与竞争基线相比高性能的草稿模型。此外，通过 T2D 获得的草稿模型还可以以即插即用的方式被其他推测性解码令牌对齐和知识蒸馏方法利用，从而获得进一步的收益。我们的研究结果强调了共同探索模型架构调整前沿草案的重要性，以释放法学硕士推测解码的全部潜力。

papers.title: INTRA: Interleaved Non-contiguous Token spaRse Attention
papers.summary: Transformers achieve strong performance across modalities but are bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of attention. Sparse attention can reduce this cost, but effective sparsity must preserve useful long-range communication and map well to GPU hardware. We introduce INTRA--Interleaved Non-contiguous Token spaRse Attention--a hardware-aware static sparse attention design based on a relay-communication view under Computational Query Set (CQS) constraints. Rather than directly covering all token-to-token interactions within each sparse layer, INTRA uses complementary sparse groups to provide short mediated communication paths across layers. Scatter forms relay groups that sample broadly across local neighborhoods, while Gather reconnects these groups in subsequent layers. Under a partition model, this structure guides CQS-compatible sparse patterns with global reachability. Our CQS-aware FlashAttention-style kernel computes structured indices at runtime, loads selected non-contiguous tokens, and packs them densely for computation. On an A100, INTRA achieves a $1.53\times$ speedup in $2K$ FLUX.1-dev generation, with better measured image quality than evaluated CLEAR configurations after LoRA self-distillation. On LLaMA-3.1-8B, it improves long-context prefill efficiency with strong teacher-forced retrieval performance under matched LoRA adaptation. Attention-only benchmarks further show up to $8.4\times$ and $10.4\times$ speedups over MoBA and density-constrained NSA, respectively.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/NovTi/INTRA

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且工程价值高，但证据仍需更扎实。
pros: 将跨层中继通信与静态稀疏模式结合，设计动机清晰且有新意

papers.title_zh: INTRA：交错的非连续令牌稀疏注意力
papers.summary_zh: Transformers achieve strong performance across modalities but are bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of attention. Sparse attention can reduce this cost, but effective sparsity must preserve useful long-range communication and map well to GPU hardware.我们介绍 INTRA——Interleaved Non-contigious Token spaRse Attention——一种硬件感知的静态稀疏注意力设计，基于计算查询集（CQS）约束下的中继通信视图。 INTRA 不是直接覆盖每个稀疏层内的所有令牌到令牌交互，而是使用互补的稀疏组来提供跨层的短中介通信路径。 Scatter forms relay groups that sample broadly across local neighborhoods, while Gather reconnects these groups in subsequent layers.在分区模型下，该结构引导具有全局可达性的与 CQS 兼容的稀疏模式。我们的 CQS 感知 FlashAttention 风格的内核在运行时计算结构化索引，加载选定的非连续标记，并将它们密集打包以进行计算。在 A100 上，INTRA 在 2K$ FLUX.1-dev 一代中实现了 $1.53\times$ 加速，测量的图像质量比 LoRA 自蒸馏后评估的 CLEAR 配置更好。 On LLaMA-3.1-8B, it improves long-context prefill efficiency with strong teacher-forced retrieval performance under matched LoRA adaptation. Attention-only benchmarks further show up to $8.4\times$ and $10.4\times$ speedups over MoBA and density-constrained NSA, respectively.

papers.title: Software Engineering LLMs: Why We Need Them and How Software Engineering Helps Build Them
papers.summary: Software engineering (SE) expertise can shape how coding large language models (LLMs) are trained and which engineering capabilities they acquire. We examine this role through an industrial case study of capability-focused training for a 92B-parameter coding LLM serving more than 100,000 developers. We demonstrate how established SE knowledge can guide the selection of engineering capabilities, the construction of verifiable training data, and the evaluation of model improvements. To target repository-level refactoring, we developed RefactorForge, a pipeline that combines refactoring knowledge, established SE tools, and verification techniques to construct training data. Across 306 Python repositories, RefactorForge generated 5,704 executable tasks and retained 4,572 verified teacher trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens. Incremental supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories, accounting for 0.46% of the preceding coding mixture's tokens, improved RefactorBench performance by 18.00 percentage points and SWE-Bench ProMax performance by 7.06 points. Under OpenCode, these improvements extended to SWE issue resolution, with gains of 4.97 points on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.23 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Improvements also persisted across other coding-agent harnesses, while greenfield repository generation showed mixed results. We report lessons from constructing capability-focused training data and evaluating its effects across engineering workloads. Building on this industrial experience, we propose a research agenda for expanding SE's role in transforming coding LLMs into SE LLMs: incorporating SE knowledge into model training, applying engineering methods to model development and maintenance, and systematically defining the engineering capabilities these models should acquire.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工业价值突出，但学术证据仍偏应用化。
pros: 将SE知识系统融入数据构建与能力定义，问题动机清晰

cons: 方法新颖性有限且因果归因不足，缺少更细致消融与跨语言泛化验证

papers.title_zh: 软件工程法学硕士：为什么我们需要它们以及软件工程如何帮助构建它们
papers.summary_zh: 软件工程 (SE) 专业知识可以决定大型语言模型 (LLM) 的编码方式以及他们获得的工程能力。我们通过针对为超过 100,000 名开发人员提供服务的 92B 参数编码 LLM 的以能力为中心的培训的工业案例研究来检验这一角色。我们展示了现有的 SE 知识如何指导工程能力的选择、可验证的训练数据的构建以及模型改进的评估。为了实现存储库级重构，我们开发了 RefactorForge，这是一个结合了重构知识、已建立的 SE 工具和验证技术来构建训练数据的管道。在 306 个 Python 存储库中，RefactorForge 生成了 5,704 个可执行任务，并保留了 4,572 个经过验证的教师轨迹，总计 7251 万个令牌。对这些轨迹进行增量监督微调（占先前编码混合标记的 0.46%），将 RefactorBench 性能提高了 18.00 个百分点，将 SWE-Bench ProMax 性能提高了 7.06 个百分点。在 OpenCode 下，这些改进扩展到了 SWE 问题解决，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上提高了 4.97 分，在 SWE-Bench Pro 上提高了 1.23 分。其他编码代理工具也持续改进，而新建存储库生成结果却好坏参半。我们报告了构建以能力为中心的培训数据并评估其在工程工作负载中的影响的经验教训。基于这一行业经验，我们提出了一个研究议程，以扩大SE在将编码LLM转变为SE LLM方面的作用：将SE知识纳入模型训练中，将工程方法应用于模型开发和维护，以及系统地定义这些模型应获得的工程能力。

papers.title: ZipFusion: Fusing Lossless KV Decompression with Attention for Efficient LLM Decoding
papers.summary: The key-value (KV) cache places growing demands on GPU memory capacity and bandwidth as large language models serve longer contexts and more concurrent requests. Its footprint limits concurrency, while repeated KV reads during attention can make decoding memory-bandwidth bound. Prior lossless KV cache compression methods reduce transfers between devices but restore the uncompressed KV cache in GPU memory before attention. They therefore leave these repeated KV reads unchanged and require additional work and memory for decompression. We present ZipFusion, which enables attention to consume the losslessly compressed KV cache directly. ZipFusion co-designs the compression format and attention kernel to reduce the bytes read from GPU memory during attention. The kernel reconstructs the original values directly in registers using simple bit operations, avoiding a separate decompression pass and easing the memory-bandwidth bound. ZipFusion also reassigns memory freed by compression across layers to store additional KV cache. Its memory manager reserves space for ongoing generation and makes the remaining capacity available to new requests. We implement ZipFusion on top of FlashInfer and integrate it with SGLang. On an NVIDIA H100, ZipFusion achieves about 1.25x speedup over FlashInfer in decode attention. With 8K context, it improves model decode throughput by up to 26.3% over uncompressed SGLang under the same GPU memory budget. At each method's largest supported batch, it also delivers up to 2.76x the throughput of the best-performing lossless KV cache compression baseline.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据广度仍不足。
pros: 将无损KV解压与注意力核融合，避免独立解压并减少显存读带宽压力
同时优化内核与内存管理，在H100与SGLang集成下报告了有竞争力的吞吐提升
cons: 摘要仅给出有限硬件与场景结果，缺少跨模型/长度/负载稳定性与端到端开销拆解，严谨性仍待验证
对比基线公平性与代价说明不足（如压缩率变化、精确实现细节、调参预算）

papers.title_zh: ZipFusion：融合无损 KV 解压缩和 Attention 实现高效 LLM 解码
papers.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型服务更长的上下文和更多并发请求，键值 (KV) 缓存对 GPU 内存容量和带宽的要求越来越高。它的占用空间限制了并发性，而在注意力过程中重复的 KV 读取可能会限制解码内存带宽。先前的无损 KV 缓存压缩方法减少了设备之间的传输，但在关注之前将未压缩的 KV 缓存恢复到 GPU 内存中。因此，他们保持这些重复的 KV 读取不变，并且需要额外的工作和内存来解压缩。我们提出了 ZipFusion，它可以让注意力直接使用无损压缩的 KV 缓存。 ZipFusion 共同设计了压缩格式和注意力内核，以减少注意力期间从 GPU 内存读取的字节数。内核使用简单的位操作直接在寄存器中重建原始值，避免了单独的解压缩过程并减轻了内存带宽限制。 ZipFusion 还重新分配跨层压缩释放的内存，以存储额外的 KV 缓存。其内存管理器为正在进行的生成保留空间，并使剩余容量可用于新请求。我们在 FlashInfer 之上实现 ZipFusion，并将其与 SGLang 集成。在 NVIDIA H100 上，ZipFusion 在解码注意力方面比 FlashInfer 实现了约 1.25 倍的加速。在 8K 上下文中，在相同 GPU 内存预算下，与未压缩的 SGLang 相比，它的模型解码吞吐量提高了 26.3%。在每种方法支持的最大批次中，它还提供高达性能最佳无损 KV 缓存压缩基准的 2.76 倍的吞吐量。

papers.title: RAQ-MLA: Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches
papers.summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) has been adopted by recent frontier large language models. Instead of per-head keys and values, MLA caches a compressed KV latent that is up-projected into keys and values at decode time, together with a narrow positional key that carries position information into the attention score. Existing KV-cache quantization methods are designed around the keys and values of standard attention and do not account for what MLA actually caches, which costs accuracy at low bit widths. We analyze the MLA cache both in activation distribution and in how quantization error propagates to the attention output, and show that the two cached tensors play different roles: the latent mainly supplies the values, whereas the positional key dominates the attention score. We therefore propose RAQ-MLA (Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches), which fits an invertible transform to each cached tensor against the error that tensor delivers to the attention output: attention-weighted value error for the latent and score perturbation for the positional key. Without training, RAQ-MLA quantizes the full MLA cache to about 2.5 bits per element, a 6.5x increase in theoretical KV-cache capacity, while remaining nearly lossless on reasoning and coding tasks across four MLA models.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，方法实用但证据仍偏摘要级
pros: 抓住MLA缓存量化与标准KV量化错配这一关键空白
基于张量角色差异设计目标函数，且无训练即可低比特近无损
cons: 摘要缺少误差分析细节、基线完整性与统计显著性信息，稳健性仍待验证

papers.title_zh: RAQ-MLA：多头潜在注意力缓存的角色感知量化
papers.summary_zh: 多头潜在注意力（MLA）已被最近的前沿大型语言模型采用。 MLA 不是按头键和值，而是缓存压缩的 KV 潜在值，该潜在值在解码时向上投影到键和值中，以及将位置信息携带到注意力分数中的窄位置键。现有的 KV 缓存量化方法是围绕标准注意力的键和值设计的，并没有考虑 MLA 实际缓存的内容，这会降低低位宽下的准确性。我们分析了 MLA 缓存的激活分布以及量化误差如何传播到注意力输出，并表明两个缓存张量发挥着不同的作用：潜在张量主要提供值，而位置键主导注意力分数。因此，我们提出了 RAQ-MLA（多头潜在注意力缓存的角色感知量化），它针对张量传递给注意力输出的误差，对每个缓存张量进行可逆变换：潜在注意力加权值误差和位置键的分数扰动。在没有训练的情况下，RAQ-MLA 将完整的 MLA 缓存量化为每个元素约 2.5 位，理论 KV 缓存容量增加了 6.5 倍，同时在四个 MLA 模型的推理和编码任务上保持几乎无损。

papers.title: DualPace: Decoupled Scheduling and Cooperative GPU--CPU Decoding for LLM Serving
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) serving relies on batching to improve inference throughput, but the key-value (KV) cache grows with sequence length and limits GPU-resident concurrency. CPU offloading can expand KV capacity using host memory, yet existing systems remain largely GPU-gated: CPU-resident requests make progress only when the GPU scheduler exposes suitable overlap opportunities. As a result, host memory and CPU compute cannot act as an independent serving resource, leading to bursty CPU-side progress and inflated tail inter-token latency (ITL) under load. We present DualPace, an LLM serving runtime that turns the host into an independently scheduled decode engine. DualPace separates scheduling authority across two engines: the GPU engine executes prefills and GPU-resident decodes, while an AMX-enabled CPU engine independently batches and advances CPU-resident decodes. The engines are decoupled in scheduling but cooperative in execution: the CPU can execute a complete decode iteration locally or selectively invoke GPU Dense Assist for dense stages, while offline profiles guide hardware-specific batching and routing. Our evaluations show that, in decode-oriented scenarios, DualPace improves serving throughput by 6.9--43.2\% over NEO, a state-of-the-art open-source CPU-offloading system, and by 11.5--90.6\% over vLLM, a widely used GPU serving system, while maintaining the same level of latency. DualPace also preserves NEO's P99 time-to-first-token (TTFT) advantage over vLLM while sustaining 7.3--50.5\% higher request rates than NEO at the same level of P99 ITL.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据完整性仍待加强
pros: 提出GPU/CPU解耦调度并协同解码，明确针对现有CPU offloading“被GPU门控”的痛点
给出相对NEO与vLLM的显著吞吐与尾延迟改进，系统价值与工程落地潜力较高
cons: 摘要缺少关键实验细节与统计稳健性信息（负载分布、模型规模、硬件代际、显著性检验），泛化与公平性风险仍在

papers.title_zh: DualPace：解耦调度和协同 GPU--LLM 服务的 CPU 解码
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务依赖批处理来提高推理吞吐量，但键值 (KV) 缓存会随着序列长度而增长，并限制 GPU 驻留并发性。 CPU 卸载可以使用主机内存扩展 KV 容量，但现有系统在很大程度上仍然是 GPU 门控的：只有当 GPU 调度程序公开合适的重叠机会时，CPU 驻留请求才会取得进展。因此，主机内存和 CPU 计算无法充当独立的服务资源，从而导致 CPU 端进度突发和负载下尾部令牌间延迟 (ITL) 膨胀。我们推出了 DualPace，一种 LLM 服务运行时，可将主机转变为独立调度的解码引擎。 DualPace 将调度权限分散到两个引擎中：GPU 引擎执行预填充和 GPU 驻留解码，而支持 AMX 的 CPU 引擎独立批处理和推进 CPU 驻留解码。这些引擎在调度中是解耦的，但在执行中是协作的：CPU 可以在本地执行完整的解码迭代，或有选择地调用 GPU 密集辅助来实现密集阶段，而离线配置文件则指导特定于硬件的批处理和路由。我们的评估表明，在面向解码的场景中，DualPace 比最先进的开源 CPU 卸载系统 NEO 提高了 6.9--43.2% 的服务吞吐量，比广泛使用的 GPU 服务系统 vLLM 提高了 11.5--90.6%，同时保持相同水平的延迟。 DualPace 还保留了 NEO 的 P99 首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 相对于 vLLM 的优势，同时在相同的 P99 ITL 水平上维持比 NEO 高 7.3--50.5% 的请求率。

papers.title: LLMs in Cloud: A Discussion on Architecture, Orchestration, and Inference
papers.summary: The widespread deployment of foundational Large Language Models (LLM) across cloud datacenters marks a fundamental paradigm shift from stateless deep learning toward distributed, memory-intensive generative workloads. However, serving massive foundation models under stringent Service Level Objectives (SLO) exposes critical physical and system bottlenecks. These challenges include the persistent High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) wall, operational asymmetry between compute-bound prefilling and memory-bandwidth-bound decoding, explosive Key-Value (KV) cache expansion, prohibitive serverless cold starts, and hardware reliability vulnerabilities. Existing literature reviews remain layer-siloed, decoupling low-level accelerator virtualization from cluster orchestration and runtime inference, while largely overlooking defining advancements from 2024 to 2026. To address these limitations, this study presents a comprehensive, cross-layer systematic review guided by the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 framework. We synthesize a holistic taxonomy unifying hardware virtualization, cluster-level scheduling, and runtime inference optimizations, including iteration-level continuous batching, prefill-decoding disaggregation, and hierarchical KV cache offloading. Furthermore, we evaluate resilient cloud-native service architectures, examining scale-to-zero serverless paradigms, fault-tolerant checkpointing against silent data corruption, and hardware-enforced Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) for multi-tenant isolation. Finally, we formalize the multi-dimensional Pareto trade-offs governing throughput, latency, monetary cost, and confidentiality, outlining a forward-looking research roadmap spanning Compute Express Link (CXL) memory pooling, in-memory computing, and autonomous multi-agent control planes to guide future cloud LLM infrastructure.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且框架完整，但方法与证据强度待验证。
pros: 跨硬件虚拟化、集群调度与推理运行时的分层整合视角较系统
覆盖2024-2026关键议题并引入SLO/成本/隐私多目标权衡框架
cons: 作为综述论文，创新性主要在组织与归纳，原创方法贡献有限
PRISMA执行细节与纳入排除标准在摘要中不充分，严谨性仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: 云中的法学硕士：关于架构、编排和推理的讨论
papers.summary_zh: 基础大型语言模型（LLM）在云数据中心的广泛部署标志着从无状态深度学习到分布式、内存密集型生成工作负载的根本范式转变。然而，在严格的服务级别目标 (SLO) 下为大规模基础模型提供服务会暴露出关键的物理和系统瓶颈。这些挑战包括持久的高带宽内存 (HBM) 墙、计算限制的预填充和内存带宽限制的解码之间的操作不对称、爆炸性的键值 (KV) 缓存扩展、令人望而却步的无服务器冷启动以及硬件可靠性漏洞。现有的文献综述仍然是分层的，将低级加速器虚拟化与集群编排和运行时推理脱钩，同时在很大程度上忽略了 2024 年至 2026 年的定义进步。为了解决这些局限性，本研究提出了一项全面的、跨层的系统综述，以系统评价和元分析的首选报告项目 (PRISMA) 2020 框架为指导。我们综合了一个统一硬件虚拟化、集群级调度和运行时推理优化的整体分类法，包括迭代级连续批处理、预填充解码分解和分层 KV 缓存卸载。此外，我们还评估弹性云原生服务架构，检查从规模到零的无服务器范例、针对静默数据损坏的容错检查点，以及用于多租户隔离的硬件强制可信执行环境 (TEE)。最后，我们正式确定了管理吞吐量、延迟、货币成本和机密性的多维帕累托权衡，概述了涵盖计算快速链路 (CXL) 内存池、内存计算和自主多代理控制平面的前瞻性研究路线图，以指导未来的云 LLM 基础设施。

papers.title: One Call Ahead: Packed Self-Speculative Decoding with Diffusion Drafting
papers.summary: Autoregressive (AR) language models generate tokens sequentially, so generating long outputs is costly. Speculative decoding mitigates this by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens for the target AR model to verify in parallel, while a diffusion-based drafter can produce an entire draft block in one forward pass. In models with AR and diffusion modes, one network both drafts and verifies, but drafting still waits for verification, so the standard schedule needs two sequential model calls per iteration. Existing one-call schedules avoid the wait but incur input size quadratic in the speculative width. Motivated by this efficiency bottleneck, we introduce Packed-SS, a self-speculative decoding schedule that verifies and drafts in a single model call with input size linear in the speculative width, while preserving the target model's distribution. The key idea is to let the diffusion drafter run one call ahead: while verifying the current draft, the model simultaneously constructs the next draft from an older verified prefix and keeps its unresolved suffix for the next iteration. Under a mild monotonicity assumption on the drafter, we further show that Packed-SS requires no more model calls than the standard two-call decoding in the greedy setting. Experiments on Nemotron 3B/8B and SetDLM 1.7B show higher throughput and lower mean wall time than both baselines under greedy decoding.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据广度仍不足。
pros: 提出线性输入规模的一次调用自投机调度，直击现有方法瓶颈
给出分布保持与调用次数不劣的理论说明，并在多模型上展示吞吐与时延收益
cons: 关键结论依赖温和单调性假设，摘要未体现其可验证性与失效情形
实验主要集中于贪心解码，缺少采样场景与更大规模模型的泛化证据

papers.title_zh: 提前一通：通过扩散起草进行打包自推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 自回归 (AR) 语言模型按顺序生成标记，因此生成长输出的成本很高。推测性解码通过使用轻量级绘图器为目标 AR 模型提出多个标记以并行验证来缓解这一问题，而基于扩散的绘图器可以在一次前向传递中生成整个草稿块。在具有 AR 和扩散模式的模型中，一个网络同时进行起草和验证，但起草仍然等待验证，因此标准计划每次迭代需要两次顺序模型调用。现有的一调用调度避免了等待，但会导致输入大小与推测宽度成二次方。受此效率瓶颈的推动，我们引入了 Packed-SS，这是一种自推测解码计划，可在单个模型调用中验证和起草，输入大小与推测宽度呈线性关系，同时保留目标模型的分布。关键思想是让扩散起草者提前运行一个调用：在验证当前草案时，模型同时从较旧的已验证前缀构造下一个草案，并为下一次迭代保留其未解析的后缀。在起草者的温和单调性假设下，我们进一步表明，Packed-SS 不需要比贪婪设置中的标准两次调用解码更多的模型调用。 Nemotron 3B/8B 和 SetDLM 1.7B 上的实验表明，在贪婪解码下，与两个基线相比，吞吐量更高，平均挂壁时间更低。

papers.title: LSTM-Style Looped Transformers with Shared KV Caches
papers.summary: Recurrent transformers reuse weights to perform deep computation with fewer parameters. We study an LSTM-style transformer that also shares one key--value cache across its recurrent core. At width 1024, it uses 40.4% fewer parameters than an untied control at nearly matched forward FLOPs, and reduces persistent cache sets from fifteen to four. Parallel training supplies cache entries from a standard-attention pass, whereas continuation reads entries produced recursively using shared attention. We address this mismatch by aligning the two training passes' cache entries with a consistency loss during the final 10% of a fixed training-token budget. Across three model widths on FineWeb, this removes 81--89% of the continuation-loss penalty relative to full-cache evaluation. The improvement replicates on disjoint documents for two training seeds. Across four widths and 1.05--4.19B training tokens, the loss cost of weight tying is smallest at lower token budgets, suggesting an opportunity to use recurrent computation when data and model storage are limited.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据深度仍不足。
pros: 将循环权重复用与共享KV缓存结合，面向推理效率问题切中痛点
在近似匹配FLOPs下显著降参并减少持久缓存集合，工程价值明确
cons: 评估主要停留在训练损失与续写损失，缺少端到端吞吐、时延和显存实测
一致性损失仅在训练末段启用，超参数与稳定性敏感性分析不足

papers.title_zh: 具有共享 KV 缓存的 LSTM 式循环变压器
papers.summary_zh: 循环变压器重用权重以更少的参数执行深度计算。我们研究了一种 LSTM 风格的转换器，它也在其循环核心之间共享一个键值缓存。在宽度为 1024 时，它在几乎匹配的正向 FLOP 下使用的参数比未绑定控件少 40.4%，并将持久缓存集从 15 个减少到 4 个。并行训练从标准注意力传递中提供缓存条目，而继续读取使用共享注意力递归生成的条目。我们通过在固定训练令牌预算的最后 10% 期间将两个训练遍的缓存条目与一致性损失对齐来解决这种不匹配问题。在 FineWeb 上的三个模型宽度中，相对于全缓存评估，这消除了 81--89% 的连续损失惩罚。该改进复制了两个训练种子的不相交文档。在四种宽度和 1.05--4.19B 训练令牌中，权重绑定的损失成本在令牌预算较低时最小，这表明当数据和模型存储有限时有机会使用循环计算。

papers.title: NgramRL: Accelerating RL Post-Training for Structured Generation via Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but its cost is dominated by autoregressive rollout generation, which can exceed 70% of training time. Existing speculative-decoding methods are poorly suited to this setting: model-based drafters consume scarce GPU memory and may become misaligned as the policy evolves, while existing model-free methods do not explicitly exploit repetition across training epochs. We observe that recent rollouts of the same prompt provide a high-quality, self-updating draft source. Based on this insight, we propose NgramRL, a per-prompt n-gram drafter constructed from bounded recent rollout history. NgramRL requires no auxiliary model, drafter training, or persistent GPU-resident drafter state, while target-model verification preserves the rollout distribution. To hide CPU cache lookup and scheduling, we further introduce an adaptive fan-out prefetcher that predicts likely verification outcomes (j, b), consisting of the accepted draft length j and target-emitted continuation token b. A causal budget allocator concentrates prefetches on high-probability outcomes, while uncovered outcomes fall back to sequential lookup without changing committed tokens. Across two model families and three reasoning and structured-generation workloads, NgramRL commits 3.60-7.77 tokens per target-model forward in the warm-cache regime, up to 1.99x more than SuffixDecoding and 7.0x more than prompt-lookup decoding. On Spider, the prefetcher covers 96.6% of Qwen3-8B outcomes at a candidate budget of 16 and improves measured rollout throughput by 1.38x over synchronous NgramRL, approaching its 1.40x overlap ceiling.

papers.title_zh: NgramRL：通过 Rollout-Aware N-gram 推测解码加速结构化生成的 RL 后训练
papers.summary_zh: 强化学习 (RL) 后训练提高了大型语言模型的推理能力，但其成本主要由自回归推出生成主导，该生成可能超过训练时间的 70%。现有的推测解码方法不太适合这种设置：基于模型的绘图器消耗稀缺的 GPU 内存，并且随着策略的发展可能会变得不对齐，而现有的无模型方法并没有明确地利用跨训练时期的重复。我们观察到，最近推出的同一提示提供了高质量、自我更新的草稿源。基于这一见解，我们提出了 NgramRL，这是一种根据有限的最近推出历史构建的按提示的 n-gram 起草器。 NgramRL 不需要辅助模型、绘图员训练或持久的 GPU 驻留绘图员状态，而目标模型验证保留了推出分布。为了隐藏 CPU 缓存查找和调度，我们进一步引入了一个自适应扇出预取器，它可以预测可能的验证结果 (j, b)，其中包括接受的草稿长度 j 和目标发出的延续令牌 b。因果预算分配器将预取集中在高概率结果上，而未覆盖的结果则回退到顺序查找而不更改已提交的令牌。在两个模型系列以及三个推理和结构化生成工作负载中，NgramRL 在热缓存机制中为每个目标模型提交 3.60-7.77 个令牌，比 SuffixDecoding 多出 1.99 倍，比提示查找解码多出 7.0 倍。在 Spider 上，预取器在候选预算为 16 的情况下覆盖了 96.6% 的 Qwen3-8B 结果，并将测量的转出吞吐量比同步 NgramRL 提高了 1.38 倍，接近其 1.40 倍重叠上限。

papers.title: InferSlice: A Reference Architecture for SLO-driven LLM Inference over a Telco Wide-Area Network
papers.summary: LLM inference is increasingly deployed as a core service for enterprise and interactive applications, but sovereignty, compliance, latency and resource-locality requirements can limit the suitability of centralised cloud deployments. Telco operators offer geographically distributed compute and network infrastructure for addressing these constraints. However, existing LLM serving frameworks are designed for tightly coupled data centres and provide limited support for coordinating geographically distributed and heterogeneous resources. We present InferSlice, a reference architecture for Service-Level Objective (SLO)-driven LLM inference over a telco infrastructure, integrating network slicing, GPU partitioning, elastic serving and observability. Led by BT in collaboration with the University of Bristol and NVIDIA, and realised on the JOINER UK national-scale wide-area network (WAN), InferSlice is evaluated on service differentiation across tiers, elastic scale-out, client-edge bandwidth as a bottleneck, and the reach of tensor, pipeline, data parallelism, and prefill/decode disaggregation over the WAN. Our results show that, on a general-purpose telco network, tiers yield distinct latency-throughput regimes, and weight streaming shortens scale-out time. Replication is placement-insensitive but memory-bound; pipeline parallelism tolerates near- and mid-cross-site hops, while tensor parallelism and disaggregation fail beyond a single subnet hop. We share practical insights from operating SLO-driven inference on a telco network, lessons learned and open questions, and hope to encourage further research on distributed and heterogeneous LLM inference systems.

papers.title_zh: InferSlice：通过电信广域网进行 SLO 驱动的 LLM 推理的参考架构
papers.summary_zh: LLM 推理越来越多地作为企业和交互式应用程序的核心服务进行部署，但主权、合规性、延迟和资源本地化要求可能会限制集中式云部署的适用性。电信运营商提供地理上分布式的计算和网络基础设施来解决这些限制。然而，现有的LLM服务框架是为紧密耦合的数据中心设计的，并且为协调地理上分布的异构资源提供有限的支持。我们推出了 InferSlice，这是一种在电信基础设施上进行服务级别目标 (SLO) 驱动的 LLM 推理的参考架构，集成了网络切片、GPU 分区、弹性服务和可观察性。 InferSlice 由 BT 与布里斯托大学和 NVIDIA 合作领导，并在 JOINER UK 国家级广域网 (WAN) 上实现，针对跨层服务差异化、弹性横向扩展、作为瓶颈的客户端边缘带宽以及 WAN 上张量、管道、数据并行性和预填充/解码分解的范围进行了评估。我们的结果表明，在通用电信网络上，各层会产生不同的延迟吞吐量机制，并且权重流会缩短横向扩展时间。复制对位置不敏感，但受内存限制；管道并行性可以容忍近站点和中跨站点跃点，而张量并行性和分解则无法超出单个子网跃点。我们分享在电信网络上运行 SLO 驱动推理的实用见解、经验教训和开放性问题，并希望鼓励对分布式和异构 LLM 推理系统的进一步研究。

papers.title: DELA: Learning Controllable Edits for Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support bidirectional denoising and iterative refinement, but generation remains largely controlled by token-level masking schedules. This leaves draft-level refinement implicit and limits explicit control over when to insert missing content, delete redundant spans, revisit uncertain regions, or stop editing. We introduce Diffusion Editing Language Adapter (DELA), a plug-in framework that enables controllable draft refinement with a frozen DLM. DELA operates on clean, variable-length drafts using four explicit editing actions: Insert, Delete, Remask, and Stop. The controller determines when and where to edit the draft, while the frozen DLM fills masked regions through denoising, separating high-level edit control from token-level generation. A naive single-phase editor would be computationally expensive because arbitrary interior edits can disrupt prefix stability and limit reliable KV-cache reuse. To address this, DELA uses a two-phase decoding procedure: a fast, append-only drafting phase that supports KV-cache reuse, followed by a global refinement phase that enables targeted non-monotonic edits to the full draft. We train the controller using a staged curriculum that begins with learning local edit priors from synthetic recovery tasks and mined actions that improve draft quality. Subsequent stages refine edit selection through rollout-based outcome preferences and alignment with downstream task feedback. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that DELA achieves gains of up to 5.5 percentage points over direct diffusion decoding while keeping the backbone frozen. DELA thus provides a modular approach to explicit draft-level control in diffusion language models.

papers.title_zh: DELA：学习扩散语言模型的可控编辑
papers.summary_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）支持双向去噪和迭代细化，但生成仍然主要由令牌级掩码计划控制。这使得草稿级细化变得隐式，并限制了对何时插入缺失内容、删除冗余跨度、重新访问不确定区域或停止编辑的显式控制。我们引入了扩散编辑语言适配器 (DELA)，这是一个插件框架，可通过冻结的 DLM 实现可控的草稿细化。 DELA 使用四种显式编辑操作对干净的、可变长度的草稿进行操作：插入、删除、重新屏蔽和停止。控制器确定何时何地编辑草稿，而冻结的 DLM 通过去噪填充屏蔽区域，将高级编辑控制与令牌级生成分开。一个简单的单阶段编辑器在计算上会非常昂贵，因为任意内部编辑可能会破坏前缀稳定性并限制可靠的 KV 缓存重用。为了解决这个问题，DELA 使用两阶段解码过程：一个支持 KV 缓存重用的快速、仅附加起草阶段，然后是一个全局细化阶段，可以对完整草稿进行有针对性的非单调编辑。我们使用分阶段课程来训练控制器，该课程首先从综合恢复任务中学习本地编辑先验，并挖掘提高草稿质量的动作。后续阶段通过基于推出的结果偏好并与下游任务反馈保持一致来完善编辑选择。数学推理和代码生成实验表明，DELA 在保持骨干网冻结的同时，比直接扩散解码实现了高达 5.5 个百分点的增益。因此，DELA 提供了一种模块化方法，用于在扩散语言模型中进行显式草稿级控制。

papers.title: LazyFlash: Forward-Dense, Backward-Sparse Attention for Accelerated Long-Context Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly long sequences, attention becomes a major computational bottleneck. Sparse attention mostly targets inference, yet many methods still train densely or cannot support sparse training, and their added complexity makes sparsity hard to turn into wall-clock speedups, leaving dense attention widely used in practice. This paper introduces LazyFlash, a forward-dense, backward-sparse attention method built on the observation that attention training is dominated by the backward pass. LazyFlash keeps the forward pass exactly dense, so the trained model remains a standard dense model that existing systems such as vLLM can serve without any change. For the backward pass, LazyFlash proposes a gradient-aware block sparsification design that ranks query blocks by their attention-output gradient norms and skips those contributing negligibly to parameter updates, turning the dense backward into a block-sparse one. A gradient-mass budget adapts the amount of skipped computation to each head and training step, while importance sampling preserves the dense gradient in expectation. These designs are implemented inside the tiled FlashAttention backward kernel, where skipped blocks are never loaded or computed, translating gradient sparsity into real wall-clock acceleration. Experiments on long-context text and speech LLMs show that LazyFlash maintains downstream performance while achieving up to 5.7x attention-backward speedup over FlashAttention and 1.7x end-to-end training speedup.

papers.title_zh: LazyFlash：前向密集、后向稀疏注意力，用于加速长上下文微调
papers.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）处理越来越长的序列，注意力成为主要的计算瓶颈。稀疏注意力主要针对推理，但许多方法仍然密集训练或无法支持稀疏训练，而且它们增加的复杂性使得稀疏性很难转化为挂钟加速，从而使得密集注意力在实践中得到广泛应用。本文介绍了 LazyFlash，这是一种前向密集、后向稀疏的注意力方法，基于注意力训练由后向传递主导的观察结果。 LazyFlash 保持前向传递完全密集，因此训练后的模型仍然是标准密集模型，vLLM 等现有系统无需任何更改即可提供服务。对于后向传递，LazyFlash 提出了一种梯度感知块稀疏化设计，该设计根据查询块的注意力输出梯度范数对查询块进行排序，并跳过那些对参数更新贡献微不足道的块，将密集后向转换为块稀疏块。梯度质量预算使跳过的计算量适应每个头和训练步骤，而重要性采样保留期望中的密集梯度。这些设计是在平铺的 FlashAttention 后向内核中实现的，其中跳过的块永远不会被加载或计算，从而将梯度稀疏性转化为真正的挂钟加速。对长上下文文本和语音 LLM 的实验表明，LazyFlash 保持下游性能，同时实现比 FlashAttention 高达 5.7 倍的注意力向后加速和 1.7 倍的端到端训练加速。

papers.title: FSVL: Taxonomic Fast-Slow Vision-to-Language Collaborative Framework for Interpretable Confusable Fish Species Identification and Knowledge Generation in the Middle Yangtze River
papers.summary: The Yangtze River Basin is a critical region for freshwater biodiversity conservation. The implementation of the Yangtze River Ten-Year Fishing Ban has increased the importance of effective aquatic biodiversity monitoring and species-level identification. However, fine-grained identification of closely related freshwater fish species remains challenging due to subtle morphological differences. Existing deep learning methods often struggle to balance classification accuracy and inference efficiency, while LLMs may generate unsupported information when producing specialized biological knowledge. To address these challenges, this study proposes FSVL, a fast-slow dual-pathway framework integrating visual recognition with LLM-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). A lightweight ResNet50 fast path performs preliminary classification across 51 fish species in the Middle Yangtze River Basin and routes predefined groups of easily confused species to a slow path for refined identification. Guided by taxonomic criteria, the slow path uses YOLOv8n to detect key morphological regions, including the head, dorsal fin, and tail, leveraging morphometric and outline traits to improve discrimination among closely related species. The framework further integrates a retrieval-enhanced Qwen3-14B backend, using soft tokens and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for parameter-efficient domain knowledge generation. On the evaluated test set of 607 images, the fast classifier achieved 99.67% accuracy, whereas the cascade corrected the two errors, yielding 100.00% overall accuracy; further validation on independent specimens and external conditions remains needed. Across 255 knowledge generation samples, scientific name accuracy rises from 91.37% to 100.00%, genus accuracy from 90.20% to 98.82%, and ROUGE-L from 0.335 to 0.655, supporting intelligent biodiversity monitoring and fisheries management.

papers.title_zh: FSVL：长江中游可解释易混淆鱼类物种识别和知识生成的分类快慢视觉语言协作框架
papers.summary_zh: 长江流域是淡水生物多样性保护的重要区域。长江十年禁渔的实施，提高了有效水生生物多样性监测和物种层面识别的重要性。然而，由于细微的形态差异，密切相关的淡水鱼类物种的细粒度识别仍然具有挑战性。现有的深度学习方法往往难以平衡分类准确性和推理效率，而法学硕士在产生专门的生物知识时可能会产生不受支持的信息。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了 FSVL，一种将视觉识别与基于 LLM 的检索增强生成 (RAG) 相结合的快慢双路径框架。轻量级的 ResNet50 快速路径对长江中游流域的 51 种鱼类进行初步分类，并将预定义的易混淆物种组路由到慢速路径以进行精细识别。在分类学标准的指导下，慢速路径使用 YOLOv8n 来检测关键形态区域，包括头部、背鳍和尾部，利用形态测量和轮廓特征来提高密切相关物种之间的区分。该框架进一步集成了检索增强型 Qwen3-14B 后端，使用软令牌和低秩适应 (LoRA) 来生成参数高效的领域知识。在 607 张图像的评估测试集上，快速分类器实现了 99.67% 的准确率，而级联纠正了这两个错误，总体准确率达到 100.00%；仍需要对独立样本和外部条件进行进一步验证。在255个知识生成样本中，学名准确率从91.37%上升到100.00%，属准确率从90.20%上升到98.82%，ROUGE-L从0.335上升到0.655，支持智能生物多样性监测和渔业管理。

papers.title: SPECMEM: Accelerating Agentic Tool Calling via Live Memory Management
papers.summary: Tool-calling agents are mostly optimized for accuracy; in deployment, however, their growing cost is latency: every tool call is decoded autoregressively. Speculative decoding accelerates this without changing the output, and retrieved past calls make strong drafts under real use, where each user's behavior tends to repeat. Yet existing systems keep no cross-session memory, or build the draft store once and never update it. We propose SpecMem, a tool-call memory kept alive and managed throughout deployment: verified calls are written back online into bounded per-user stores with LRU eviction, and a side-effect gate defers irreversible calls until verification confirms. On multi-session, multi-user query streams served by three open-weight models, a frozen store steadily loses acceptance while SpecMem holds it: a 27% gap in mean accepted tokens (+11% to +34% across benchmarks, tracking how much novel work arrives after the store is built) and up to 1.74x wall-clock speedup. Ablations attribute the gain almost entirely to keeping the store live; local per-user scoping adds no acceptance but closes a measured cross-user leakage channel, and gating on declared side effects, rather than on retrieval confidence, is what eliminates irreversible mistakes.

papers.title_zh: SPECMEM：通过实时内存管理加速代理工具调用
papers.summary_zh: 工具调用代理大多针对准确性进行了优化；然而，在部署中，它们不断增长的成本是延迟：每个工具调用都是自回归解码的。推测性解码在不改变输出的情况下加速了这一过程，并且检索到的过去的调用在实际使用中产生了强大的草稿，其中每个用户的行为往往会重复。然而，现有系统不保留跨会话内存，或者构建一次草稿存储并且从不更新它。我们提出了 SpecMem，一种在整个部署过程中保持活动和管理的工具调用内存：经过验证的调用通过 LRU 逐出在线写回到有界的每用户存储中，并且副作用门推迟了不可逆的调用，直到验证确认为止。在由三个开放权重模型提供的多会话、多用户查询流上，冻结存储逐渐失去接受度，而 SpecMem 保持它：平均接受令牌有 27% 的差距（跨基准+11% 到 +34%，跟踪商店构建后到达的新颖工作数量）和高达 1.74 倍的挂钟加速。消融几乎完全将收益归因于保持商店的活力；本地每用户范围界定不会增加接受度，但会关闭可测量的跨用户泄漏通道，并且对声明的副作用（而不是对检索置信度）进行控制可以消除不可逆转的错误。

papers.title: KVStream: Adaptive Parallel Storage Management for KV Caching in Large-Scale LLM Serving
papers.summary: Long-context LLM serving for agentic, coding, and document workloads reuses prefixes whose key-value (KV) cache outgrows GPU and host memory, putting storage I/O on the critical path of the inference step for retrieving prefixes. A single node-local NVMe absorbs all retrievals, while the parallel file system or cloud file store that nodes already mount carries almost no inference traffic. We cast prefix retrieval as aggregate-bandwidth scheduling across these tiers and present KVStream, a KV cache engine that batches a step's reads, defers writes behind the forward pass, replicates each chunk on every tier, and lets each tier adaptively claim the next unread chunks once it is free. Our performance model shows this routing attains the aggregate-bandwidth bound without prediction or tuning, whereas any static split misses it by a margin that grows as per-tier bandwidths drift or fluctuate. It also predicts that the time-to-first-token (TTFT) gain grows with load, as faster retrieval drains the queue, and disappears when host memory or arrival order keeps reuse in cache. Plugged into LMCache and evaluated on four models, six datasets, and up to 128 GPUs, KVStream retrieves within 5% of the bound, delivers up to 1.49$\times$ higher offline throughput than LMCache, and lowers mean TTFT by up to 6.1$\times$ under bursty arrivals.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、方法实用，证据较强但外部可推广性待证。
pros: 将前缀KV检索建模为跨层聚合带宽调度，动机清晰且契合真实瓶颈
给出无预测自适应路由与可验证性能上界，并在多模型多数据集与128卡规模展示显著TTFT/吞吐收益
