papers.title_zh: KVStream：大规模 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存的自适应并行存储管理
papers.summary_zh: 服务于代理、编码和文档工作负载的长上下文 LLM 重用其键值 (KV) 缓存超出 GPU 和主机内存的前缀，将存储 I/O 放在用于检索前缀的推理步骤的关键路径上。单个节点本地 NVMe 吸收所有检索，而节点已安装的并行文件系统或云文件存储几乎不承载任何推理流量。我们将前缀检索作为跨这些层的聚合带宽调度，并提出 KVStream，这是一种 KV 缓存引擎，它可以批量读取步骤，推迟前向传递后面的写入，复制每个层上的每个块，并让每个层在空闲时自适应地声明下一个未读块。我们的性能模型显示，此路由无需预测或调整即可达到聚合带宽界限，而任何静态分割都会因每层带宽漂移或波动而增长的裕度而错过它。它还预测，首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 增益会随着负载的增加而增长，因为更快的检索会耗尽队列，而当主机内存或到达顺序在缓存中保持重用时，该增益就会消失。插入 LMCache 并在四个模型、六个数据集和多达 128 个 GPU 上进行评估，KVStream 检索范围在 5% 以内，提供比 LMCache 高出 1.49$\times 的离线吞吐量，并在突发到达情况下将平均 TTFT 降低多达 6.1$\times$。

papers.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
papers.summary: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.

quality.label: 较高

pros: 将扩散努力与投机验收宽松度统一建模，问题表述清晰

papers.title_zh: 投机扩散是两个权衡的故事
papers.summary_zh: 推测解码是一种通过从速度更快、质量较低的草稿模型中进行采样来加速自回归大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理速度的技术。传统上，推测解码的一个基本特征是它对于验证者分布是无损的，保证速度而不牺牲质量。这与最近开发的扩散法学硕士 (dLLM) 不同，后者能够以较少的扩散工作降低输出质量，从而实现大幅加速。由于扩散模型能够通过并行生成标记来比自回归模型更快地采样，因此它们被认为是投机扩散中草案模型的有力候选者。虽然人们普遍认为扩散模型会为了速度而牺牲质量，但推测性解码本身也可以推广到使用相对于验证者分布更宽松的接受标准更快地生成有损样本。本文提出了扩散努力和推测解码宽大两个参数，通过这些参数的联合变化探索完全可实现的帕累托前沿。我们的实验表明，联合改变扩散努力和接受宽容可以扩展单步扩散起草的速度质量帕累托前沿。

papers.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
papers.summary: Looped architectures scale quality while keeping parameter count fixed by repeatedly passing activations through the same block of layers. During inference, each recurrence generates independent KV-caches, causing memory to grow linearly. To address this challenge, prior work has proposed KV-sharing (i.e., sharing KV-caches across depth), finding that, in some cases, the KV-cache of the final recurrence can be shared with the earlier recurrences without quality loss, a property we denote as KV-shareability. However, the mechanisms underlying KV-shareability remain poorly understood, with even identically trained looped architectures not consistently exhibiting it. In this paper, we study how KV-shareability can be enabled in looped models. We propose a two-stage method: in the first stage, we use stochastic depth during pretraining, which induces contractive residual dynamics that drive representations toward a common limit across recurrences. In the second stage, we propose BeNice!, a post-training method that broadcasts the final recurrence's KV-cache into the first recurrence, training it to produce compatible residuals while preserving the original model's quality. As a result, BeNice! enables KV-shareability while matching standard finetuning's unshared validation perplexity. Using BeNice!, we show that KV-sharing is complementary to alternative KV-compression methods, composing with memory-efficient sequence mixers (e.g., multi-latent attention, Kimi delta attention) and low-precision KV-cache quantization (e.g., fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4). Finally, in simulated low-memory, long-context inference, KV-sharing improves cache hit rates by up to 31.4%, increases throughput by up to 23.6%, and reduces p90 time-to-first-token by up to 83.6%.

papers.title_zh: 乖！通过 KV 共享缩小循环的推理内存差距
papers.summary_zh: 循环架构通过在同一层块中重复传递激活来扩展质量，同时保持参数数量固定。在推理过程中，每次循环都会生成独立的 KV 缓存，导致内存线性增长。为了应对这一挑战，之前的工作提出了 KV 共享（即跨深度共享 KV 缓存），发现在某些情况下，最终循环的 KV 缓存可以与早期循环共享，而不会造成质量损失，我们将这一属性表示为 KV 可共享性。然而，KV 可共享性背后的机制仍然知之甚少，即使是经过相同训练的循环架构也不能始终如一地表现出来。在本文中，我们研究了如何在循环模型中启用 KV 共享性。我们提出了一种两阶段方法：在第一阶段，我们在预训练期间使用随机深度，这会引起收缩残差动态，从而将表示推向递归的共同极限。在第二阶段，我们提出了 BeNice！，一种后训练方法，将最终循环的 KV 缓存广播到第一个循环中，训练它产生兼容的残差，同时保留原始模型的质量。结果，BeNice！实现 KV 共享性，同时匹配标准微调的非共享验证困惑。使用 BeNice!，我们证明 KV 共享是替代 KV 压缩方法的补充，由内存高效的序列混合器（例如，多潜在注意力、Kimi delta 注意力）和低精度 KV 缓存量化（例如，fp8、mxfp8、nvfp4）组成。最后，在模拟的低内存、长上下文推理中，KV 共享将缓存命中率提高了 31.4%，将吞吐量提高了 23.6%，并将 p90 首次令牌时间缩短了 83.6%。

papers.title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
papers.summary: Apple Silicon is among the most widely used platforms for local LLM inference, yet nearly all inference optimizations are designed and validated on server-class NVIDIA GPUs under batched serving workloads. Which optimizations retain their benefits when moved to Apple Silicon, and what determines their applicability? We evaluate four optimization families: KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization. Experiments span four Apple machines under a common single-request decode workload, with matched RTX 4090 comparisons where possible. KV-cache pruning can reach up to 1.75 times end-to-end throughput on Apple but can reduce throughput on desktop NVIDIA GPUs. Under the common benchmark, all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput on Apple, despite reported 2-6 times gains on server GPUs. CUDA kernel designs transfer only partially: public Metal lacks asynchronous copy, and batch-one decode makes several serving-oriented mechanisms inapplicable, although transferable components yield up to 1.20 times decode throughput. Quantization gains vary by machine. Across four families, a reported speedup is not a portable property of a technique alone but a joint function of technique, runtime, hardware contract, and workload regime.
papers.comment: Paper was accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence (ODI) and the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). OpenReview ODI: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Y6fgNlFNL6, OpemReview SLM: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Hhqi8DIZaG

papers.title_zh: 评估 LLM 推理优化在 Apple Silicon 上的适用性
papers.summary_zh: Apple Silicon 是本地 LLM 推理最广泛使用的平台之一，但几乎所有推理优化都是在批量服务工作负载下的服务器级 NVIDIA GPU 上设计和验证的。哪些优化在转移到 Apple Silicon 后仍保留其优势，以及什么决定了它们的适用性？我们评估了四个优化系列：KV 缓存修剪、推测性解码、移植的 GPU 内核和训练后量化。实验在常见的单请求解码工作负载下跨越四台 Apple 机器，并尽可能进行匹配的 RTX 4090 比较。 KV 缓存修剪在 Apple 上可以达到高达 1.75 倍的端到端吞吐量，但会降低桌面 NVIDIA GPU 上的吞吐量。在通用基准测试下，所有评估的推测性解码方法都会降低 Apple 的吞吐量，尽管据报道服务器 GPU 的吞吐量提高了 2-6 倍。 CUDA 内核设计仅部分传输：公共 Metal 缺乏异步复制，并且批量一解码使得多种面向服务的机制不适用，尽管可传输组件产生高达 1.20 倍的解码吞吐量。量化增益因机器而异。在四个系列中，报告的加速并不是技术本身的可移植属性，而是技术、运行时、硬件合同和工作负载机制的联合函数。

papers.title: Drift Says When, Budget Says How Much: Rate-Controlled KV Re-selection for Long-Form Multimodal Generation
papers.summary: KV cache compression for multimodal LLMs usually selects the visual tokens to keep once, at prefill, and reuses that selection for the whole generation. We show that this one-shot selection is severely limited on long-form generation: on detailed image description, even an oracle that selects with the attention of the uncompressed answer reaches only 0.44-0.52 ROUGE-L agreement with the uncompressed output, because the evidence the model reads moves as the description unfolds. Re-selecting whenever attention drifts out of the kept set is the natural remedy, but we find that a fixed drift threshold fails systematically: drift magnitudes are not comparable across samples, so low-drift samples are almost never refreshed although they benefit the most. We propose Rate-Controlled Refresh (RCR), which lets drift decide when and where to re-select while a per-sample controller regulates how often, combined with a low-rank drift detector, candidate-restricted re-selection, and a decision that stays on the GPU. With one setting for all models and tasks, RCR outperforms the per-step retrieval method InfiniGen by 1.6-3.8 ROUGE-L points on five of six model-task settings with no significant difference on the sixth, while staying within 1.7 points of exact per-step re-selection, with comparable estimated data movement per step and a 4x smaller GPU-resident detector. On DetailCaps, drift-chosen timing beats random timing at the same refresh rate and periodic timing even at a higher rate, by 2.0-5.0 points. On pre-registered video description, where drift is homogeneous across samples, RCR is on par with InfiniGen on Qwen2-VL and exceeds it on Qwen3-VL but no longer beats a fixed threshold at the nearest tested rates, consistent with the diagnosis; object-level evaluation shows that RCR achieves higher object F1 against the uncompressed output than InfiniGen on two of three models.

papers.title_zh: 漂移说明何时，预算说明多少：用于长形式多模态生成的速率控制 KV 重选
papers.summary_zh: 多模式 LLM 的 KV 缓存压缩通常会选择视觉标记在预填充时保留一次，并在整个生成过程中重用该选择。我们表明，这种一次性选择在长格式生成上受到严重限制：在详细的图像描述上，即使是关注未压缩答案进行选择的预言机也只能与未压缩输出达到 0.44-0.52 ROUGE-L 一致性，因为模型读取的证据会随着描述的展开而移动。每当注意力偏离保留的集合时重新选择是自然的补救措施，但我们发现固定的漂移阈值系统性地失败了：样本之间的漂移幅度不可比较，因此低漂移样本几乎从不刷新，尽管它们受益最多。我们提出了速率控制刷新（RCR），它让漂移决定何时何地重新选择，同时每个样本控制器调节频率，结合低秩漂移检测器、候选限制重新选择以及保留在 GPU 上的决策。在所有模型和任务都采用一种设置的情况下，RCR 在六个模型任务设置中的五个上比每步检索方法 InfiniGen 好 1.6-3.8 个 ROUGE-L 点，而在第六个上没有显着差异，同时精确每步重新选择的精度保持在 1.7 点以内，每步估计的数据移动量相当，并且 GPU 驻留检测器小 4 倍。在 DetailCaps 上，漂移选择的时序在相同的刷新率下优于随机时序，甚至在更高的刷新率下优于周期性时序（2.0-5.0 个点）。在预先注册的视频描述中，样本之间的漂移是均匀的，RCR 在 Qwen2-VL 上与 InfiniGen 相当，在 Qwen3-VL 上超过它，但在最近的测试速率下不再超过固定阈值，与诊断一致；对象级评估表明，在三个模型中的两个上，RCR 在未压缩输出上实现了比 InfiniGen 更高的对象 F1。

papers.title: ValuSpec: Plug-and-Play Candidate Valuation before Target Verification for Tree-Based Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Tree-based speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by verifying multiple candidate branches in parallel. However, in practical serving scenarios, similar requests repeatedly induce overlapping candidate branches. While retrieval-based methods mitigate this by reusing historical drafts, the resulting candidate trees often contain many low-quality branches as the candidate tree grows, which reduces verification efficiency and wastes target-side computation. To address this, we propose ValuSpec, a plug-and-play candidate valuation mechanism that filters low-quality branches from a supplied candidate tree before expensive target-side verification. ValuSpec introduces transfer-based supervision to align filtering with the target model's behavior. A filtering threshold is estimated from the target model's greedy trajectories on a calibration split, without any parameter training. The target model then verifies the filtered tree under the output-identical greedy rule, so accepted tokens are guaranteed to match standard autoregressive decoding exactly. Experimental results on HumanEval, GSM8K, Dolly, and SpecBench show that, in our main evaluation, ValuSpec achieves up to 2.38x end-to-end speedup in retrieval-based tree settings. Furthermore, integrating ValuSpec into the EAGLE-3 dynamic tree framework yields up to 2.78x end-to-end speedup without modifying its tree construction strategy, demonstrating that ValuSpec serves as a generally applicable and plug-and-play candidate valuation module.

papers.title_zh: ValuSpec：基于树的推测解码的目标验证之前的即插即用候选者评估
papers.summary_zh: 基于树的推测解码通过并行验证多个候选分支来加速大型语言模型推理。然而，在实际的服务场景中，相似的请求重复导致候选分支重叠。虽然基于检索的方法通过重用历史草稿来缓解这一问题，但随着候选树的增长，生成的候选树通常包含许多低质量的分支，这降低了验证效率并浪费了目标端计算。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 ValuSpec，一种即插即用的候选评估机制，可以在昂贵的目标端验证之前从提供的候选树中过滤掉低质量的分支。 ValuSpec 引入了基于传输的监督，使过滤与目标模型的行为保持一致。过滤阈值是根据目标模型在校准分割上的贪婪轨迹来估计的，无需任何参数训练。然后，目标模型根据输出相同的贪婪规则验证过滤后的树，因此保证接受的标记与标准自回归解码完全匹配。 HumanEval、GSM8K、Dolly 和 SpecBench 上的实验结果表明，在我们的主要评估中，ValuSpec 在基于检索的树设置中实现了高达 2.38 倍的端到端加速。此外，将 ValuSpec 集成到 EAGLE-3 动态树框架中，无需修改其树构建策略即可实现高达 2.78 倍的端到端加速，这表明 ValuSpec 作为普遍适用且即插即用的候选评估模块。

papers.title: RIFT: KV Cache Compression for Draft Models with Complementary Compressibility Training
papers.summary: Speculative decoding is a popular decode acceleration method. As such, it is particularly relevant to long-output generation, which requires an increasingly large KV cache. KV cache compression offers a way to constrain costs in long-context drafting. However, compression methods that focus on prefill information can lose relevance as the output length grows. We term this phenomenon decode staleness and show that it degrades draft model accuracy under selection-based KV cache compression. We introduce RIFT, a family of selection-based KV cache compression strategies that balance prefill information and recent generated tokens. We show that refreshing the KV cache selection during token generation significantly improves the drafter's quality at the cost of additional decode latency. To alleviate the refresh costs, we propose an adaptive KV refresh strategy that reduces the number of score calculations while retaining the drafter's quality. We further demonstrate how a compressibility-driven drafter training phase, based on sparse attention masks, can improve the drafter's quality under a compressed KV cache. Combined with compressibility training, RIFT enables Qwen3.5-4B, drafting for Qwen3.5-122B, to retain over 98% of its full-cache acceptance length on 32K-token inputs, 4K-token outputs, and an 8K-token KV cache budget.

cons: 摘要未体现充分的计算开销—收益曲线、广泛基线与统计显著性，严谨性仍待验证

papers.title_zh: RIFT：具有互补压缩性训练的草稿模型的 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 推测解码是一种流行的解码加速方法。因此，它与长输出生成特别相关，这需要越来越大的 KV 缓存。 KV 缓存压缩提供了一种限制长上下文绘图成本的方法。然而，随着输出长度的增长，专注于预填充信息的压缩方法可能会失去相关性。我们将这种现象称为解码陈旧，并表明它会在基于选择的 KV 缓存压缩下降低草稿模型的准确性。我们介绍 RIFT，这是一系列基于选择的 KV 缓存压缩策略，可以平衡预填充信息和最近生成的令牌。我们表明，在令牌生成期间刷新 KV 缓存选择可以显着提高起草者的质量，但代价是额外的解码延迟。为了减轻刷新成本，我们提出了一种自适应 KV 刷新策略，可以减少分数计算次数，同时保留绘图员的质量。我们进一步演示了基于稀疏注意力掩模的压缩性驱动的绘图员训练阶段如何在压缩的 KV 缓存下提高绘图员的质量。与压缩性训练相结合，RIFT 使 Qwen3.5-4B（为 Qwen3.5-122B 起草）能够在 32K 令牌输入、4K 令牌输出和 8K 令牌 KV 缓存预算上保留超过 98% 的全缓存接受长度。

papers.title: Low-Latency MoE Inference in Space Data Centers: A Wireless-Power-Transfer Perspective
papers.summary: Space data centers (SpaceDCs) are emerging as platforms for large language models (LLMs), supported by continuous solar-energy harvesting and high-speed interconnections. The mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture supports distributed LLM inference by deploying experts across satellites. However, skewed expert activation creates uneven computation power demands despite uniform solar-power supply at the dawn-dusk sun-synchronous orbit (SSO). Consequently, active experts remain power-constrained while harvested power at idle experts is underused. These reduce inference efficiency and increase latency. To address this supply-demand mismatch, we propose the SpaceWPT framework, which uses inter-satellite laser-based wireless power transfer (WPT) to redistribute harvested power. The key design challenge is to balance the computation demands of power-donating and power-receiving satellites under WPT losses: transferring more power accelerates computation at the receiver but leaves less power for the donor. After deriving design principles that simplify WPT control, we characterize the resulting latency tradeoff through a tractable surrogate of average inference latency. Minimizing the surrogate yields a novel two-sided water-filling strategy that determines whether each active expert donates, retains, or receives power according to the water level and its WPT link efficiency. Simulations with Mixtral-8x7B and Phi-3.5-MoE show up to 29.25% lower inference latency than without WPT, with larger gains under more compact formations and higher transfer efficiencies.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，但证据链仍偏仿真化。
pros: 将MoE推理负载偏斜与轨道供电错配统一建模，问题设定新颖且具体
提出可解释的双侧注水策略，方法结构清晰并具工程直觉
cons: 仅基于仿真与代理目标，缺少端到端系统原型和真实链路验证
对激光WPT安全性、指向误差、控制开销与可靠性讨论不足

papers.title_zh: 空间数据中心中的低延迟 MoE 推理：无线功率传输视角
papers.summary_zh: 空间数据中心 (SpaceDC) 正在成为大型语言模型 (LLM) 的平台，并得到持续的太阳能收集和高速互连的支持。专家混合 (MoE) 架构通过跨卫星部署专家来支持分布式 LLM 推理。然而，尽管黎明-黄昏太阳同步轨道（SSO）上的太阳能供电是均匀的，但不平衡的专家激活会产生不均匀的计算能力需求。因此，活跃专家的功率仍然受到限制，而闲置专家收集的功率却未得到充分利用。这些会降低推理效率并增加延迟。为了解决这种供需不匹配的问题，我们提出了 SpaceWPT 框架，该框架使用卫星间基于激光的无线功率传输（WPT）来重新分配所收集的功率。关键的设计挑战是在 WPT 损耗下平衡供电卫星和受电卫星的计算需求：传输更多的功率可以加速接收器的计算，但留给捐赠者的功率更少。在推导出简化 WPT 控制的设计原则后，我们通过平均推理延迟的易处理替代品来描述由此产生的延迟权衡。最小化代理产生了一种新颖的两侧注水策略，该策略根据水位及其 WPT 链路效率确定每个活跃专家是否捐赠、保留或接收电力。使用 Mixtral-8x7B 和 Phi-3.5-MoE 进行的模拟显示，与没有 WPT 的情况相比，推理延迟降低了 29.25%，在更紧凑的阵型和更高的传输效率下获得了更大的增益。

papers.title: Amplifying Latency and Cost of LLM Inference via Rowhammer Attack
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high inference efficiency using optimized GPU kernels generated by just-in-time (JIT) compilation frameworks such as Triton. Triton compiles GPU kernels through an MLIR/LLVM-based pipeline. We investigate whether a Rowhammer-induced bit-flip in the CPU's DRAM can degrade GPU-based LLM inference performance while preserving output correctness. We present LLVMhammer, the first Rowhammer attack that causes LLM inference slowdown by inducing a bit-flip in Triton's compilation pipeline. A bit-flip in a performance-critical optimization pass causes Triton to generate a functionally identical but suboptimal GPU kernel. Since Triton caches the generated kernel on disk, a single successful bit-flip causes persistent slowdown across subsequent inference executions. Triton's target-independent stages are shared across GPU vendors, which makes our attack GPU vendor-agnostic. To identify exploitable bit-flip locations without manual inspection, we build Karnage, a tool that isolates useful bit-flip locations in Triton's target-independent compilation pipeline. We evaluate LLVMHammer across a diverse set of LLMs, including Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Deepseek-llm-7B-chat, across NVIDIA RTX 4090 and AMD RX 7900 XTX GPUs. LLVMhammer increases inference latency of an LLM inference server running on a single GPU by 4-16\%, which, in turn, can translate into additional annual operating costs at the scale of multi-GPU deployments. We further show that LLVMhammer can also corrupt LLM outputs across different GPU vendors, reducing BERTScore to as low as 25\%, illustrating the broader security implications of bit-flips in Triton's compilation pipeline.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题新颖且实用，但证据链仍需加强。
pros: 首次将Rowhammer与Triton编译链路结合，提出可持续生效的降速攻击视角
跨模型与跨GPU厂商实验设计有代表性，兼顾性能与正确性破坏影响
cons: 摘要未充分量化攻击成功率、触发条件与现实威胁门槛，4–16%降速的普适性与统计稳健性仍存疑

papers.title_zh: 通过 Rowhammer 攻击放大 LLM 推理的延迟和成本
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 使用 Triton 等即时 (JIT) 编译框架生成的优化 GPU 内核实现高推理效率。 Triton 通过基于 MLIR/LLVM 的管道编译 GPU 内核。我们研究了 CPU DRAM 中由 Rowhammer 引起的位翻转是否会降低基于 GPU 的 LLM 推理性能，同时保持输出正确性。我们提出了 LLVMhammer，这是第一个 Rowhammer 攻击，它通过在 Triton 编译管道中引发位翻转来导致 LLM 推理速度减慢。性能关键优化过程中的位翻转会导致 Triton 生成功能相同但次优的 GPU 内核。由于 Triton 将生成的内核缓存在磁盘上，因此一次成功的位翻转会导致后续推理执行持续缓慢。 Triton 的目标无关阶段在 GPU 供应商之间共享，这使得我们的攻击与 GPU 供应商无关。为了在无需手动检查的情况下识别可利用的位翻转位置，我们构建了 Karnage，这是一个在 Triton 的目标无关编译管道中隔离有用的位翻转位置的工具。我们跨不同的 LLM 集（包括 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 和 Deepseek-llm-7B-chat）以及 NVIDIA RTX 4090 和 AMD RX 7900 XTX GPU 评估 LLVMHammer。 LLVMhammer 使在单个 GPU 上运行的 LLM 推理服务器的推理延迟增加了 4-16%，这反过来又可以转化为多 GPU 部署规模的额外年度运营成本。我们进一步表明，LLVMhammer 还可以破坏不同 GPU 供应商的 LLM 输出，将 BERTScore 降低至低至 25%，说明 Triton 编译管道中位翻转的更广泛的安全影响。

papers.title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
papers.summary: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months. To improve SSD lifetime, a natural solution is to reduce the KV cache writes by gating the KV cache writes via historical access patterns. However, that significantly lowers the KV cache hit rate (and increase the LLM serving cost) since KV caches from different attention types might have identical historical access pattern but different future access patterns. Our insight is that, to reduce KV cache writes without hurting KV cache hit rate, one need to not only consider the access pattern, but also application-level information such as the attention type of KV cache. Leveraging this observation, we propose Gandalf , the first SSD KV cache offloading system with SSD life time awareness. Gandalf prioritize the admission of full-attention KV cache into SSD over the cache generated by other types of attention, which significantly increases SSD lifetime without sacrificing cache hit rate. Our evaluation shows that Gandalf extends the SSD lifetime by 7.3X on average, while having negligible impact on cache hit rate across multiple workload traces and wide range of hardware capacity. Gandalf design can be extended to other flash-based storage, such as High Bandwidth Flash (HBF).

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、思路实用，但方法新颖性与证据深度一般。
pros: 聚焦SSD寿命这一LLM服务落地痛点，工程价值明确
利用注意力类型做写入准入，兼顾寿命提升与命中率目标
cons: 核心机制偏启发式，理论分析与最优性论证不足
摘要未说明在线开销、误判代价及极端负载稳定性

papers.title_zh: 甘道夫：闪电侠不死！延长 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存卸载的闪存存储寿命
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存降低了大型语言模型 (LLM) 的服务成本，但不断增长的 KV 缓存占用空间日益超出 GPU 和主机内存容量。因此，人们使用SSD来扩展具有高I/O带宽的KV缓存存储容量。然而，在生产LLM工作负载中，例如多轮对话和LLM代理，KV缓存写入总量显着超过SSD容量，导致SSD寿命从几年缩短到几个月。为了延长 SSD 的使用寿命，一个自然的解决方案是通过历史访问模式来门控 KV 缓存写入，从而减少 KV 缓存写入。然而，这显着降低了 KV 缓存命中率（并增加了 LLM 服务成本），因为来自不同注意力类型的 KV 缓存可能具有相同的历史访问模式，但未来的访问模式不同。我们的见解是，为了在不影响 KV 缓存命中率的情况下减少 KV 缓存写入，不仅需要考虑访问模式，还需要考虑应用程序级信息，例如 KV 缓存的注意力类型。利用这一观察结果，我们提出了 Gandalf，这是第一个具有 SSD 生命周期感知功能的 SSD KV 缓存卸载系统。 Gandalf 优先考虑将全注意力 KV 缓存接纳到 SSD，而不是其他类型的注意力生成的缓存，这在不牺牲缓存命中率的情况下显着延长了 SSD 的寿命。我们的评估表明，Gandalf 将 SSD 寿命平均延长了 7.3 倍，同时对跨多个工作负载跟踪和各种硬件容量的缓存命中率的影响可以忽略不计。 Gandalf 设计可以扩展到其他基于闪存的存储，例如高带宽闪存 (HBF)。

papers.title: Speculative Acceptance Does Not Decay with Position: A Full-Length Diagnostic on Long Chain-of-Thought with Independent Drafts
papers.summary: The claim that speculative-decoding acceptance rate decays as a chain-of-thought grows longer has become a de facto industry narrative, motivating draft-model co-design and position-aware training. Nearly all direct evidence comes from trained drafters whose offline training length is far shorter than inference, so a purely positional law has never been isolated. We present the first systematic, full-length measurement of acceptance rate as a function of generation position on MATH-500 (all 500 problems), under greedy and sampling decoding, with two independent drafts against DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B: a same-family draft (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) and a cross-family draft (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct), yielding about 1.78M verification rounds. Using within-problem paired tests, we find that after isolating a greedy-decoding repetition pathology, acceptance rate does not decay with position in any of the four configurations within the supported ranges (greedy 0-8K, sampling 0-12K); the second half of each trajectory is slightly but significantly higher than the first. A controlled temperature sweep shows that the apparent sampling-mode degradation of high-entropy reflection tokens is a visibility artifact of argmax agreement, not a drop in expected acceptance probability. Rejections concentrate with high precision on reflection trigger tokens such as "wait", "however" and "check", an entropy-selective failure that a lightweight three-arm LoRA trajectory-alignment intervention (uniform, reflection-marked, entropy-weighted) fails to improve in mean accepted length. We thus supply the positional baseline that independent draft-target pairs were missing, and localize the residual failure to decision-point entropy rather than position.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 实验扎实、结论有冲击，但外推边界仍需补强。
pros: 首次在全长CoT上系统隔离并检验“位置衰减”假说，问题定义清晰
样本规模与统计设计强（全量MATH-500、配对检验、温度控制），并给出可操作失效定位
cons: 结论主要基于单一target与两种1.5B draft及MATH域，跨模型族与跨任务泛化仍不足
“可见性伪象”与“熵主导失败”虽有证据，但机制层解释与替代干预仍偏初步

papers.title_zh: 投机性接受不会随立场而衰减：对独立草案的长思想链的全面诊断
papers.summary_zh: 随着思想链变长，推测解码接受率会下降的说法已成为事实上的行业叙述，激励了草稿模型协同设计和位置感知培训。几乎所有的直接证据都来自训练有素的起草者，他们的离线训练时间远短于推理，因此纯粹的位置法则从来都不是孤立的。我们提出了第一个系统的、完整的接受率测量，作为 MATH-500（所有 500 个问题）上生成位置的函数，在贪婪和采样解码下，针对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 提出了两个独立草案：同族草案 (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) 和跨族草案 (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct)，产生约178 万轮验证。使用问题内配对测试，我们发现在隔离贪婪解码重复病理学之后，接受率不会随着支持范围内的四种配置中的任何位置而衰减（贪婪 0-8K，采样 0-12K）；每个轨迹的后半部分略高于前半部分，但明显较高。受控温度扫描表明，高熵反射令牌的明显采样模式退化是 argmax 协议的可见性伪影，而不是预期接受概率的下降。拒绝高精度地集中在反射触发标记上，例如“等待”、“但是”和“检查”，这是一种熵选择性故障，轻量级三臂 LoRA 轨迹对准干预（均匀、反射标记、熵加权）无法改善平均接受长度。因此，我们提供了独立草稿-目标对缺失的位置基线，并将剩余失败定位于决策点熵而不是位置。

papers.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
papers.summary: Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and all-step baselines at substantially lower cost. These results demonstrate that selective candidate sampling and lightweight verification provide complementary gains in coding-agent performance and inference efficiency. Our model, code, and data are available at https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 实用价值明确，但创新与实证深度中等。
pros: 提出按需触发验证，显著降低全步验证开销
跨两类基座模型有一致增益，展示一定泛化能力
cons: 绝对提升幅度较小且评测范围偏窄，缺少更强基线与统计显著性分析

papers.title_zh: SWE-VERIFIER：经济高效的编码代理的选择性验证
papers.summary_zh: 编码代理花费大量计算来生成动作并处理长交互历史。糟糕的操作选择可能会引导代理进入低价值状态，浪费计算并增加 API 成本。对替代操作进行采样和验证可以改善代理的决策，但在每个步骤中应用此过程会增加大量开销。我们引入了 SWE-Verifier，这是一种轻量级生成模型，可以选择性地触发候选采样和验证。它对编码代理建议的操作进行评分，以确定何时需要额外的候选采样，然后在执行之前对结果操作进行排名。我们使用偏好数据从 Qwen3.5-4B 训练 SWE-Verifier，这些偏好数据将对比行为与其结果环境观察和评分标准引导的教师分数进行分组。使用 mini-swe-agent 工具，SWE-Verifier 以 1.09 倍的成本将 MiniMax-M2.7 上的分辨率从 75.47% 提高到 77.20%，并在没有对其动作进行训练的情况下推广到 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，以 1.13 倍的成本将分辨率从 72.60% 提高到 74.27%。在这两种模型中，SWE-Verifier 验证了不到 4% 的步骤，并以低得多的成本实现了与轨迹和全步骤基线相当或更高的分辨率。这些结果表明，选择性候选采样和轻量级验证在编码代理性能和推理效率方面提供了互补的增益。我们的模型、代码和数据可在 https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier 获取。

papers.title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. Recently, selective looping, which recursively applies a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step, has been shown to improve training efficiency in MDLMs under an iso-FLOP budget. We investigate looping in UDLMs while keeping the training objective and sampler unchanged. We find that looping significantly improves training efficiency: looped UDLMs reach the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens with up to 2.8x fewer training FLOPs on OpenWebText and 3.3x fewer on FineWeb-Edu. We also find that, at a matched NFE budget, looped UDLMs reach up to 9.8% lower generation perplexity than the non-looped UDLM, with most gains achieved at moderate loop counts. Finally, we study different loop-count distributions and find that sampling smaller loop counts more frequently during training improves inference efficiency: on downstream tasks, this strategy uses 12% fewer loops than uniform loop-count sampling without degrading accuracy.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 实用增量改进明显，但方法创新有限
pros: 在不改训练目标与采样器前提下显著降训练FLOPs，效率收益清晰
同时报告NLL、生成困惑度与下游推理开销，评估维度较完整
cons: 核心思想主要是将既有selective looping迁移到UDLM，方法新颖性偏弱
摘要未体现统计显著性、方差与多规模复现实验，结论稳健性仍待验证

papers.title_zh: 循环一致扩散语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 统一扩散语言模型（UDLM）通过迭代地对普通词汇标记序列进行去噪来生成文本，其中任何一个都可能被损坏并随后进行修改。在训练期间，UDLM 必须从本身可能不可靠的上下文中进行去噪，而掩码扩散语言模型 (MDLM) 始终以干净的上下文为条件。这种具有挑战性的训练目标使得 UDLM 的训练比 MDLM 更加密集，但它会产生更强的下游推理性能。最近，选择性循环（在每个去噪步骤中递归地应用一些早期 Transformer 层）已被证明可以在 iso-FLOP 预算下提高 MDLM 的训练效率。我们研究 UDLM 中的循环，同时保持训练目标和采样器不变。我们发现循环显着提高了训练效率：循环 UDLM 达到了在约 5 万亿个令牌上训练的非循环 UDLM 的验证 NLL，并且 OpenWebText 上的训练 FLOP 减少了 2.8 倍，FineWeb-Edu 上的训练 FLOP 减少了 3.3 倍。我们还发现，在匹配的 NFE 预算下，循环 UDLM 的生成困惑度比非循环 UDLM 降低了 9.8%，并且大部分增益是在适度的循环计数下实现的。最后，我们研究了不同的循环计数分布，发现在训练期间更频繁地采样较小的循环计数可以提高推理效率：在下游任务中，该策略比统一循环计数采样少使用 12% 的循环，而不会降低准确性。

papers.title: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance and efficiency. However, realizing such heterogeneous integration is challenging because LLM phase disaggregation requires KV cache transfer from prefill to decode (that is, from GPUs to NPUs), which is complicated by differences in inter-device communication mechanisms and KV cache tensor layouts. To address this, we propose HAWK, a transfer mechanism that enables rapid KV cache transfer across heterogeneous devices. HAWK establishes a remote direct memory access (RDMA) path for direct cross-device transfers while handling inter-device tensor layout discrepancies as part of the transfer process. In particular, HAWK allocates tensor-layout-aware RDMA buffers on the NPU side to match the target tensor layout. Leveraging these buffers, HAWK orchestrates data transfer from a conventional contiguous GPU RDMA buffer to the corresponding NPU buffers, allowing transferred tensors to be consumed directly without additional data rearrangement while maintaining transfer efficiency. We implement and evaluate HAWK on a system built with commercially available GPUs and NPUs, demonstrating performance within 7.88% of a GPU-only system under the same SLO constraints while achieving up to 1.26$\times$ higher power efficiency and 1.72$\times$ higher cost efficiency.

papers.title_zh: HAWK：异构感知 KV 缓存传输，用于高效 GPU-NPU 阶段分解 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理在其两个阶段中表现出不同的计算特征：预填充是计算密集型的，而解码则更受内存限制。因此，人工智能加速器在这两个阶段实现了不同水平的效率。 GPU 非常适合预填充，但在解码过程中常常未得到充分利用。相比之下，NPU 在解码过程中可以更有效地利用其计算资源。受此观察的启发，我们探索了一种集成 GPU 和 NPU 的异构架构，将预填充映射到 GPU，解码到 NPU，以实现高性能和高效率。然而，实现这种异构集成具有挑战性，因为LLM阶段分解需要KV缓存从预填充到解码（即从GPU到NPU）的传输，而设备间通信机制和KV缓存张量布局的差异使这变得复杂。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了HAWK，一种能够跨异构设备快速KV缓存传输的传输机制。 HAWK 为直接跨设备传输建立远程直接内存访问 (RDMA) 路径，同时作为传输过程的一部分处理设备间张量布局差异。特别是，HAWK 在 NPU 侧分配张量布局感知 RDMA 缓冲区以匹配目标张量布局。利用这些缓冲区，HAWK 协调从传统连续 GPU RDMA 缓冲区到相应 NPU 缓冲区的数据传输，允许直接使用传输的张量，无需额外的数据重新排列，同时保持传输效率。我们在使用商用 GPU 和 NPU 构建的系统上实现并评估了 HAWK，在相同的 SLO 约束下，性能比仅使用 GPU 的系统低 7.88%，同时实现高达 1.26$\times$ 的功效提升和 1.72$\times$ 的成本效率提升。

papers.title: UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving
papers.summary: Long contexts increase the memory cost of the key-value (KV) cache in large language model (LLM) inference. Sparse attention reduces attention computation and memory traffic by selecting historical tokens, but the retained KV cache must remain available for later decoding steps. We present UlaCache, a KV cache management system built around a unified logical address space spanning GPU KV pools and optional CPU memory. Stable logical references let the inference engine allocate and select KV independently of physical placement. Common allocation and sparse-access interfaces support data-parallel (DP) and tensor-parallel (TP) attention. For distributed storage, local GPU buffers retain selected KV across decoding steps, so only missing entries require transfers. When CPU storage is enabled, Parallel Bucketed LRU (PB-LRU) manages a GPU pool shared across requests. It updates recency metadata and selects eviction victims in parallel. UlaCache transfers KV and then updates the address mappings. With speculative decoding enabled under matched CPU and GPU memory budgets, UlaCache achieves peak decoding throughput speedups of 1.16 $\times$ (DP) and 1.70 $\times$ (TP) on H200, and 1.73 $\times$ (DP) and 2.51 $\times$ (TP) on B300, compared with the state-of-the-art baseline.

papers.title_zh: UlaCache：稀疏 LLM 服务的统一逻辑寻址
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文会增加大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理中键值 (KV) 缓存的内存成本。稀疏注意力通过选择历史标记来减少注意力计算和内存流量，但保留的 KV 缓存必须保持可用于后续解码步骤。我们推出了 UlaCache，这是一个 KV 缓存管理系统，围绕跨越 GPU KV 池和可选 CPU 内存的统一逻辑地址空间构建。稳定的逻辑引用让推理引擎能够独立于物理布局来分配和选择 KV。通用分配和稀疏访问接口支持数据并行（DP）和张量并行（TP）注意力。对于分布式存储，本地 GPU 缓冲区会在解码步骤中保留选定的 KV，因此只有丢失的条目才需要传输。启用 CPU 存储后，并行存储 LRU (PB-LRU) 管理跨请求共享的 GPU 池。它会并行更新近期元数据并选择驱逐受害者。 UlaCache传输KV，然后更新地址映射。与最先进的基准相比，在匹配的 CPU 和 GPU 内存预算下启用推测解码后，UlaCache 在 H200 上实现了 1.16 $\times$ (DP) 和 1.70 $\times$ (TP) 的峰值解码吞吐量加速，在 B300 上实现了 1.73 $\times$ (DP) 和 2.51 $\times$ (TP) 的峰值解码吞吐量加速。

papers.title: MoEZip: Routing-Aware KV Cache Compression for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity efficiently by activating a small subset of parameters per token. However, in long-context inference, memory remains a major bottleneck because the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce this cost for dense transformers, but overlook a problem specific to MoE: KV eviction can change which experts are selected during answer generation, degrading the generation quality. We propose MoEZip, a routing-aware KV cache compression for sparse MoE language models. To estimate the sensitivity of expert routing to perturbation, we propose a novel metric based on the Fisher information matrix of routing distributions. MoEZip combines this metric with attention weights for routing-aware scoring of contexts. Finally, we compose a complementary scoring system that combines eviction methods for dense and sparse-MoE architectures. Experiments show that MoEZip achieves robust performance under aggressive cache compression on various benchmarks. At a KV retention ratio of 10\%, MoEZip improves over the SoTA baseline by +24 and +20 points on average on LongBench and RULER, corresponding to 2.3$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ higher scores, respectively.
papers.comment: Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026, Accepted

papers.title_zh: MoEZip：用于稀疏专家混合 LLM 的路由感知 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 专家混合 (MoE) 语言模型通过激活每个令牌的一小部分参数来有效扩展模型容量。然而，在长上下文推理中，内存仍然是一个主要瓶颈，因为 KV 缓存随着序列长度线性增长。现有的 KV 缓存压缩方法降低了密集变压器的成本，但忽略了 MoE 特有的问题：KV 驱逐可能会改变在答案生成过程中选择的专家，从而降低生成质量。我们提出了 MoEZip，一种用于稀疏 MoE 语言模型的路由感知 KV 缓存压缩。为了估计专家路由对扰动的敏感性，我们提出了一种基于路由分布的 Fisher 信息矩阵的新度量。 MoEZip 将此指标与注意力权重相结合，用于上下文的路由感知评分。最后，我们构建了一个互补的评分系统，结合了密集和稀疏 MoE 架构的驱逐方法。实验表明，MoEZip 在各种基准测试中，在积极的缓存压缩下实现了稳健的性能。在 KV 保留率为 10\% 时，MoEZip 在 LongBench 和 RULER 上比 SoTA 基线平均提高了 +24 和 +20 分，分别相当于高出 2.3$\times$ 和 4.9$\times$ 分数。

papers.title: RISK-KV: Quality-Aware Selective KV Cache Reconstruction for Distributed LLM Inference
papers.summary: Request migration and interruption recovery in distributed large language model (LLM) inference rely on historical key-value (KV) caches. Retaining or transferring a complete cache incurs substantial state overhead, whereas replaying historical tokens requires additional computation. This paper proposes RISK-KV, a quality-aware method for selective historical KV reconstruction in pretrained models. RISK-KV uses exact KV states on both sides of a target layer and cross-layer ridge regression to predict the missing layer's attention-projection input; it then folds in the original model's KV projection matrices to reduce predictor storage. Reconstruction risk is measured by the change in negative log-likelihood (NLL) caused by actual reconstruction, and low-overhead topology search with quality gating selects the layer groups to reconstruct. Independent tests on three language models show that representative recovery configurations omit 18.2 percent to 33.3 percent of historical KV, with perplexity changes below 0.5 percent. In a local request-recovery experiment with a 512-token history, RISK-KV achieves a 1.51 to 3.31 times speedup over full Token Replay. These results indicate that selective KV reconstruction can reduce historical cache overhead with small changes in predictive quality and improve request-recovery efficiency under the evaluated deployment conditions.

papers.title_zh: RISK-KV：用于分布式 LLM 推理的质量感知选择性 KV 缓存重建
papers.summary_zh: 分布式大语言模型（LLM）推理中的请求迁移和中断恢复依赖于历史键值（KV）缓存。保留或传输完整的缓存会产生大量的状态开销，而重放历史令牌则需要额外的计算。本文提出了 RISK-KV，一种用于在预训练模型中选择性重建历史 KV 的质量感知方法。 RISK-KV 使用目标层两侧的精确 KV 状态和跨层岭回归来预测缺失层的注意力投影输入；然后折叠原始模型的 KV 投影矩阵以减少预测变量存储。重建风险通过实际重建引起的负对数似然（NLL）的变化来衡量，并且具有质量门控的低开销拓扑搜索选择要重建的层组。对三种语言模型的独立测试表明，代表性的恢复配置忽略了 18.2% 到 33.3% 的历史 KV，而困惑度变化低于 0.5%。在具有 512 个令牌历史记录的本地请求恢复实验中，RISK-KV 比完整令牌重放实现了 1.51 至 3.31 倍的加速。这些结果表明，选择性 KV 重建可以在预测质量发生微小变化的情况下减少历史缓存开销，并在评估的部署条件下提高请求恢复效率。

papers.title: RCSD: Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Domain-Specific Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.

papers.title_zh: RCSD：特定领域推测解码的强化和持续学习
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过采用紧凑的草稿模型来提出由目标模型并行验证的候选标记，从而加速大型语言模型推理。传统的训练依赖于软标签蒸馏，这迫使草稿模型模仿目标的完整输出分布，包括降低接受率并增加早期拒绝风险的高熵区域。我们提出了 RCSD（推测解码的强化和持续学习），这是一种训练框架，它将草稿模型优化与最大化接受长度的系统级目标结合起来。 RCSD 在推测推理过程中利用自然发生的接受和拒绝序列来构建隐式偏好对，并使用掩蔽损失来避免惩罚目标对齐标记。经过多个基准评估，RCSD 的平均接受长度比 HASS 提高了 35%，并且在实际工作负载上实现的端到端推理速度比 HASS 快 1.35 倍，而不会影响生成质量。

papers.title: Reorienting the Vector Axis: Restructuring FlashAttention for Long-Vector Processors
papers.summary: A Transformer is built around attention, whose cost grows with the square of the sequence length and dominates the layer on long sequences. FlashAttention made that cost manageable by tiling the attention matrix and updating the softmax as it goes, but almost all work since has targeted GPUs. On long-vector processors one vector register can hold up to 512 single-precision numbers. The savings of a vector instruction are proportional to how much of the register it uses, so the choice of which loop to vectorize is a first-order decision. We port PyTorch's CPU FlashAttention kernel to a RISC-V CPU with 2KB vector registers and find that it reaches 16.2% of peak floating-point throughput. The kernel walks each tile one query row at a time: the product against V is vectorized along the 64-element head dimension, the softmax's per-row maximum and sum are reductions that collapse a full register to a scalar, and the software exponential's polynomial coefficients compete with tile data for vector registers and cause spilling. We propose two techniques. The first transposes the score tile and the running output so that queries lie along the contiguous axis. The algorithm and its values are unchanged. A single parameter, the number of queries in a tile, now sets the vector length of every part of the kernel and can be matched to the machine. Both reductions also disappear. The second moves the polynomial's coefficients into scalar registers, removing the spills and cutting the softmax's vector memory instructions by 78.7%. On silicon the two together cut whole-kernel cycles by 1.84 to 2.08x at a head dimension of 64, raising floating-point utilization from 16.2% to 29.7% of peak. An FPGA of the same design ranks the changes identically and scores them higher, at 2.71x.

papers.title_zh: 重新定向向量轴：为长向量处理器重构 FlashAttention
papers.summary_zh: Transformer 是围绕注意力构建的，其成本随着序列长度的平方而增长，并在长序列上占主导地位。 FlashAttention 通过平铺注意力矩阵并更新 softmax 来控制成本，但此后几乎所有工作都针对 GPU。在长向量处理器上，一个向量寄存器最多可以保存 512 个单精度数字。向量指令的节省与其使用的寄存器量成正比，因此选择要向量化的循环是一阶决策。我们将 PyTorch 的 CPU FlashAttention 内核移植到具有 2KB 向量寄存器的 RISC-V CPU 上，发现它达到了峰值浮点吞吐量的 16.2%。内核一次遍历每个图块一个查询行：V 的乘积沿 64 元素头维度进行矢量化，softmax 的每行最大值和总和是将完整寄存器折叠为标量的缩减，并且软件指数的多项式系数与矢量寄存器的图块数据竞争并导致溢出。我们提出两种技术。第一个转置分数图块和运行输出，以便查询位于连续轴上。算法及其值保持不变。现在，单个参数（图块中的查询数量）设置了内核每个部分的向量长度，并且可以与机器匹配。两种减少也会消失。第二个将多项式的系数移入标量寄存器，消除溢出并将 softmax 的向量内存指令减少 78.7%。在硅片上，两者共同将头部尺寸为 64 时的整个内核周期缩短了 1.84 至 2.08 倍，将浮点利用率从峰值的 16.2% 提高至 29.7%。相同设计的 FPGA 对这些变化进行相同的排名，并且得分更高，为 2.71 倍。

papers.title: Double KV Cache Optimization on Apple Silicon: Block-FP4, Radial Quantization, and Fused Metal Kernels
papers.summary: Key-value (KV) cache capacity and memory traffic are primary bottlenecks in long-context autoregressive inference. We evaluate five cache paths on an Apple Silicon M5 Max using MLX: a native bf16 baseline, block-scaled E2M1 FP4, a Python reference implementing radial quantization with a QJL-style residual, sequential FP4-to-Polar composition, and a fused Metal Polar kernel. On Apple Silicon M5 Max, fused Metal PolarQuant achieves 46.8 tok/s at 3,456 B/token - 3.64x compression versus the bf16 baseline and 1.84x faster than the Python Polar reference (25.4 tok/s), while slightly outperforming block-FP4 (41.5 tok/s at 3.62x compression). Sequential composition of FP4 and Polar (Double Optimization) yields no additive benefit: 4,241 B/token at 15.1 tok/s, worse than FP4 alone on both axes. The fused path establishes that radial coding can be competitive when packing, rotation, and reconstruction are placed in one device kernel, but this result does not extend to longer contexts. At 32K and above, all compressed variants collapse to 1.5-14 tok/s because the current attention path repeatedly reconstructs the full cache, retaining cumulative O(N^2) decode work. At 64K, the Metal variant runs out of memory when a 33.5 GB allocation exceeds MLX's 22.6 GB Metal buffer limit. Fused scaled dot-product attention operating directly on compressed KV, together with chunked pre-allocation, is required for long-context viability. These results separate representation-level compression from kernel and allocator effects and identify the conditions under which low-bit KV caching helps on unified memory hardware.

pros: 对五条KV缓存路径做了同平台可比实验，结论边界清晰
揭示了表示压缩与内核/分配器瓶颈的解耦关系，具实用诊断价值
cons: 核心收益主要来自fused内核实现而非双重量化本身，长上下文下仍因O(N^2)重构与内存上限失效

papers.title_zh: Apple Silicon 上的双 KV 缓存优化：Block-FP4、径向量化和熔合金属内核
papers.summary_zh: 键值 (KV) 缓存容量和内存流量是长上下文自回归推理的主要瓶颈。我们使用 MLX 评估 Apple Silicon M5 Max 上的五个缓存路径：原生 bf16 基线、块缩放 E2M1 FP4、使用 QJL 式残差实现径向量化的 Python 参考、顺序 FP4 到 Polar 组合以及融合的 Metal Polar 内核。在 Apple Silicon M5 Max 上，融合金属 PolarQuant 在 3,456 B/token 下实现了 46.8 tok/s - 与 bf16 基线相比，压缩率为 3.64 倍，比 Python Polar 参考（25.4 tok/s）快 1.84 倍，同时略优于 block-FP4（3.62 倍压缩时为 41.5 tok/s）。 FP4 和 Polar（双重优化）的顺序组合不会产生额外的好处：15.1 tok/s 时为 4,241 B/token，在两个轴上都比单独的 FP4 差。融合路径表明，当打包、旋转和重构被放置在一个设备内核中时，径向编码可以具有竞争力，但这一结果并不能扩展到更长的上下文。在 32K 及以上，所有压缩变体都崩溃到 1.5-14 tok/s，因为当前的注意力路径重复重建完整的缓存，保留累积的 O(N^2) 解码工作。在 64K 下，当 33.5 GB 分配超过 MLX 的 22.6 GB Metal 缓冲区限制时，Metal 变体就会耗尽内存。直接在压缩 KV 上运行的融合缩放点积注意力以及分块预分配是长上下文可行性所必需的。这些结果将表示级压缩与内核和分配器效果分开，并确定低位 KV 缓存对统一内存硬件有帮助的条件。

papers.title: Cache Locally, Recompute Selectively for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.summary: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires video-LLMs to process incoming video continuously while answering user queries with low latency. Recent methods reduce query-time cost by prefilling frames into KV caches during idle time and reusing the cached KVs at query time. To bound per-frame computation over unbounded video streams, these methods restrict the context available during prefill. This creates a fundamental context mismatch: the restricted context may omit information needed to properly contextualize video tokens, yet, still contain information irrelevant to the eventual query, which is unknown during prefill. We propose FrameBlend, a simple yet effective plug-and-play method to address this mismatch through selective KV recomputation, without requiring any additional training. At query time, FrameBlend re-prefills selected video tokens using query-relevant context and replaces their cached KVs with recomputed ones. Crucially, this recomputation enables shorter attention windows during idle-time prefill, substantially reducing prefill cost while improving accuracy. Experiments across three SVU frameworks and five streaming and offline benchmarks demonstrate accuracy gains of up to 3.9 pp. On RVS-Ego, FrameBlend reduces per-frame prefill FLOPs by over 20% and total processing time by 14-59% for retrieval-based frameworks, including the cost of query-time recomputation. These results demonstrate that a simple change in how contextualization is distributed between idle time and query time can improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off for SVU.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用但创新幅度中等。
pros: 提出“本地缓存+选择性重算”以缓解预填充上下文错配，思路清晰且可插拔

papers.title_zh: 本地缓存，有选择地重新计算以实现流视频理解
papers.summary_zh: 流视频理解 (SVU) 要求视频法学硕士能够连续处理传入视频，同时以低延迟回答用户查询。最近的方法通过在空闲时将帧预填充到 KV 缓存中并在查询时重用缓存的 KV 来降低查询时间成本。为了限制无界视频流上的每帧计算，这些方法限制了预填充期间可用的上下文。这造成了基本的上下文不匹配：受限上下文可能会省略正确将视频令牌置于上下文中所需的信息，但仍然包含与最终查询无关的信息，这些信息在预填充期间是未知的。我们提出了 FrameBlend，这是一种简单而有效的即插即用方法，可以通过选择性 KV 重新计算来解决这种不匹配问题，而无需任何额外的训练。在查询时，FrameBlend 使用查询相关上下文重新预填充选定的视频标记，并用重新计算的 KV 替换其缓存的 KV。至关重要的是，这种重新计算可以缩短空闲时间预填充期间的注意力窗口，从而大大降低预填充成本，同时提高准确性。跨三个 SVU 框架和五个流媒体和离线基准测试的实验表明，准确度提升高达 3.9 个百分点。在 RVS-Ego 上，FrameBlend 将基于检索的框架的每帧预填充 FLOP 减少了 20% 以上，总处理时间减少了 14-59%，包括查询时间重新计算的成本。这些结果表明，对上下文化在空闲时间和查询时间之间的分配方式进行简单的更改可以改善 SVU 的准确性与效率权衡。

papers.title: Understanding Target Probability Reuse in Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding uses a target model to verify a tree of draft tokens in parallel. We study whether the resulting next-token distributions can help select the next tree. For unrestricted target models, we show that guaranteed exact reuse requires a distribution computed at the next round's complete context. We characterize when retaining this distribution requires sacrificing accepted tokens and establish conditions under which this loss persists across decoding rounds. Across six targets, we find that reranking first-token branches with a separately computed distribution at the current context improves expected acceptance over draft ranking, especially with small tree budgets. Drawing the first token from this distribution before allocating the tree further improves expected acceptance over pruning a preselected tree, even at equal mean tree size. In our experiments, both selection rules also decode faster than draft ranking when the separate target pass overlaps standalone drafting. Our findings show that making target probabilities available before tree allocation can improve the efficiency of speculative decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRows.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中实践，但贡献偏增量改进
pros: 聚焦 speculative decoding 中关键且常被忽视的目标概率复用问题

papers.title_zh: 了解推测解码中的目标概率重用
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码使用目标模型来并行验证草稿令牌树。我们研究由此产生的下一个令牌分布是否可以帮助选择下一棵树。对于不受限制的目标模型，我们表明保证精确重用需要在下一轮的完整上下文中计算分布。我们的特征是，保留这种分布需要牺牲已接受的令牌，并建立在解码轮次中这种损失持续存在的条件。在六个目标中，我们发现在当前上下文中使用单独计算的分布对第一个令牌分支进行重新排名可以提高草稿排名的预期接受度，尤其是在树预算较小的情况下。在分配树之前从该分布中提取第一个标记进一步提高了修剪预选树的预期接受度，即使在平均树大小相同的情况下也是如此。在我们的实验中，当单独的目标通道与独立起草重叠时，两种选择规则的解码速度也比草案排名更快。我们的研究结果表明，在树分配之前提供目标概率可以提高推测解码的效率。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRows 获取。

papers.title: Resuming Vision-Language Inference across Onboard Interruptions
papers.summary: Executing vision-language models (VLMs) aboard low-Earth orbit satellites enables flexible processing of observation data without first downlinking it to the ground. On commercial off-the-shelf payloads, however, a request may span multiple execution windows: power and thermal constraints, fault-triggered reboots, and competing payload demands can interrupt inference before it completes. Each shutdown discards volatile activations and KV caches, forcing an unprotected request to repeat work after restart. We present OrbitWeaver, a framework that preserves VLM inference progress across onboard interruptions through coordinated checkpointing and recovery. Its phase-aware checkpointing selects recovery boundaries according to the state lifetimes and computational characteristics of vision encoding, language-model prefill, and decoding, balancing storage traffic against recomputation. Its dependency-aware dynamic recovery schedules restoration from partially completed states across the layer and token-chunk dimensions. By overlapping checkpoint and weight reads with recomputation, it reduces restart latency; the recovery planner computes an optimal execution order under its scheduling model within 100 ms. Experiments on satellite payload hardware using on-orbit telemetry traces show up to a 4.07-fold end-to-end speedup and a 3.56-fold reduction in SSD write volume over the evaluated baselines. A 72-hour deployment on two low-Earth orbit satellites demonstrates that OrbitWeaver retains inference progress and resumes execution across repeated bus-enforced shutdowns.

papers.title_zh: 跨机载中断恢复视觉语言推理
papers.summary_zh: 在低地球轨道卫星上执行视觉语言模型 (VLM) 可以灵活处理观测数据，而无需先将其下行传输到地面。然而，在商业现成的有效负载上，请求可能跨越多个执行窗口：功率和热限制、故障触发的重新启动以及竞争有效负载需求可能会在推理完成之前中断推理。每次关闭都会丢弃易失性激活和 KV 缓存，迫使未受保护的请求在重新启动后重复工作。我们推出了 OrbitWeaver，这是一个框架，通过协调检查点和恢复，在机载中断时保持 VLM 推理进度。其阶段感知检查点根据视觉编码、语言模型预填充和解码的状态生命周期和计算特性来选择恢复边界，平衡存储流量和重新计算。其依赖项感知动态恢复计划从跨层和令牌块维度的部分完成状态进行恢复。通过将检查点和权重读取与重新计算重叠，可以减少重启延迟；恢复规划器在 100 毫秒内计算出其调度模型下的最佳执行顺序。使用在轨遥测轨迹对卫星有效负载硬件进行的实验显示，与评估的基线相比，端到端加速高达 4.07 倍，SSD 写入量减少 3.56 倍。在两颗低地球轨道卫星上的 72 小时部署表明，OrbitWeaver 保留了推理进度，并在多次总线强制关闭后恢复执行。

papers.title: Target Regeneration Shrinks the Gains of Draft-Training Objectives in Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models by verifying drafted tokens in parallel. New draft-training objectives are usually credited with the acceptance they add over cross-entropy on externally written responses, yet many pipelines let the target rewrite them. We ask how much of that gain survives. With a vision-language target and a block drafter, we train three objectives on four versions of one corpus: cross-entropy on corpus tokens, token-level distillation from the target, and distillation gated to positions that would survive verification. Distillation and the gate add large gains on external responses, but after greedy regeneration, distillation adds a smaller gain and the gate little or none. The shrinkage persists across data orders, position weights, verifiers, decoding temperatures and, for distillation, initializations and learning rates. Most of it remains at matched supervised length and at each objective's best measured training length. A second vision corpus shows the shrinkage, as does a text-only replication, for distillation also with an autoregressive drafter. Objective gains should therefore be measured against a target-regenerated baseline and across training lengths. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRegeneration.

quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，证据扎实但机理阐释仍不足。

papers.title_zh: 目标再生缩小了推测解码中草案训练目标的收益
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过并行验证起草的标记来加速大型语言模型。新的草稿训练目标通常被认为是因为它们在外部编写的响应上添加了交叉熵，但许多管道让目标重写它们。我们要问的是，这些收益中有多少能够幸存下来。通过视觉语言目标和块起草器，我们在一个语料库的四个版本上训练三个目标：语料库令牌的交叉熵、目标的令牌级蒸馏以及门控到能够通过验证的位置的蒸馏。蒸馏和门对外部响应增加了很大的增益，但在贪婪再生之后，蒸馏增加了较小的增益，而门增加了很少的增益或没有增益。这种收缩在数据顺序、位置权重、验证器、解码温度以及蒸馏、初始化和学习率方面持续存在。其中大部分保持匹配的监督长度和每个目标的最佳测量训练长度。第二个视觉语料库显示了收缩，就像纯文本复制一样，也使用自回归起草器进行蒸馏。因此，目标收益应根据目标重新生成的基线和整个训练长度来衡量。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRegenesis 获取。

papers.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
papers.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.

papers.title_zh: 代理的缓存工程
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理可以处理日益复杂的任务，引导观察和行动的长轨迹。随着这些轨迹的增长，键值 (KV) 缓存 I/O 和存储成为主要成本。轨迹也可能超过 LLM 的最大上下文长度，需要控制活动缓存增长。先前的工作使用上下文工程通过修剪或总结历史记录来减少缓存大小。然而，修改轨迹前缀会使后续缓存状态无效并触发保留上下文的昂贵的重新预填充。当保留的上下文太少以限制重新预填充成本时，任务准确性也会受到影响。我们提出缓存工程作为一种新方案。它允许代理直接控制其活动的 KV 缓存，而无需修改轨迹或重新预填充保留的上下文。具体来说，代理可以主动使用 drop 将选定的缓存从未来的关注中排除，并使用 repos 来调整保留键的位置编码。我们将这些缓存操作形式化，并将历史依赖性确定为服务挑战：相同的令牌序列可以在不同的缓存操作序列下产生不同的缓存状态，使得前缀匹配不足以正确重用缓存。因此，我们共同设计了 AKV 服务引擎。它提供与现有服务 API 兼容的无状态接口，同时在内部管理有状态缓存重用、驱逐和恢复。实验表明，与传统的阈值触发汇总相比，工具响应滚降缓存策略将平均基准分数提高了 1.7 分，平均成本降低了 27.7%。借助 AKV，它可实现高达 1.2 倍的输出吞吐量和 1.5 倍的 P95 请求延迟加速。缓存策略的递归自我完善，比专家设计进一步降低了7.1%的成本。我们的代码位于 https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV。

papers.title: Large Flow Language Models
papers.summary: Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.
