papers.title_zh: DLite：代理 AI 的无历史推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码已成为一种主流技术，通过使用轻量级草稿模型来生成随后由目标模型验证的候选标记，从而加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理。然而，代理工作负载引入了长期且不断发展的上下文和频繁的多轮交互。在这样的工作负载下，我们观察到现有的草稿模型的接受长度下降了高达 80%，同时维护其历史 KV 缓存会带来大量的系统开销。在本文中，我们将不断增长的历史背景确定为这两个问题的共同根源，并介绍了 DLite，这是一种用于代理 AI 的无历史推测解码框架。 DLite 直接重用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态并执行局部推测预测，而无需显式维护历史上下文，将日益复杂的建模问题转化为局部简单的预测问题。轻量级顺序头进一步以低开销恢复块内因果依赖性。为了有效地训练这种异构的无历史架构，我们引入了定制的两阶段训练策略。对通用、长上下文和代理工作负载的实验表明，DLite 实现了 2-6 的接受长度，并且优于最先进的推测解码方法 DSpark，高达 70%。

papers.title: Agentic AI for Heterogeneous System Design Across Chip, Scale-Up, and Scale-Out Domains
papers.summary: The design space of modern AI/HPC systems has expanded rapidly across compute architectures, including GPUs, dataflow processors, and RISC-V accelerators; memory tech- nologies, including HBM, GDDR, and SRAM; and interconnects such as NVLink, UALink, Infinity Fabric, InfiniBand, Slingshot, and Ultra Ethernet. No single architecture is optimal across LLM training, LLM serving, and AI-coupled HPC workloads, while the resulting combinatorial design space is too large for manual exploration. We present ArchAgent, a hierarchical multi- agent framework in which an LLM-based planner decomposes system design into chip, scale-up, and scale-out subproblems, each handled by specialist agents. A deterministic analytical evaluator closes the loop, ensuring that all performance estimates are derived from analytical models rather than generated by the LLM. On a mixed AI+HPC workload under a 1 MW power budget, ArchAgent discovers heterogeneous designs that achieve a 1.93x weighted geometric mean speedup over a homogeneous GPU baseline, while requiring only 18 evaluations compared with 100 evaluations for hill climbing, which achieves 1.65x speedup.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 问题重要且结果亮眼，但证据链仍偏薄。
pros: 聚焦跨芯片/scale-up/scale-out联合设计，选题具有现实价值
采用分层多智能体+解析评估闭环，兼顾自动化探索与可解释性
cons: 摘要仅给出单一场景与基线对比，泛化性和稳健性证据不足
18次评估优于hill climbing的结论可能受对手方法与调参公平性影响

papers.title_zh: 用于跨芯片、纵向扩展和横向扩展域的异构系统设计的代理 AI
papers.summary_zh: 现代 AI/HPC 系统的设计空间在计算架构中迅速扩展，包括 GPU、数据流处理器和 RISC-V 加速器；存储器技术，包括 HBM、GDDR 和 SRAM；以及 NVLink、UALink、Infinity Fabric、InfiniBand、Slingshot 和 Ultra 以太网等互连。没有哪个单一架构能够在 LLM 训练、LLM 服务和 AI 耦合 HPC 工作负载方面达到最佳效果，而由此产生的组合设计空间对于手动探索来说太大了。我们提出了 ArchAgent，一个分层多代理框架，其中基于 LLM 的规划器将系统设计分解为芯片、扩展和扩展子问题，每个子问题都由专业代理处理。确定性分析评估器闭合循环，确保所有绩效评估均来自分析模型，而不是由法学硕士生成。在 1 MW 功率预算下的混合 AI+HPC 工作负载上，ArchAgent 发现异构设计在同质 GPU 基线上实现了 1.93 倍加权几何平均加速，同时只需要 18 次评估，而爬山则需要 100 次评估，实现了 1.65 倍加速。

papers.title: Trajectory-Triggered Sparse Collaborative Decoding
papers.summary: Dense assistance methods such as speculative decoding repeatedly verify draft tokens with a target model, keeping target computation coupled to generation. We study sparse collaborative decoding, where a draft model generates most tokens and a target model is invoked only for short corrective segments. The key problem is deciding when to call the target. We show that local uncertainty is a weak trigger: entropy, negative log-likelihood, logit margin, top-$k$ mass, and velocity features give near-chance failure prediction, with AUC 0.50-0.53. In contrast, aggregate trajectory-shape features over the draft confidence path reach AUC 0.86 using a lightweight logistic predictor trained only from draft correctness labels. This induces a trigger-timing tradeoff: early calls have more leverage but weaker evidence, while later calls have stronger evidence but less ability to redirect the trajectory. Used online, learned sparse collaborative decoding improves over the best open-loop schedule by +5.3 to +20.0 accuracy points across five GSM8K draft-target pairs. On MATH-500, it gains 7.0-13.5 points when early prediction and target competence align, but loses when either is weak. On StrategyQA, it improves over open-loop by 5.0-8.3 points, showing transfer beyond arithmetics.
papers.comment: 17 pages. Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 uncertainty workshop

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，但泛化与稳健性证据仍不足。
pros: 提出稀疏协作解码触发机制，区别于常规逐步验证范式
用轨迹形状特征显著优于局部不确定性触发，并报告跨任务增益
cons: 主要在少数推理基准与模型配对验证，负例显示方法对早期预测质量和目标模型能力较敏感，稳定性与通用性风险较高

papers.title_zh: 轨迹触发的稀疏协作解码
papers.summary_zh: 诸如推测解码之类的密集辅助方法用目标模型重复验证草稿令牌，使目标计算与生成保持耦合。我们研究稀疏协作解码，其中草稿模型生成大部分标记，而目标模型仅针对较短的纠正片段被调用。关键问题是决定何时呼叫目标。我们表明，局部不确定性是一个弱触发因素：熵、负对数似然、logit 裕度、top-$k$ 质量和速度特征给出了近似概率故障预测，AUC 为 0.50-0.53。相比之下，使用仅根据草稿正确性标签训练的轻量级逻辑预测器，草稿置信路径上的聚合轨迹形状特征达到 AUC 0.86。这导致了触发时机的权衡：早期的调用具有更大的杠杆作用，但证据较弱，而较晚的调用具有更强的证据，但重定向轨迹的能力较差。在线使用时，学习的稀疏协作解码在五个 GSM8K 草案目标对上比最佳开环调度提高了 +5.3 到 +20.0 的准确度点。在 MATH-500 上，当早期预测和目标能力一致时，它会获得 7.0-13.5 分，但当其中任何一个较弱时，它都会下降。在 StrategyQA 上，它比开环提高了 5.0-8.3 个点，显示出超越算术的迁移。

papers.title: HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs
papers.summary: High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) has recently emerged as a promising technology that provides terabyte-scale accelerator-local capacity at bandwidths approaching HBM, with a potential cost-per-bit advantage over HBM. However, its NAND foundation brings long latency, out-of-place updates, and finite write endurance directly into the accelerator memory hierarchy, making its effects on performance and lifetime difficult to predict. To study this emerging design space, we present HBFSim, an LLM-aware event-driven simulator for heterogeneous HBM+HBF memory systems that preserves application-level memory semantics while modeling flash-internal behavior. HBFSim models HBM, HBF with host-managed flash translation, and conventional capacity tiers in one simulation driven by a calibrated serving frontend. Using HBFSim, we study decoding of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-235B-A22B under three workloads that differ in their input and output lengths. HBF serves data that does not fit in HBM 11.0--19.0$\times$ faster than host DRAM; HBM is better used to hold the running sequences' KV cache than as a cache for HBF; and at a published peak load of Llama-3.1-70B, HBF lasts 2.0 to 6.9 years, in proportion to the stacks that share the KV writes. The artifact is available at https://github.com/FlashLabAE/HBFSim and will track public HBF device data as it becomes available.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且工程价值高，但证据链仍偏有限。
pros: 聚焦HBM+HBF新型层次内存，问题前沿且与大模型部署强相关
提供LLM感知事件驱动模拟器并开源，给出性能与寿命的定量结论
cons: 结论主要基于模拟与校准前端，缺少真实HBF硬件实测与广泛交叉验证
工作负载与模型覆盖面仍有限，通用性和外推性存在不确定性

papers.title_zh: HBFSim：用于探索 LLM 内存层次结构中的 HBF 的模拟器
papers.summary_zh: 高带宽闪存 (HBF) 最近成为一种很有前景的技术，它可以在接近 HBM 的带宽下提供 TB 级加速器本地容量，并且与 HBM 相比具有潜在的每比特成本优势。然而，其 NAND 基础将长延迟、异地更新和有限的写入耐久性直接带入加速器内存层次结构，使其对性能和寿命的影响难以预测。为了研究这个新兴的设计空间，我们推出了 HBFSim，这是一种用于异构 HBM+HBF 内存系统的 LLM 感知事件驱动模拟器，它在对闪存内部行为进行建模的同时保留了应用程序级内存语义。 HBFSim 在由校准服务前端驱动的一次模拟中对 HBM、具有主机管理闪存转换的 HBF 和传统容量层进行建模。使用 HBFSim，我们研究了在输入和输出长度不同的三种工作负载下 Llama-3.1-70B 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B 的解码。 HBF 提供不适合 HBM 11.0--19.0$\times$ 的数据，速度比主机 DRAM 快； HBM 更适合用于保存运行序列的 KV 缓存，而不是作为 HBF 的缓存；在已发布的 Llama-3.1-70B 峰值负载下，HBF 可以持续 2.0 到 6.9 年，与共享 KV 写入的堆栈成比例。该工件可在 https://github.com/FlashLabAE/HBFSim 上获取，并将在可用时跟踪公共 HBF 设备数据。

papers.title: Prism Attention: Proposal-Refined Index Sharing Mechanism for Efficient LLMs Inference
papers.summary: Long-context decoding in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by the memory and computation required to attend over an ever-growing Key-Value (KV) cache at each autoregressive step. Although token-level sparse attention reduces this burden by restricting computation to a small subset of relevant past tokens, its practical gains are often offset by repeatedly recomputing layer-wise sparse indices as the context grows. A common remedy is to share sparse indices across layers by computing them only at designated anchor layers, but such static reuse ignores the layer-wise evolution of attention patterns, causing the reused indices to progressively deviate from the layer-specific optima and incur substantial attention loss. By revisiting cross-layer sparsity from the perspective of attention dynamics, we find that inter-layer salient token shift is highly localized: although the exact top-$κ$ indices differ across layers, the core high-attention tokens remain stable, with changes concentrated near the expanded boundary of previously selected regions. Motivated by this, we propose Prism Attention, a proposal-refined sparse attention framework. It replaces rigid cross-layer index reuse with a coarse-to-fine strategy, preserving layer-wise adaptability while retaining the efficiency benefits of cross-layer sharing. Extensive experiments show that Prism Attention achieves state-of-the-art performance among mainstream sparse attention methods on both reasoning and long-context benchmarks, while attaining a $3.4\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup over FlashAttention at 128K context length.
papers.comment: Published as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据链仍需更扎实。
pros: 抓住跨层稀疏索引复用失配这一关键痛点，提出proposal-refined机制较有新意
兼顾层间共享效率与层内自适应，若结果稳健则具备较强工程落地价值
cons: 摘要仅给出宏观SOTA与加速结论，缺少关键消融、统计显著性与硬件/实现公平性信息，严谨性存疑

papers.title_zh: Prism Attention：提案细化索引共享机制，实现LLM高效推理
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 中的长上下文解码越来越受到每个自回归步骤中不断增长的键值 (KV) 缓存所需的内存和计算的瓶颈。尽管令牌级稀疏注意力通过将计算限制为相关过去令牌的小子集来减轻这种负担，但随着上下文的增长，其实际收益通常会因重复重新计算分层稀疏索引而被抵消。一种常见的补救措施是通过仅在指定的锚层计算稀疏索引来跨层共享稀疏索引，但这种静态重用忽略了注意力模式的逐层演化，导致重用的索引逐渐偏离特定于层的最优值并导致大量的注意力损失。通过从注意力动态的角度重新审视跨层稀疏性，我们发现层间显着令牌转移是高度局部化的：尽管确切的 top-$κ$ 指数在各层之间有所不同，但核心高注意力令牌保持稳定，变化集中在先前选择区域的扩展边界附近。受此启发，我们提出了 Prism Attention，这是一种经过提案改进的稀疏注意力框架。它用从粗到细的策略取代了严格的跨层索引重用，保留了分层适应性，同时保留了跨层共享的效率优势。大量实验表明，Prism Attention 在推理和长上下文基准测试中均实现了主流稀疏注意力方法中最先进的性能，同时在 128K 上下文长度下比 FlashAttention 实现了 $3.4\times$ 的端到端解码加速。

papers.title: BS-Spec: BFP-Based Bit-Sharing for Self-Speculative LLM Decoding with LUT-Driven Mixed-Precision Acceleration
papers.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across diverse inference services, serving workloads span a wide range of batch sizes, context lengths, and performance requirements. Speculative decoding improves inference throughput, but conventional approaches require a separate draft model and KV cache, while existing self-speculative methods suffer from workload-insensitive draft configurations and inefficient mixed-precision execution. In this paper, we present BS-Spec, a block floating point (BFP)-based bit-sharing framework that jointly optimizes draft construction, workload-aware precision selection, and hardware execution. BS-Spec derives multiple draft representations directly from a single BFP target model by partially loading the most significant bits of weights and the KV cache while preserving shared exponents, eliminating separate draft-model storage. Offline calibration selects the weight and KV-cache precision pair that maximizes estimated speedup for each serving regime, and a precision lookup table applies the selected configuration at runtime. To support this adaptive execution, we design a mixed-precision BFP accelerator with a lookup table (LUT)-based variable-precision datapath for both draft and target computation. Experimental results show that BS-Spec achieves up to $1.9\times$ speedup over conventional autoregressive decoding and improves speedup over the evaluated bit-sharing self-speculative decoding baselines by $67.2\%$ on average, demonstrating the benefits of jointly co-designing bit sharing, precision adaptation, and specialized hardware for diverse LLM serving workloads.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 方向重要且方案完整，但证据力度仍偏有限。
pros: 提出BFP位共享自推测解码，减少独立draft模型与KV存储开销
结合离线校准与LUT运行时选择，并与专用混精硬件协同设计
cons: 摘要未交代统计显著性、开销分解与跨模型泛化，1.9×上限与67.2%均值增益的可复现性和普适性仍需更强实证支撑

papers.title_zh: BS-Spec：基于 BFP 的位共享，用于具有 LUT 驱动的混合精度加速的自推测 LLM 解码
papers.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地部署在不同的推理服务中，服务工作负载涵盖了各种批量大小、上下文长度和性能要求。推测性解码提高了推理吞吐量，但传统方法需要单独的草稿模型和 KV 缓存，而现有的自推测方法受到工作负载不敏感的草稿配置和低效的混合精度执行的影响。在本文中，我们提出了 BS-Spec，这是一种基于块浮点 (BFP) 的位共享框架，可联合优化草稿构造、工作负载感知精度选择和硬件执行。 BS-Spec 通过部分加载权重的最高有效位和 KV 缓存，同时保留共享指数，从而消除单独的草稿模型存储，直接从单个 BFP 目标模型导出多个草稿表示。离线校准选择权重和 KV 缓存精度对，以最大化每个服务方案的估计加速，并且精度查找表在运行时应用所选配置。为了支持这种自适应执行，我们设计了一个混合精度 BFP 加速器，具有基于查找表 (LUT) 的可变精度数据路径，用于草图和目标计算。实验结果表明，BS-Spec 比传统自回归解码实现了高达 $1.9\times$ 的加速，并且比评估的位共享自推测解码基线平均提高了 $67.2\%$ 的加速，展示了针对不同 LLM 服务工作负载联合共同设计位共享、精度自适应和专用硬件的好处。

papers.title: Shape-Aware Neural Time Fields for Rigid-Body Motion and Manipulation Planning
papers.summary: Rigid-body motion planning is fundamental to robotic transport and manipulation, where both object position and orientation determine whether a body can move through cluttered environments. This coupling makes planning chal- lenging because translation and rotation can be constrained very differently by surrounding geometry. We propose Shape- Aware Neural Time Fields, a physics-informed neural motion planning framework that learns a reusable travel-time, or cost- to-go, representation for rigid-body motion while explicitly accounting for these distinct geometric restrictions. The learned field captures local motion difficulty in translation and rotation and is paired with a sampling-based planner that balances progress toward the goal with the cost of reaching nearby poses. We evaluate the framework across 2D and 3D rigid- body planning tasks and non-prehensile manipulation through object pushing in diverse environments. Results show substantial improvements in planning success and inference efficiency over physics-informed neural planning baselines, while remaining competitive with classical sampling-based planners at significantly lower planning times. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of both the learned representation and the proposed planning strategy. Finally, closed-loop pushing experiments under execution deviations and external disturbances demonstrate that fast replanning enables reactive and adaptive task execution.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路有新意且实用，但证据链仍偏摘要化。
pros: 将形状感知与时间场结合，针对平移/旋转耦合约束建模较到位
兼顾成功率与推理效率，并在闭环扰动下展示了重规划实用性
cons: 摘要未充分交代理论保证、统计显著性与泛化边界，严谨性仍待正文验证
与强经典规划器的公平对比细节不足，速度优势可能受实现与硬件设置影响

papers.title_zh: 用于刚体运动和操纵规划的形状感知神经时间场
papers.summary_zh: 刚体运动规划是机器人运输和操纵的基础，其中物体的位置和方向决定了物体是否可以在杂乱的环境中移动。这种耦合使得规划具有挑战性，因为平移和旋转可能受到周围几何形状的非常不同的约束。我们提出了形状感知神经时间场，这是一种基于物理的神经运动规划框架，它学习可重复使用的行程时间或移动成本表示刚体运动，同时明确考虑这些不同的几何限制。学习场捕获平移和旋转中的局部运动难度，并与基于采样的规划器配对，平衡实现目标的进度与达到附近姿势的成本。我们评估了 2D 和 3D 刚体规划任务以及通过在不同环境中推动对象的非抓握操作的框架。结果表明，与基于物理的神经规划基线相比，规划成功率和推理效率有了显着提高，同时在规划时间显着缩短的情况下，仍与基于采样的经典规划器保持竞争力。消融研究进一步验证了学习到的表示和提出的规划策略的贡献。最后，执行偏差和外部干扰下的闭环推动实验表明，快速重新规划可以实现反应性和自适应任务执行。

papers.title: SAFETYEDIT: Sparse Internal Targets with Prompt-Wide Control for LLM Jailbreak Backdoors
papers.summary: Model-editing backdoors aim to induce harmful responses under a trigger while preserving ordinary behavior on untriggered input. Recent model-editing approaches target affirmative response prefixes through rank-one updates to a small subset of model weights. Yet when this prefix-level target is satisfied, the model may still revert to refusal or produce a coherent, apparently compliant response that does not address the request. To overcome this limitation, existing internal-representation approaches shift focus from output tokens to dense, high-dimensional compliance directions in latent space. Existing representation-level approaches rely on preservation constraints to maintain conditionality, motivating us to ask whether a smaller internal target can offer a different effectiveness-preservation trade-off. Motivated by the comparable control capability of single-coordinate interventions, we investigate a sparse refusal-related MLP coordinate as this target. We propose SAFETYEDIT, which optimizes a single refusal-related coordinate and uses KV-cache marking in early attention layers to propagate a prefix-trigger signal across subsequent instruction positions. On some checkpoints a downstream MLP reader converts this signal into control of the coordinate, while on others the propagated signal alone suffices; the method is defined by the sparse target rather than by a fixed writer-reader pair. Across four open-weight LLMs and three dataset groups, SAFETYEDIT achieves the highest triggered Guard ASR in 11 of 12 comparisons and the highest mean StrongREJECT score in all 12, relative to the baselines evaluated for each model. Crucially, comprehensive ablation and behavioral audits confirm generally minimal changes in untriggered behavior and general capabilities in the tested configurations.

quality.label: 较高

证据主要基于“部分检查点/测试配置”，跨模型机制一致性与泛化稳健性仍待加强

papers.title_zh: SAFETYEDIT：稀疏内部目标与 LLM 越狱后门的快速范围控制
papers.summary_zh: 模型编辑后门旨在在触发条件下引发有害反应，同时保留未触发输入的正常行为。最近的模型编辑方法通过对一小部分模型权重进行一级更新来针对肯定响应前缀。然而，当满足此前缀级目标时，模型仍可能会恢复拒绝或生成不解决请求的连贯的、明显合规的响应。为了克服这一限制，现有的内部表示方法将焦点从输出标记转移到潜在空间中的密集、高维顺从方向。现有的代表性水平方法依赖于保留约束来维持条件性，这促使我们询问较小的内部目标是否可以提供不同的有效性-保留权衡。受单坐标干预的可比控制能力的启发，我们研究了稀疏拒绝相关的 MLP 坐标作为该目标。我们提出 SAFETYEDIT，它优化单个与拒绝相关的坐标，并在早期注意层中使用 KV 缓存标记来在后续指令位置传播前缀触发信号。在某些检查点上，下游 MLP 读取器将此信号转换为坐标控制，而在其他检查点上，仅传播信号就足够了；该方法是由稀疏目标而不是固定的写入器-读取器对定义的。在四个开放权重法学硕士和三个数据集组中，相对于每个模型评估的基线，SAFETYEDIT 在 12 次比较中的 11 次中实现了最高的触发 Guard ASR，并在所有 12 次比较中实现了最高的平均 StrongREJECT 分数。至关重要的是，全面的消融和行为审核确认了测试配置中未触发行为和一般功能的变化通常很小。

papers.title: MemLLM: End-to-end In-Storage Acceleration of On-device Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Precomputed KV Caches
papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices enables personalized large language model (LLM) inference while preserving privacy. However, RAG's inherent length asymmetry makes the prefill phase the dominant bottleneck. While precomputing the KV caches offline alleviates the prefill cost on server systems, the multi-gigabyte caches over the narrow interconnect create a severe I/O wall for on-device systems. To mitigate this, we propose MemLLM, an end-to-end in-storage processing (ISP) architecture that executes the complete attention pipeline based on precomputed KV caches within the SSD. MemLLM utilizes per-channel accelerators to fully utilize the aggregated NAND channel bandwidth and accelerates all KV cache-related computations on the storage-side to minimize PCIe transfers. To efficiently handle the sparse updates required by RAG, MemLLM introduces a fused recomputation-query kernel paired with a hardware-based filter logic to halve the NAND read volume and eliminate write-back penalties. Furthermore, MemLLM's global SRAM-based stateful reduction engine enables a completely DRAM-less dataflow, thereby removing the internal memory bottlenecks and bounding the PCIe egress to an $O(1)$ footprint. A full-stack software stack allows asynchronous, zero-copy transfers from the ISP to the host and provides transparent execution within modern ML frameworks. Evaluated across eight real-world RAG datasets and six on-device LLM models, MemLLM achieves an average end-to-end speedup of 4.06$\times$ over the GPU baseline.
papers.comment: To be published in IEEE/ACM MICRO 2026

papers.title_zh: MemLLM：使用预计算 KV 缓存对设备上检索增强生成进行端到端存储加速
papers.summary_zh: 边缘设备上的检索增强生成 (RAG) 可实现个性化大语言模型 (LLM) 推理，同时保护隐私。然而，RAG 固有的长度不对称性使得预填充阶段成为主要瓶颈。虽然离线预计算 KV 缓存可以减轻服务器系统上的预填充成本，但窄互连上的数 GB 缓存为设备上的系统创建了严重的 I/O 墙。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了 MemLLM，这是一种端到端存储内处理 (ISP) 架构，它基于 SSD 内预先计算的 KV 缓存执行完整的注意力管道。 MemLLM 利用每通道加速器来充分利用聚合的 NAND 通道带宽，并加速存储端所有与 KV 缓存相关的计算，以最大限度地减少 PCIe 传输。为了有效处理 RAG 所需的稀疏更新，MemLLM 引入了融合的重新计算查询内核，与基于硬件的过滤器逻辑配对，以将 NAND 读取量减半并消除回写惩罚。此外，MemLLM 的基于 SRAM 的全局状态缩减引擎可实现完全无 DRAM 的数据流，从而消除内部内存瓶颈并将 PCIe 出口限制在 $O(1)$ 占用空间内。全栈软件堆栈允许从 ISP 到主机的异步、零拷贝传输，并在现代机器学习框架内提供透明的执行。通过对 8 个真实世界的 RAG 数据集和 6 个设备上的 LLM 模型进行评估，MemLLM 实现了比 GPU 基线 4.06$\times$ 的平均端到端加速。

papers.title: On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction
papers.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel text generation, but in practice face an unresolved speed-quality trade-off. Exact decoding fills in only one masked position per model pass, while faster multi-token decoding schemes are lossy. Speculative decoding is the standard lossless acceleration for autoregressive models. However, it does not transfer directly to DLMs, which must choose both what to generate and where. We show that this order is the missing piece: the model's own predictions from the previous pass already give the right token at over $90\%$ of positions, but not which position comes next. We introduce Speculating Positions Order Trajectory (SPOT), a 0.62M-parameter model that reads only the target's output distributions, predicts this order and proposes a tree of candidate continuations, which the target verifies in a single pass by state equality. Coupled-noise match, which shares Gumbel noise between drafter and target, keeps this verification exact at any temperature. This approach also inspired us to introduce SPOT-Sets for dynamic threshold decoding, where a pass commits several positions: SPOT-Sets drafts whole commit sets together with their tokens. Our comprehensive experiments show that SPOT cuts target passes by up to $6.8\times$ and reaches up to $3.4\times$ the throughput of standard decoding on SDAR-8B, matching or beating the calibrated and training-free drafting baselines in every task and budget at $T=0$ and $T=1$. In addition, we show that SPOT's learned drafter transfers across models, demonstrating successful transfer across six different DLMs; with a light calibration, the SPOT-Sets drafter transfers as well. On top of dynamic threshold decoding, SPOT-Sets improves the throughput of SDAR-8B by 59% on average over the threshold decoder alone. Project page: https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/
papers.comment: Preprint, 44 pages. Project page: https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/. v2: adds SPOT-Sets for dynamic threshold decoding; experiments re-run with new hardware

papers.title_zh: 现场：通过提交顺序预测增强扩散语言模型的推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 扩散语言模型 (DLM) 有望实现并行文本生成，但实际上面临着未解决的速度与质量权衡问题。精确解码每次模型传递仅填充一个掩码位置，而更快的多令牌解码方案是有损的。推测解码是自回归模型的标准无损加速。但是，它不会直接传输到 DLM，DLM 必须选择生成内容和生成位置。我们证明这个顺序是缺失的部分：模型自己对前一遍的预测已经在 92-100% 的位置给出了正确的标记，但没有给出下一个位置。基于这一观察，我们引入了推测头寸订单轨迹（SPOT），它可以学习预测该订单。 0.62M 参数模型仅读取目标的输出分布并提出候选延续树，目标通过检查每个分布是否等于其自己的下一个状态来一次性验证所有这些分布。在验证方面，我们的分析表明，先前的块扩散验证方法要么假设 $T=0$ 要么假设顺序提案接口。为了支持任何温度下基于树的推测，我们建议遵循共享 Gumbel 噪声耦合方法，对扩散块使用耦合噪声匹配验证。我们的综合实验表明，SPOT 将目标传递次数减少了 6.8 倍，标准解码的吞吐量提高了 3.2 倍，在 $T=0$ 和 $T=1$ 的每项任务和预算中都击败了经过校准和免训练的绘图基线。此外，我们还展示了学习的绘图员跨模型迁移，展示了跨六个不同 DLM 的成功迁移。项目页面：https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/

papers.title: PACE: Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs
papers.summary: Native multimodal large language models (native MLLMs) jointly encode visual and linguistic sequences within a unified autoregressive Transformer, emerging as a promising paradigm for multimodal understanding. Unlike conventional ViT-based MLLMs relying on external vision encoders, ViT-free native MLLMs tokenize pixel patches directly, potentially suffering severe visual token redundancy. A pilot study confirms this: unlike ViT-based models that degrade under compression, ViT-free MLLMs tolerate aggressive compression with near-lossless or even improved performance. Yet existing compression methods target ViT-based settings, leaving native MLLMs, which stand to gain the most, unexplored. To close this gap, we introduce an analysis pipeline centered on token discriminability and cross-dimensional heterogeneous redundancy, revealing that (i) redundancy is distributed independently and heterogeneously along height and width axes, and (ii) early-layer visual tokens are indiscriminable and uniformly redundant. Guided by these findings, we propose PACE (Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs), the first visual token compression framework tailored for native MLLMs with Multimodal-RoPE. Leveraging dimensional decoupling of positional encoding, PACE decomposes attention into two orthogonal spatial saliency estimates along height and width, gated by a positional attention signal, yielding direction-aware importance with negligible overhead. It further casts token budget allocation as Pareto optimization over performance preservation, inference efficiency, and spatial coverage, jointly identifying optimal compression depths and retention ratios. Experiments show PACE maintains near-lossless performance at only 25%-50% visual token retention, even improving several benchmarks, while delivering over 2x FLOPs reduction.

papers.title_zh: PACE：高效原生 MLLM 的帕累托自适应压缩
papers.summary_zh: 原生多模态大语言模型（原生 MLLM）在统一的自回归 Transformer 中联合编码视觉和语言序列，成为多模态理解的有前途的范例。与依赖外部视觉编码器的传统基于 ViT 的 MLLM 不同，无 ViT 的原生 MLLM 直接标记像素块，可能会遭受严重的视觉标记冗余。一项试点研究证实了这一点：与在压缩下性能下降的基于 ViT 的模型不同，无 ViT 的 MLLM 可以承受剧烈的压缩，并具有近乎无损甚至改进的性能。然而，现有的压缩方法以基于 ViT 的设置为目标，而未开发能够获得最大收益的原生 MLLM。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一种以令牌可区分性和跨维度异构冗余为中心的分析流程，揭示了（i）冗余沿着高度和宽度轴独立且异构地分布，以及（ii）早期层视觉令牌是不可区分的且一致冗余的。在这些发现的指导下，我们提出了 PACE（高效原生 MLLM 的帕累托自适应压缩），这是第一个为具有 Multimodal-RoPE 的原生 MLLM 量身定制的视觉令牌压缩框架。利用位置编码的维度解耦，PACE 将注意力分解为沿高度和宽度的两个正交空间显着性估计，由位置注意力信号门控，以可忽略的开销产生方向感知的重要性。它进一步将代币预算分配作为性能保留、推理效率和空间覆盖范围的帕累托优化，共同确定最佳压缩深度和保留率。实验表明，PACE 在视觉令牌保留率仅为 25%-50% 的情况下保持了近乎无损的性能，甚至改进了多个基准，同时实现了超过 2 倍的 FLOP 减少。

papers.title: Efficient KV Cache Migration for Geo-Distributed LLM Inference in Collaborative Edge Computing
papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown exceptional capabilities but rely heavily on centralized cloud GPU clusters, leading to high bandwidth costs, latency, and privacy issues. Edge computing offers a solution by deploying LLMs closer to users on edge servers, yet single edge servers often cannot meet LLMs' heavy computational demands. Collaborative Edge Computing (CEC) addresses this challenge by integrating resources of multiple geo-distributed heterogeneous edge servers, which jointly host small model shards and associated Key-Value (KV) cache for distributed inference. However, edge servers may disconnect or easily become overloaded, making it essential to migrate stateful KV cache to other servers for ensuring continuous service. Existing cloud-based KV cache management methods, such as direct cross-GPUs transmission and recomputation from input tokens are ill-suited for bandwidth-constrained and resource-limited edge environments. In this work, we propose EdgeFlow, a novel hybrid KV cache migration scheme that integrates direct KV cache transmission with activation-based recomputation, leveraging parallel computation and communication to minimize migration time. On this basis, we formulate a multi-node KV migration optimization problem and design a 2-approximation algorithm based on improved linear programming relaxation and bipartite graph techniques. Extensive experiments on a real-world distributed LLM inference platform demonstrate that EdgeFlow reduces migration time by up to 45%, significantly enhancing the robustness and efficiency of distributed LLM inference in collaborative edge computing.

papers.title_zh: 协作边缘计算中地理分布式 LLM 推理的高效 KV 缓存迁移
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 已展现出卓越的功能，但严重依赖集中式云 GPU 集群，从而导致高带宽成本、延迟和隐私问题。边缘计算提供了一种解决方案，即在边缘服务器上部署靠近用户的 LLM，但单个边缘服务器通常无法满足 LLM 繁重的计算需求。协作边缘计算 (CEC) 通过集成多个地理分布式异构边缘服务器的资源来解决这一挑战，这些服务器共同托管小型模型分片和关联的键值 (KV) 缓存以进行分布式推理。然而，边缘服务器可能会断开连接或容易过载，因此必须将有状态的 KV 缓存迁移到其他服务器以确保连续服务。现有的基于云的 KV 缓存管理方法，例如直接跨 GPU 传输和输入令牌重新计算，不适合带宽受限和资源有限的边缘环境。在这项工作中，我们提出了 EdgeFlow，一种新颖的混合 KV 缓存迁移方案，它将直接 KV 缓存传输与基于激活的重新计算相结合，利用并行计算和通信来最小化迁移时间。在此基础上，我们制定了多节点KV迁移优化问题，并设计了基于改进的线性规划松弛和二分图技术的2逼近算法。在现实世界的分布式 LLM 推理平台上进行的大量实验表明，EdgeFlow 将迁移时间缩短了高达 45%，显着增强了协作边缘计算中分布式 LLM 推理的稳健性和效率。

papers.title: DropKV: Decoupling Residual-Output Perturbation for Near-Optimal KV-Cache Eviction
papers.summary: Key-value (KV) cache management has become a critical bottleneck for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) to long-context scenarios due to linear memory growth. While recent eviction methods have moved beyond simple attention-score heuristics to incorporate value representations, they typically face a fundamental trade-off: the underlying optimization for minimizing output perturbation is an NP-hard combinatorial problem, leading to mathematically suboptimal heuristics or implementations that are difficult to kernelize. In this work, we propose DropKV, a simple principled eviction framework based on Decoupled Residual-Output Perturbation. By decoupling the joint eviction decision into independent per-token scoring, DropKV circumvents combinatorial intractability and admits a provable constant-factor approximation guarantee under a cone condition that we empirically verify on three long-context LLMs. To ensure practical viability, we provide a high-performance implementation using fused Triton kernels that avoid materializing the full attention matrix, delivering a 19.8x scoring-kernel speedup that translates to up to a 9.9% matched-batch end-to-end prefill speedup. Extensive evaluations on the RULER and LongBench benchmarks demonstrate that DropKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines at equivalent cache budgets, achieving the lowest inference latency among eviction methods while also remaining faster than the dynamic cache baseline.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 理论与系统结合扎实，属有竞争力工作

papers.title_zh: DropKV：解耦残余输出扰动以实现近乎最优的 KV 缓存驱逐
papers.summary_zh: 由于线性内存增长，键值 (KV) 缓存管理已成为将大型语言模型 (LLM) 扩展到长上下文场景的关键瓶颈。虽然最近的逐出方法已经超越了简单的注意力评分启发法，融入了价值表示，但它们通常面临着一个基本的权衡：最小化输出扰动的底层优化是一个 NP 难组合问题，导致数学上次优的启发法或难以核化的实现。在这项工作中，我们提出了 DropKV，一个基于解耦残余输出扰动的简单原则驱逐框架。通过将联合驱逐决策解耦为独立的每个令牌评分，DropKV 规避了组合的棘手性，并在我们在三个长上下文 LLM 上凭经验验证的圆锥条件下承认了可证明的常数因子近似保证。为了确保实际可行性，我们使用融合的 Triton 内核提供高性能实现，避免实现完整的注意力矩阵，从而提供 19.8 倍的评分内核加速，转化为高达 9.9% 的匹配批次端到端预填充加速。对 RULER 和 LongBench 基准的广泛评估表明，DropKV 在同等缓存预算下始终优于最先进的基准，在逐出方法中实现最低的推理延迟，同时保持比动态缓存基准更快的速度。

papers.title: Augment the Cache, Replace the Activation: A 2x2 Study of Internal-State Sharing
papers.summary: Multi-agent systems built from frozen language models communicate through text, which discards the internal state the sender already computed and makes the receiver pay to rebuild it. Work on internal channels avoids that cost, framing the problem as transfer: agent A sends information to agent B. Every agent pair that must communicate needs its own transfer bridge, and every agent added to a system needs a new bridge fitted against each previous agent. We reframe this problem as sharing: an agent publishes its internal state once into a pool, and every peer reads that pool through a single mechanism fitted to no sender in particular, so adding an agent adds a publisher and no new bridge. Whereas the carrier of the internal state and the fusion mechanism are usually chosen independently in the literature, our main finding is that these two choices are coupled; the deciding factor is where the carrier enters the receiver's computation. Consumability is a property of the receiving computation rather than of the representation. We find that the key-value (KV) cache must be augmented rather than swapped in: the receiver cross-attends over a peer's cache while keeping its own, and with only a small query-side adapter trained, matches the accuracy it gets from reading the source document. Activations invert this. They are best written straight into the receiver, with no bridge, no adapter and no training, which beats exposing them alongside the receiver's own, though that advantage rests on knowing where in the receiver the state belongs. The rule is augment the KV cache, replace the activation, established under one protocol with a shared control ladder. One adapter, trained once, also serves publishers it never trained on, and a pool of several at once, but only those whose internal state lies close to the receiver's own.

结论依赖状态与接收器“相近”前提，适用边界可能较窄

papers.title_zh: 增强缓存，替换激活：内部状态共享的 2x2 研究
papers.summary_zh: 由冻结语言模型构建的多代理系统通过文本进行通信，这会丢弃发送者已经计算出的内部状态，并让接收者付费重建它。内部通道上的工作避免了这种成本，将问题描述为传输：代理 A 向代理 B 发送信息。每个必须通信的代理对都需要自己的传输桥，并且添加到系统中的每个代理都需要一个针对每个先前代理的新桥。我们将这个问题重新定义为共享：代理将其内部状态发布到池中，每个对等点通过适合任何发送者的单一机制读取该池，因此添加代理会添加发布者，而不需要新的桥。尽管文献中内部状态的载体和融合机制通常是独立选择的，但我们的主要发现是这两种选择是耦合的；决定因素是载波进入接收器计算的位置。可消费性是接收计算的属性，而不是表示的属性。我们发现键值 (KV) 缓存必须增强而不是交换：接收方交叉参与对等方的缓存，同时保留自己的缓存，并且仅训练一个小型查询端适配器，就可以匹配从读取源文档中获得的准确性。激活会扭转这一点。它们最好直接写入接收器，没有桥接器，没有适配器，也没有训练，这比将它们与接收器自己的状态一起暴露要好，尽管这种优势取决于知道状态属于接收器中的哪个位置。规则是增加 KV 缓存，替换激活，在具有共享控制梯的协议下建立。一个适配器，经过一次训练，也可以为从未训练过的发布者提供服务，并且可以同时为多个发布者提供服务，但仅限于那些内部状态与接收者自己的状态接近的适配器。

papers.title: Close Enough is Nowhere Near: Fidelity-Consumability Decoupling in KV Caches
papers.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems communicate in text, which is lossy and wasteful: the sender throws away the reading it already did. A growing literature instead transmits the KV cache, the natural carrier of that reading. We study the most appealing form of the idea: both models stay frozen and the sender's cache is substituted for the reader's with nothing trained. It does not work, and the obstruction belongs to the reader. A frozen transformer reads only caches close to the one it would have written itself, a region we call its tolerable set. We show that geometric similarity to that cache does not predict whether the reader can use it, and the failure is not gradual, so a more faithful substitute is not the remedy it appears to be. We explain this phenomenon with competitive attention. Experimentally, we test eight diverse substitution methods against two measured anchors: an uninformative cache baseline and the reader's own accuracy from having read the passage. All sit at the baseline. That turns a long tail of separate negative results into one outcome with a stated condition for overturning it. A different design does work: if the reader keeps its own cache and attends over the sender's as extra context, adapting only its queries, it beats its own baseline, and also clears the baseline with eight senders pooled where undirected attention over the same union falls below it. We offer this as a characterization on one probe, not a leaderboard claim. Our central contribution is a redirection: pursuing faithful substitute caches is the wrong target; adding a cache to what the reader already has is the promising one.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且洞见新颖，但证据广度仍待加强。
pros: 将分散负结果统一为“可容忍集”框架，问题定义清晰有解释力
提出“替换无效、增补有效”的方向性转向，对系统设计有直接启发
cons: 结论主要基于单一探针与有限设定，跨任务、模型规模和真实系统负载下的外推性风险较高

papers.title_zh: 还远远不够：KV 缓存中的保真度-消耗性解耦
papers.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系统以文本方式进行通信，这是有损耗且浪费的：发送者会丢弃已经读取的内容。越来越多的文献转而传输 KV 缓存，它是读取的自然载体。我们研究了这个想法最吸引人的形式：两个模型都保持冻结状态，并且发送者的缓存取代了读者的缓存，而无需任何训练。它不起作用，阻碍属于读者。冻结的变压器只读取接近它自己写入的缓存，我们称之为它的可容忍集的区域。我们表明，与该缓存的几何相似性并不能预测读者是否可以使用它，而且失败也不是渐进的，因此更可靠的替代品并不是它看起来的补救措施。我们用竞争性关注来解释这一现象。在实验上，我们针对两个测量的锚点测试了八种不同的替换方法：无信息的缓存基线和读者自己阅读文章的准确性。所有人都坐在基线上。这就把一长串单独的负面结果变成了一个结果，并规定了推翻它的条件。一种不同的设计确实有效：如果读取器保留自己的缓存并作为额外的上下文关注发送者的缓存，仅调整其查询，它就会超越自己的基线，并且还清除八个发送者汇集的基线，其中对同一联合的无向关注低于它。我们将此作为对一个探针的表征，而不是排行榜声明。我们的核心贡献是重定向：追求忠实的替代缓存是错误的目标；在读者已有的内容上添加一个缓存是有希望的。

papers.title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models
papers.summary: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. However, generating each token still involves sequential computation and repeated access to model weights, leading to high decoding latency. Recent pipelined self-speculative decoding methods reduce this delay by drafting tokens from early-loop predictions and asynchronously advancing tokens at different recurrent depths in the same batch, but they do not fully exploit early-loop features for longer lookahead and still spend computation verifying incorrect speculative branches. We introduce \method, a speculative decoding framework for looped transformers that enables earlier drafting of future tokens and assigns complementary roles to different recurrent depths. A lightweight lookahead drafter (LAD) predicts multiple future tokens with early-loop states, and deeper-loop feedback helps decide which draft branches to continue and which to pause, while the full-depth model makes the final token decisions. LoopAhead achieves up to 7.82x decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路有新意且潜在影响大，但证据仍待全面验证。
pros: 针对 looped Transformer 的解码瓶颈提出分工明确的推测框架，问题抓得准
将早层多步前瞻与深层反馈结合，兼顾速度提升与分布保持目标
cons: 摘要未说明关键消融、稳定性与不同任务/模型规模上的泛化，7.82x 结论可能依赖特定设置
“保持目标分布”表述较强，但缺少理论保证或严格统计检验细节

papers.title_zh: LoopAhead：提前推测循环语言模型中的更快解码
papers.summary_zh: 循环 Transformer 通过重复应用相同的 Transformer 层来提高参数效率。然而，生成每个令牌仍然涉及顺序计算和对模型权重的重复访问，导致较高的解码延迟。最近的流水线自推测解码方法通过从早期循环预测中起草令牌并在同一批次中以不同的循环深度异步推进令牌来减少这种延迟，但它们没有充分利用早期循环功能来实现更长的前瞻，并且仍然花费计算来验证不正确的推测分支。我们引入了 \method，这是一种用于循环变压器的推测性解码框架，可以更早地起草未来的令牌，并将互补的角色分配给不同的循环深度。轻量级前瞻起草器 (LAD) 通过早期循环状态预测多个未来令牌，更深层次的循环反馈有助于决定哪些草稿分支继续以及哪些暂停，而全深度模型则做出最终令牌决策。 LoopAhead 的解码速度比自回归解码高出 7.82 倍，同时保留目标模型的输出分布。

papers.title: BiShield-TEE: On the (In-)Security of Unilateral Weight Obfuscation in On-Device TEE-Shielded LLM Partition
papers.summary: On-device deployment of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly adopted due to latency and privacy requirements, but exposes proprietary models to reverse engineering and intellectual property theft. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide hardware-enforced isolation for on-device inference, yet most TEE-based parameter obfuscation relies on unilateral matrix transformations that obfuscate only the output side. We identify a vulnerability in this design, termed the Solution Determinacy Property (SDP): the obfuscation secret is uniquely determined, exposing the structure of the true key and enabling attackers to break the protection. Under our attacks, representative methods GroupCover and ArrowCloak are reduced to negligible protection, with attack accuracy reaching over 2.4 times the full-shielding black-box baseline and recovering near-complete model functionality. To address this vulnerability, we propose BiShield-TEE, a bilateral framework that induces Ambiguous Solutions through joint obfuscation of input and output dimensions, hiding the true key among many equally valid candidates. Experiments across diverse models and datasets show that BiShield-TEE confines attack accuracy to the full-shielding black-box baseline, while achieving higher inference efficiency than prior methods on real hardware. Our code is available at https://github.com/laduiw/BiShield-TEE.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，方案有潜力但证据仍待加固。
pros: 提出SDP漏洞刻画，能系统解释单边混淆失效机制
双边混淆思路明确，并同时关注安全性与推理效率
cons: 仅凭摘要尚难判断攻击与防御的威胁模型完备性、统计显著性及对更广TEE/模型设置的泛化

papers.title_zh: BiShield-TEE：论设备上 TEE 屏蔽 LLM 分区中单边权重混淆的（内）安全性
papers.summary_zh: 由于延迟和隐私要求，大型语言模型 (LLM) 的设备上部署越来越多地被采用，但专有模型容易遭受逆向工程和知识产权盗窃。可信执行环境 (TEE) 为设备上推理提供硬件强制隔离，但大多数基于 TEE 的参数混淆依赖于仅混淆输出端的单边矩阵转换。我们在此设计中发现了一个漏洞，称为\emph{解决方案确定性属性（SDP）}：混淆秘密是唯一确定的，暴露了真实密钥的结构并使攻击者能够破坏保护。在我们的攻击下，代表性方法 \textsc{GroupCover} 和 \textsc{ArrowCloak} 的保护程度降低到可以忽略不计，攻击精度达到全屏蔽黑盒基线的 2.4 倍以上，并恢复接近完整的模型功能。为了解决此漏洞，我们提出了 \textsc{BiShield-TEE}，这是一个双边框架，它通过输入和输出维度的联合混淆来诱导 \emph{Ambigously Solutions}，将真正的密钥隐藏在许多相同的维度中。有效的候选人。跨不同模型和数据集的实验表明，\textsc{BiShield-TEE} 将攻击精度限制在全屏蔽黑盒基线，同时在真实硬件上实现比现有方法更高的推理效率。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/laduiw/BiShield-TEE 获取。

papers.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
papers.summary: Reusing the attention KV cache across requests is a standard way to cut prefill cost in long-context LLM serving, and production systems increasingly back the per-engine cache with a remote tier shared by every engine. We study such a tier in a disaggregated deployment of GLM-5.3, an FP8 mixture-of-experts model with multi-head latent attention (MLA), on 8xB300 nodes running prefill context parallelism (PCP8). Enabling the remote tier (LMCache with a Valkey store) left median time-to-first-token unchanged but raised the 16k-token p99 from 3.96 s to 17.3 s. Replaying a production request stream on an isolated engine, we find that a remote hit took 0.88 s against 0.31 s to recompute the prompt, and that synchronous loading turned a hit-heavy stream into an unstable queue: p99 83.32 s with the GPUs 7% busy. A two-term cost model explains both: a hit pays off only if the tier delivers more than B* = sR (2.53 GB/s for this model and GPU), and a fixed per-hit engine cost (T0 ~ 0.33 s) means that hits on prompts shorter than about 17k tokens cannot beat recompute at any bandwidth. Guided by the model, we (i) shard the MLA KV store across PCP ranks, with a proof that the existing minimum-over-ranks lookup returns the longest cached prefix and a load protocol that can never desynchronize collectives; (ii) partition the remote tier by rank, one server instance per rank with no coordination, which raises GET bandwidth 6.3x to 10.76 GB/s; (iii) add asynchronous loading to the sharded store; and (iv) fix three client bugs that caused unbounded stalls. On the hit-heavy stream, with 98.5% of prompt tokens served from the remote tier, p99 falls from 83.32 s to 0.67 s. The sharded store raises prefill throughput by 14%, and by 34% together with an upstream kernel fix. All changes are submitted upstream to LMCache.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题定义精准，工程与分析结合，实用价值高。
pros: 揭示远端KV命中反而劣于重算的反直觉瓶颈，并给出可解释的两项成本模型阈值
提出分片、分区与异步加载等成体系改进并在生产回放中显著降低长尾时延，收益量化充分
cons: 验证主要集中于单一模型与特定部署形态，跨模型与跨网络环境的可泛化性仍需更强证据

papers.title_zh: 当 KV 缓存比 GPU 慢时：扩展远程 KV 层以实现上下文并行预填充
papers.summary_zh: 跨请求重用注意力 KV 缓存是降低长上下文 LLM 服务中预填充成本的标准方法，并且生产系统越来越多地通过每个引擎共享的远程层来支持每个引擎的缓存。我们在运行预填充上下文并行性 (PCP8) 的 8xB300 节点上研究 GLM-5.3 的分解部署中的此类层，GLM-5.3 是一种具有多头潜在注意 (MLA) 的 FP8 专家混合模型。启用远程层（带有 Valkey 存储的 LMCache）使首次令牌的中值时间保持不变，但将 16k 令牌 p99 从 3.96 秒提高到 17.3 秒。在隔离引擎上重放生产请求流，我们发现远程命中需要 0.88 秒来重新计算提示，而同步加载则将命中率高的流变成了不稳定的队列：p99 83.32 秒，GPU 繁忙率为 7%。两期成本模型解释了这两个问题：只有当层提供超过 B* = sR（此模型和 GPU 为 2.53 GB/s）时，命中才会有回报，并且固定的每次命中引擎成本（T0 ~ 0.33 s）意味着短于大约 17k 令牌的提示命中无法在任何带宽下击败重新计算。在该模型的指导下，我们 (i) 将 MLA KV 存储跨 PCP 等级进行分片，并证明现有的最小超等级查找返回最长的缓存前缀和永远不会使集合体不同步的加载协议； (ii) 按等级划分远程层，每个等级一个服务器实例，无需协调，这将 GET 带宽提高 6.3 倍，达到 10.76 GB/s； (iii) 向分片存储添加异步加载； (iv) 修复三个导致无限停顿的客户端错误。在点击量大的流中，98.5% 的提示令牌是从远程层提供的，p99 从 83.32 秒下降到 0.67 秒。分片存储将预填充吞吐量提高了 14%，与上游内核修复一起提高了 34%。所有更改都会上游提交到 LMCache。

papers.title: FlashAttention with Statistics: Low-Overhead Attention Features for Compact Hallucination Detectors
papers.summary: Large language models can produce fluent answers that the supplied context does not support. A compact frozen proxy model can detect such answers by reading the context and another model's response, even from a proprietary generator. Attention-based detectors use summary statistics of the proxy's attention weights, but standard pipelines materialize the attention matrix, whose memory grows quadratically with sequence length. We compute these statistics without materializing attention, by accumulation in the FlashAttention pass, sparse lookups after it, or a second tiled pass over the scores, and classify them by this path into nearly free and costlier ones. On an H100, the statistics of five published detectors add 16% to the latency of a Qwen3-8B forward at 2K tokens, falling to 1.4% at 35K, and store 22.5 KiB per response token. On three benchmarks, probes trained on frozen Qwen3 proxies of 0.6B to 8B parameters prove strong detectors: a 4B proxy outperforms the strongest of nine zero-shot 4-9B LLM judges in F1 on two of the three, the proxies match or outperform specialized grounding checkers of up to 7B parameters, probing each proxy beats prompting it as a judge, and adding attention features significantly improves F1 in half of the 12 benchmark-proxy pairs, never significantly lowering it.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 方法实用且结果扎实，但外推性仍待验证。
pros: 将注意力统计无缝融入FlashAttention，工程开销低且可扩展到长序列
在多基准与多规模冻结代理上验证充分，较强零样本评审与专用检查器具竞争力
cons: 评测任务仍集中于特定幻觉检测场景，跨模型架构与跨域泛化证据不足
每响应token额外存储22.5KiB在高吞吐部署下可能带来显著内存压力

papers.title_zh: 带统计功能的 FlashAttention：紧凑型幻觉探测器的低开销注意力功能
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型可以产生所提供的上下文不支持的流畅答案。紧凑的冻结代理模型可以通过读取上下文和另一个模型的响应（甚至来自专有生成器）来检测此类答案。基于注意力的检测器使用代理注意力权重的汇总统计数据，但标准管道具体化了注意力矩阵，其内存随序列长度呈二次方增长。我们在不具体化注意力的情况下计算这些统计数据，通过 FlashAttention 传递中的累积、之后的稀疏查找或对分数进行第二次平铺传递，并通过此路径将它们分类为几乎免费和成本较高的两类。在 H100 上，五个已发布检测器的统计数据使 Qwen3-8B 转发在 2K 令牌时的延迟增加了 16%，在 35K 时降至 1.4%，并且每个响应令牌存储 22.5 KiB。在三个基准测试中，在 0.6B 至 8B 参数的冻结 Qwen3 代理上训练的探针证明了强大的检测器：4B 代理在三项中的两项上优于 F1 中九个零样本 4-9B LLM 法官中最强的，代理匹配或优于最多 7B 参数的专门接地检查器，探测每个代理节拍提示其作为法官，并且添加注意力特征显着提高了 12 个代理中一半的 F1基准-代理对，永远不会显着降低它。

papers.title: HyCo: Hybrid Drafting for Cost-Efficient Mobile-Cloud Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which runs the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head on the device to build a deep chain and uses one SLM pass to add alternative branches. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An ε-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three runs of each system on Spec-Bench show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-ε. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.
papers.comment: Under review at ACL Rolling Review (October 2026)

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实测有效，但证据广度不足。
pros: 提出混合草稿机制，结合MTP与SLM以降低端侧重复推理开销。
在真实手机与LTE/5G场景报告显著GPU节省与端到端加速，工程价值较高。
cons: 实验主要为单客户端与少量重复，统计稳健性、通用性及ε放松对质量边界的影响仍需更充分验证。

papers.title_zh: HyCo：用于经济高效的移动云推测解码的混合起草
papers.summary_zh: 设备云推测解码减少了服务器计算，但使用小型语言模型 (SLM) 生成深度草图树需要在移动神经处理单元 (NPU) 上重复传递。我们提出了 HyCo，它将深度分配给服务器模型的本机多令牌预测 (MTP) 头（在设备上执行），并将替代分支分配给一个 SLM 通道。服务器返回头部所需的隐藏状态、输入嵌入和键值条目，而不是执行其顺序步骤。量化、受限词汇和 1K 令牌窗口使两个起草者都适合 NPU。 ε 阈值规则还放宽了验证者采样分布的精确保留。在基于 LTE/5G 的 Galaxy S26 Ultra 的单客户端运行中，相对于服务器端 MTP 自推测，HyCo 在 Spec-Bench 上将每个输出令牌的服务器 GPU 时间减少了 38.6%，在 32K 令牌汇总上减少了 29.2%。在相同的验收规则下，每个系统运行 3 次 Spec-Bench 后显示，与仅使用 SLM 的绘图仪相比，节省了 9.0 个百分点，交付速度提高了 1.9 倍。 HyCo 与 Cloud+MTP 相差 +0.2 分（配对 95% CI：-0.9 至 +1.3）；探索性翻译有利于 SpecEdge-ε。在没有松弛的情况下，HyCo 精确在两个数据集上分别节省了 27.7% 和 11.9%。

papers.title: PriorityFEC: Deadline-Aware Streaming FEC for KV-Cache Handoff in Edge Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly deployed at the edge to support complex tasks that require collaboration and information exchange among multiple agents. However, when task contexts are passed across agents, shared context that has already been processed by upstream agents often needs to be prefilled again, resulting in substantial redundant computation. Reusing an already prefilled key--value (KV) cache can avoid this recomputation, but requires the reusable KV state to be transferred across the network before the receiving agent can begin generation. Under strict time-to-first-token (TTFT) deadlines and unreliable edge links, delivering the complete KV cache may be infeasible, making it necessary to prioritize and protect the most valuable KV information within a limited transmission budget. This paper proposes PriorityFEC, a utility-aware KV-cache handoff scheme that jointly exploits model-side KV importance and transport-side reliability. PriorityFEC first constructs a utility-aware source stream by placing high-utility KV blocks at earlier transmission positions. It then protects the ordered stream using a feedback-adaptive Streaming Forward Erasure Correction (FEC) mechanism, which schedules repair packets according to receiver feedback before the TTFT deadline. We implement PriorityFEC on a distributed edge LLM serving prototype and evaluate it with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct across multiple datasets. Results show that PriorityFEC achieves superior task quality over the compared transport schemes, with its advantages becoming particularly pronounced under stringent deadline constraints. These results demonstrate the importance of jointly optimizing KV-cache utility and deadline-aware transport reliability when reusable LLM state must be handed off across unreliable edge networks.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且方案实用，但创新与证据仍偏有限。
pros: 聚焦边缘多智能体KV交接的真实瓶颈，场景价值高
联合KV效用排序与截止期自适应FEC，工程可落地性较强

摘要未体现与最强基线的公平对比细节及统计显著性，严谨性存疑

papers.title_zh: PriorityFEC：边缘多代理系统中 KV 缓存切换的截止日期感知流式 FEC
papers.summary_zh: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统越来越多地部署在边缘，以支持需要多个智能体之间协作和信息交换的复杂任务。然而，当任务上下文跨代理传递时，已经被上游代理处理过的共享上下文通常需要再次预填充，从而导致大量的冗余计算。重用已经预填充的键值 (KV) 缓存可以避免这种重新计算，但需要在接收代理开始生成之前通过网络传输可重用的 KV 状态。在严格的首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 期限和不可靠的边缘链路下，提供完整的 KV 缓存可能不可行，因此有必要在有限的传输预算内优先考虑和保护最有价值的 KV 信息。本文提出了 PriorityFEC，这是一种实用程序感知的 KV 缓存切换方案，联合利用模型端 KV 重要性和传输端可靠性。 PriorityFEC 首先通过将高效用 KV 块放置在较早的传输位置来构建效用感知源流。然后，它使用反馈自适应流前向擦除校正 (FEC) 机制来保护有序流，该机制根据 TTFT 截止时间之前的接收器反馈来安排修复数据包。我们在分布式边缘 LLM 服务原型上实现 PriorityFEC，并使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 跨多个数据集对其进行评估。结果表明，与比较的传输方案相比，PriorityFEC 实现了更高的任务质量，其优势在严格的期限限制下变得尤为明显。这些结果证明了当可重用的 LLM 状态必须跨不可靠的边缘网络传递时，联合优化 KV 缓存实用程序和截止时间感知的传输可靠性的重要性。

papers.title: Compression Does Not End at Selection: Post-Selection Positional Geometry for Sparse KV Caches
papers.summary: Sparse KV compression reduces long-context inference costs by retaining selected historical states, yet these states typically keep their coordinates from the full history. Under Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), gaps left by evicted tokens continue to affect query-key matching, potentially limiting the use of retained evidence. We study post-selection positional geometry on a fixed selector-produced cache, examining how positional organization affects the use of retained information and which coordinate and continuation rules improve answer quality. To reorganize this geometry, we propose RoPERelay, which assigns compact, order-preserving RoPE coordinates, relocates cached key phases through inverse rotation and re-rotation, and synchronizes the current query and subsequent generation. It reuses existing K/V without renewed selection, historical re-prefill, or additional cache budget. Across 36 comparisons spanning two models, six sparse selectors, and three long-term memory tasks, RoPERelay improves answer quality in 32 cases. For Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with BM25 on LongMemEval-S, accuracy increases from 23.6% to 35.4%. Measured complete-request time overhead is approximately 1%-3% in the evaluated configurations. These findings establish positional organization as a distinct optimization dimension for sparse KV caches after content selection.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法巧妙但证据广度仍不足。
pros: 提出“后选择位置几何”新视角，区别于仅做稀疏选择的主流路线
方法工程可落地，声称无需重选或重prefill且时延开销较低

papers.title_zh: 压缩不会在选择时结束：稀疏 KV 缓存的选择后位置几何
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏 KV 压缩通过保留选定的历史状态来降低长上下文推理成本，但这些状态通常会保留完整历史记录中的坐标。在旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）下，被逐出的令牌留下的间隙继续影响查询键匹配，可能限制保留证据的使用。我们研究了固定选择器生成的缓存上的选择后位置几何，检查位置组织如何影响保留信息的使用以及哪些坐标和延续规则提高了答案质量。为了重新组织这个几何结构，我们提出了 RoPERelay，它分配紧凑的、保序的 RoPE 坐标，通过逆旋转和重新旋转重新定位缓存的关键阶段，并同步当前查询和后续生成。它重用现有的 K/V，无需重新选择、历史重新预填充或额外的缓存预算。在涵盖两个模型、六个稀疏选择器和三个长期记忆任务的 36 次比较中，RoPERelay 在 32 个案例中提高了答案质量。对于 LongMemEval-S 上具有 BM25 的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，准确度从 23.6% 提高到 35.4%。在评估的配置中，测得的完成请求时间开销约为 1%-3%。这些发现将位置组织确立为内容选择后稀疏 KV 缓存的独特优化维度。

papers.title: Long-Context Drafting Does Not Require Long-Context Drafters
papers.summary: Speculative decoding pairs a cheap drafter with parallel verification against the target. At ultra-long context it stops paying, because a drafter that attends over the full prefix inherits the target's context-dependent cost, so the speedup it was meant to provide first erodes and then reverses. The standard response is to build a long-context drafter, by training or fine-tuning one, or by using a multi-token-prediction head shipped inside the target checkpoint. We argue this is unnecessary, because the drafters in use are target-conditioned, reading hidden states the target computed over the entire prefix, so distant context already reaches them without their own attention, and verification corrects what they miss. We therefore freeze released short-context drafters and run them far past their training length under two inference-time mechanisms, one bounding the attention cache they see, which fixes their cost, and one re-basing their rotary position indices into the trained range. No weight is touched and the only tunable saturates early, so one vLLM-side configuration spans 4k to two million tokens, costing at most 0.16x of speedup at short length. We prove when a common index shift leaves the drafter's computation exactly unchanged, and decompose acceptance into two measurable gaps with sharp bounds. Whatever speedup a frozen drafter delivers at short context, it retains out to two million tokens, across three target-drafter pairs and five corpora. The claim concerns the flatness rather than the multiple, and removing either mechanism eliminates it. The gain is conditional on the speculative cost per emitted token staying below the matched target-only cost.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但外推与泛化仍待验证。
pros: 抓住长上下文投机解码失速根因，提出无需重训长上下文drafter的反直觉方案
方法工程可落地：冻结现有短上下文drafter，仅靠推理期机制与少量配置即可覆盖超长长度
同时给出理论分析（不变性与接受率分解界）和跨模型/语料实证，论证链条较完整

“速度保持平坦”是条件命题，对系统开销与代价模型较敏感，部署端稳定收益可能波动

papers.title_zh: 长上下文起草不需要长上下文起草者
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码将廉价的起草者与针对目标的并行验证配对。在超长上下文中，它停止付费，因为参与完整前缀的起草者继承了目标的上下文相关成本，因此它本应提供的加速首先会被侵蚀，然后又会逆转。标准响应是通过训练或微调一个长上下文起草器，或者使用目标检查点内附带的多令牌预测头来构建一个长上下文起草器。我们认为这是不必要的，因为使用的起草者是目标条件的，读取在整个前缀上计算的目标的隐藏状态，因此遥远的上下文已经在没有他们自己注意的情况下到达了他们，并且验证纠正了他们错过的内容。因此，我们冻结发布的短上下文绘图器，并在两种推理时间机制下运行它们，使其远远超过训练长度，一种限制它们看到的注意力缓存，这固定了它们的成本，另一种将它们的旋转位置索引重新设置为训练范围。没有触及权重，唯一的可调参数会提前饱和，因此一个 vLLM 端配置跨越 4k 到 200 万个令牌，在短长度下最多花费 0.16 倍的加速。我们证明了共同的索引变化何时使起草者的计算完全不变，并将接受度分解为两个具有尖锐界限的可测量差距。无论冻结的起草者在简短的上下文中提供多少加速，它都会在三个目标起草者对和五个语料库中保留多达 200 万个令牌。该声明涉及的是平坦度而不是倍数，并且删除任一机制都可以消除它。收益取决于每个发行代币的投机成本低于匹配的仅目标成本。

papers.title: On-Policy Residual Learning for Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Residual context is key to unlocking the speed-quality Pareto frontier of diffusion language models (DLMs) by carrying forward predictive distributions across denoising steps. Yet turning this seemingly simple mechanism into an effective learning paradigm is far from simple: there is no clear recipe for how residual context should be learned. We introduce ORL, a framework for on-policy residual learning in DLMs. Algorithmically, we identify that residual learning is inherently on-policy. ORL learns from model-induced residual trajectories on the fly and introduces an entropy-contraction objective that sharpens predictions as the model revisits its own predictions. System-wise, exact residual supervision requires capturing, retaining, and reprocessing many trajectory-dependent states. ORL co-designs the algorithm with asynchronous residual capture and transport, specialized block-diffusion attention, and packed compute-balanced training, making it practical at scale. On a 4B DLM converted from Qwen3-4B, ORL improves tokens per forward (TPF) by up to 6.2x and, with our dlmrt engine, end-to-end throughput by approximately 6.9x at comparable or better quality. In single-request serving on one H100, this mode achieves a stronger speed-quality Pareto frontier than autoregressive models with EAGLE3 and DFlash speculative decoding under both strict and relaxed verification, running 1.74x faster than DFlash at matched accuracy. ORL also transfers to existing DLMs: on LLaDA-2.1-mini, 36 H100-hours and 4.2M self-generated tokens, about 10x less data than prior LLaDA recipes, yield up to 1.5x higher TPF and up to 3x higher throughput at comparable quality, and on DiffusionGemma, ORL raises TPF by 1.1-1.2x. With dlmrt and NVFP4 quantization, ORL models decode a single request at up to 5,046 tokens/s on one B200, 7,708 on eight B200s, and 2,788 on a consumer RTX 5090, with comparable quality.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 方向重要且结果亮眼，但证据完整性待审。
pros: 提出将残差学习明确为on-policy并配套熵收缩目标，问题定义与方法契合度高

papers.title_zh: 扩散语言模型的在策略残差学习
papers.summary_zh: 残余上下文是通过在去噪步骤中推进预测分布来解锁扩散语言模型 (DLM) 的速度质量帕累托前沿的关键。然而，将这种看似简单的机制转变为有效的学习范式远非简单：对于如何学习剩余上下文，没有明确的方法。我们引入了 ORL，一种 DLM 中的在策略残差学习框架。从算法上来说，我们认为残差学习本质上是在策略的。 ORL 从模型引起的动态残差轨迹中学习，并引入熵收缩目标，当模型重新审视其自身的预测时，该目标可以使预测更加清晰。就系统而言，精确的残差监督需要捕获、保留和重新处理许多依赖于轨迹的状态。 ORL 共同设计了具有异步残差捕获和传输、专门的块扩散注意力以及打包计算平衡训练的算法，使其具有大规模实用性。在从 Qwen3-4B 转换的 4B DLM 上，ORL 将每次转发的令牌 (TPF) 提高了 6.2 倍，并且利用我们的 dlmrt 引擎，在同等或更好的质量下，端到端吞吐量提高了约 6.9 倍。在一台 H100 上的单请求服务中，该模式在严格和宽松验证下比使用 EAGLE3 和 DFlash 推测解码的自回归模型实现了更强的速度质量帕累托前沿，在匹配精度下运行速度比 DFlash 快 1.74 倍。 ORL 还可以转移到现有的 DLM：在 LLaDA-2.1-mini 上，36 H100 小时和 420 万个自生成代币，数据比以前的 LLaDA 配方少约 10 倍，在同等质量下，TPF 提高了 1.5 倍，吞吐量提高了 3 倍；在 DiffusionGemma 上，ORL 将 TPF 提高了 1.1-1.2 倍。借助 dlmrt 和 NVFP4 量化，ORL 模型在一台 B200 上以高达 5,046 个令牌/秒的速度解码单个请求，在八台 B200 上以高达 7,708 个令牌/秒的速度解码单个请求，在消费类 RTX 5090 上以高达 2,788 个令牌/秒的速度解码单个请求，且质量相当。

papers.title: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.

papers.title_zh: ReaDy：循环状态作为混合线性注意力大语言模型中推测性起草的动态上下文
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过每步起草多个标记来加速自回归生成，但基于特征的起草者依赖于目标隐藏特征，其上下文重点可能与后续草案位置的需求不一致。混合线性注意力（HLA）模型保持紧凑的循环状态，积累历史关联，为推测性起草提供有效的补充上下文来源。据我们所知，我们引入了 ReaDy，这是第一个推测性解码方法，在绘图过程中利用 HLA 循环状态进行位置特定的上下文检索。 ReaDy 为每个草稿位置配备了学习查询，以直接从目标的已提交循环状态中检索补充上下文。轻量级状态读取器通过残差更新将此上下文集成到草稿表示中，而低秩状态读取和融合运算符可保持较低的额外计算和 I/O 开销。 ReaDy 基于 DSpark 的并行主干和顺序预测头，采用轻量级两阶段适应策略，通过消融研究检查读取器容量、状态源和残差位置。在涵盖数学、代码生成和对话的七个基准测试中，ReaDy 与在单个 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上使用 Qwen3.8-27B 进行自回归解码相比，平均实现了 3.16 美元\次$的解码加速。它在每个基准测试中都优于 DSpark，吞吐量平均提高了 7.97%，接受长度平均提高了 8.50%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy 获取。

papers.title: RoLaQ: Joint Rotation and Range Calibration for 2-Bit KV Caches in Multi-Head Latent Attention
papers.summary: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) compresses the content of a key-value cache into a shared latent per token, making low-bit storage attractive for long-context inference. At two bits, errors in this representation perturb both attention matching and value readout, with effects that depend on error direction and reconstruction scale. We introduce RoLaQ (Rotation-calibrated Latent Quantization), an offline method for joint rotation and range calibration. RoLaQ refines a shared rotation within subspaces defined by the frozen key and value projections, and jointly learns quantization ranges whose thresholds and reconstruction gains are coupled to control the shared signal's response. Prediction matching and attention-output supervision guide calibration with model weights frozen. Across three MLA models and six benchmarks, RoLaQ achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared 2-bit methods both without and with token protection. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite, an SGLang implementation provides 3.96 times the BF16 KV capacity under the same memory budget and 2.51 times its decode throughput with 256K input tokens.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且结果亮眼，但方法增量偏工程化。
pros: 聚焦2-bit MLA KV缓存这一高价值长上下文推理瓶颈

cons: 创新更偏现有PTQ校准框架组合，理论与泛化证据在摘要层面仍不足

papers.title_zh: RoLaQ：多头潜在注意力中 2 位 KV 缓存的联合旋转和范围校准
papers.summary_zh: 多头潜在注意力（MLA）将键值缓存的内容压缩为每个令牌的共享潜在，使低位存储对长上下文推理有吸引力。在两位上，这种表示中的错误会扰乱注意力匹配和值读出，其影响取决于错误方向和重建规模。我们引入 RoLaQ（旋转校准潜在量化），这是一种用于联合旋转和范围校准的离线方法。 RoLaQ 细化由冻结键和值投影定义的子空间内的共享旋转，并联合学习量化范围，其阈值和重建增益耦合以控制共享信号的响应。预测匹配和注意力输出监督指导模型权重冻结的校准。在三个 MLA 模型和六个基准测试中，RoLaQ 在没有和有令牌保护的比较 2 位方法中实现了最高的平均准确度。在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上，SGLang 实现在相同的内存预算下提供了 BF16 KV 容量的 3.96 倍，并且在 256K 输入令牌的情况下提供了 2.51 倍的解码吞吐量。

papers.title: FOLD: Position-Free Far Memory with Local Order for Long-Context Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM generation through lightweight drafting and parallel verification. It is particularly promising for long inputs, where KV-cache access costs can be amortized over multiple accepted tokens. Yet most drafters are trained on short sequences and degrade on long inputs, while long-context training is costly. Existing training-free approaches restrict the context window, rescale positions, or augment recent context with retrieved distant entries. Drafters, however, read target hidden states that already encode contextual and positional information, and their lightweight architecture makes full-history attention affordable. We propose FOLD, a training-free method that preserves exact local positions and treats all distant entries as far memory at a shared position. To counter attention dilution as the memory grows, we sharpen attention within it to emphasize relevant entries while separately controlling its total weight relative to the local window. Across six target-drafter pairs and diverse benchmarks of up to 256K tokens, FOLD predominantly delivers the highest speedup, with the best case more than doubling the speedup over autoregressive decoding, from 2.08$\times$ to 4.22$\times$.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但严谨性证据仍待补强。
pros: 提出训练免费的位置处理机制，兼顾局部顺序与远程记忆，契合长上下文推理痛点
实验覆盖六组target-drafter与最高256K上下文，报告了有竞争力且可观的加速收益
cons: 摘要未充分说明开销分解、统计显著性与失败案例，速度提升的稳健性和泛化边界仍不清晰

papers.title_zh: FOLD：具有本地顺序的无位置远记忆，用于长上下文推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过轻量级起草和并行验证加速 LLM 生成。它对于长输入特别有前途，其中 KV 缓存访问成本可以分摊到多个接受的令牌上。然而，大多数绘图员接受的是短序列培训，并在长输入上退化，而长上下文培训成本高昂。现有的免训练方法限制上下文窗口、重新调整位置或使用检索到的远程条目来增强最近的上下文。然而，起草者读取已经编码上下文和位置信息的目标隐藏状态，并且它们的轻量级架构使得全历史关注变得负担得起。我们提出了 FOLD，这是一种无需训练的方法，可以保留精确的本地位置，并将所有遥远的条目视为共享位置的远记忆。为了应对记忆增长时注意力的稀释，我们加强其中的注意力以强调相关条目，同时单独控制其相对于本地窗口的总权重。在六个目标起草者对和多达 256K 代币的不同基准中，FOLD 主要提供最高的加速比，最好的情况是自回归解码的加速比增加一倍以上，从 2.08$\times$ 到 4.22$\times$。

papers.title: TreeSpark: Learning to Draft the Trees You Verify for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark reduce proposal latency, but early mismatches limit how much of each block can be accepted. Retaining alternatives introduces parent states and candidate choices that reference-conditioned training does not directly supervise. We introduce TreeSpark, a unified training and inference framework extending the semi-autoregressive DSpark architecture. It constructs parent-conditioned candidate trees from one backbone pass and replays their expansion, pruning, and budgeted packing during training. Survival negative log-likelihood weights retained edges by reference-derived path mass, while a capped coverage hinge promotes target-important alternatives near local selection boundaries. Both objectives reuse reference-chain target distributions without additional target forward passes. We evaluate greedy decoding with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on nine general benchmarks and six writing domains. Across targets and suites, TreeSpark improves mean acceptance length over DSpark by 23.4% to 31.6% and mean single-request throughput by 15.1% to 25.0%. Batched Qwen3-4B throughput improves by 12.6% to 17.2%. At fixed attention capacity and inference policy, the proposed supervision further improves mean acceptance length by approximately 6.4% and mean system throughput by 4.2% to 5.0% on Qwen3-4B.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且增益稳定，但实证边界仍需加强。
pros: 将树结构草稿训练与推理统一建模，针对保留分支监督缺口提出专门目标
在多模型与多基准上报告了较一致的接受长度与吞吐提升，具备系统实用价值
cons: 摘要未充分说明统计显著性、训练开销与消融细节，且评测主要集中在greedy设定，泛化到更广解码策略仍有风险

papers.title_zh: TreeSpark：学习起草您验证的推测解码树
papers.summary_zh: DFlash 和 DSpark 等并行起草器减少了提案延迟，但早期的不匹配限制了每个块可以接受的数量。保留替代方案引入了参考条件训练不直接监督的父状态和候选选择。我们引入了 TreeSpark，这是一个扩展半自回归 DSpark 架构的统一训练和推理框架。它从一个骨干通道构建父条件候选树，并在训练期间重播它们的扩展、修剪和预算打包。生存负对数似然通过参考导出的路径质量对保留的边缘进行权重，而有上限的覆盖铰链则促进局部选择边界附近的目标重要替代方案。两个目标都重用参考链目标分布，无需额外的目标前向传递。我们在九个通用基准和六个写入域上使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 评估贪婪解码。在目标和套件中，TreeSpark 的平均接受长度比 DSpark 提高了 23.4% 到 31.6%，平均单请求吞吐量提高了 15.1% 到 25.0%。批量 Qwen3-4B 吞吐量提高了 12.6% 至 17.2%。在固定注意力容量和推理​​策略下，所提出的监督进一步将 Qwen3-4B 上的平均接受长度提高了约 6.4%，将平均系统吞吐量提高了 4.2% 至 5.0%。

papers.title: MemDuet: Learning Dual-Process Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.summary: Reasoning over infinitely long documents is becoming a reality with recurrent memory agents. However, increasing context length exacerbates the trade-off between reasoning performance and inference efficiency. Inspired by Kahneman's account of fast and slow thinking, we propose MemDuet, a dual-process memory framework that learns to coordinate a small language model for fast, parallel evidence selection from raw context chunks (System 1) with a large language model for memory-update verification and memory updates in document order (System 2). We train MemDuet in three stages: supervised fine-tuning of System 1 for evidence selection, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) of System 2 for verification and memory rewriting, and joint optimization of both policies to coordinate selection and updating for long-context reasoning. Experiments on diverse long-context reasoning benchmarks (RULER-HQA, LongBench v2, and 2WikiMultiHopQA) demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off as context length grows. Averaged across evaluation settings on the three datasets, MemDuet achieves an end-to-end inference speedup of 9.74x and an output-token reduction of 73.91% relative to RL-MemAgent.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路有新意且实用，但证据充分性待加强。
pros: 将双过程认知映射到记忆代理，框架设计直观且有区分度
同时报告速度与token开销改进，契合serving效率核心诉求
cons: 摘要未给出关键消融与统计显著性，难判断各训练阶段真实贡献
主要对比集中于RL-MemAgent，跨方法与跨成本口径公平性仍存风险

papers.title_zh: MemDuet：学习双进程内存以进行长上下文推理
papers.summary_zh: 通过循环记忆代理，对无限长文档进行推理正在成为现实。然而，增加上下文长度会加剧推理性能和推理效率之间的权衡。受到 Kahneman 对快慢思维的启发，我们提出了 MemDuet，这是一个双进程内存框架，它学习协调一个小型语言模型，用于从原始上下文块中快速、并行选择证据（系统 1），与一个大型语言模型，用于内存更新验证和按文档顺序进行内存更新（系统 2）。我们分三个阶段训练 MemDuet：系统 1 的监督微调用于证据选择，系统 2 的组相对策略优化（GRPO）用于验证和内存重写，以及两个策略的联合优化以协调长上下文推理的选择和更新。对各种长上下文推理基准（RULER-HQA、LongBench v2 和 2WikiMultiHopQA）的实验表明，随着上下文长度的增长，可以实现有利的准确性与效率权衡。对三个数据集的评估设置进行平均，相对于 RL-MemAgent，MemDuet 的端到端推理速度提高了 9.74 倍，输出令牌减少了 73.91%。

papers.title: The Cost of Context: Profiling the Energy Footprint of Input Tokens in Large Language Models
papers.summary: The rapid adoption of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and long-context LLMs has shifted the computational burden toward the prefill phase---the initial stage where the model processes all input tokens in parallel before generating a response---yet its energy impact remains poorly characterised. We investigate the contradiction between massive hardware-level power spikes and the sub-linear marginal cost of input tokens reported in system-level studies. Through high-resolution telemetry of Llama-3.1 and Qwen-2 models on NVIDIA A100 hardware, we identify the efficiency threshold where $O(n^2)$ attention complexity overcomes GPU parallelisation. Our results quantify how optimised memory orchestration (PagedAttention) delays this scaling bottleneck across three orders of context scaling, yielding up to an 8.9$\times$ energy efficiency advantage at 112,000 tokens compared to standard baselines. Furthermore, we characterise the energy disparity between input and output tokens, demonstrating that optimised serving (vLLM) causes this ratio to narrow (from $\approx$850$\times$ to 750$\times$) as context scales due to high decode efficiency, whereas unoptimised baselines show a much smaller, roughly constant gap ($\approx$150--230$\times$) because their prefill is itself expensive. This work establishes context-scaling laws that differentiate engine-level optimisations from inherent model constraints, providing an empirical framework for sustainable LLM deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted at HotCarbon'26, the 5th Workshop on Sustainable Computer Systems; to appear in ACM SIGENERGY Energy Informatics Review, Vol. 6, Issue 2

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且数据扎实，但方法外推仍有限。
pros: 聚焦RAG与长上下文下预填充能耗，问题定义清晰且现实价值高
提供跨模型高分辨率遥测与引擎对比，量化阈值与效率收益有说服力

papers.title_zh: 上下文成本：分析大型语言模型中输入令牌的能量足迹
papers.summary_zh: 检索增强生成 (RAG) 和长上下文法学硕士的快速采用已将计算负担转移到预填充阶段（模型在生成响应之前并行处理所有输入标记的初始阶段），但其能源影响仍然没有得到很好的描述。我们研究了系统级研究中报告的大规模硬件级功率峰值与输入代币的次线性边际成本之间的矛盾。通过 NVIDIA A100 硬件上的 Llama-3.1 和 Qwen-2 模型的高分辨率遥测，我们确定了 $O(n^2)$ 注意力复杂度克服 GPU 并行化的效率阈值。我们的结果量化了优化的内存编排 (PagedAttention) 如何在上下文扩展的三个数量级上延迟此扩展瓶颈，与标准基线相比，在 112,000 个令牌时产生高达 8.9$\times$ 的能源效率优势。此外，我们描述了输入和输出令牌之间的能量差异，证明优化服务（vLLM）导致该比率随着上下文缩放而缩小（从 $\approx$850$\times$ 到 750$\times$），而未优化的基线显示出更小的、大致恒定的差距（$\approx$150--230$\times$），因为它们的预填充本身就很昂贵。这项工作建立了上下文扩展法则，将引擎级优化与固有模型约束区分开来，为可持续的法学硕士部署提供了一个经验框架。

papers.title: JetSpec++: Foresight Parallel Drafting with Self Refinements
papers.summary: Speculative decoding's effectiveness is governed by two quantities: the acceptance rate of drafted tokens and the cost of producing them. We show the two objectives can be co-optimized with algorithm-system co-design, and present JetSpec++, which retains a strong learned draft model while hiding its cost almost entirely. JetSpec++ combines three components: intra-block self refinement, which trains the draft model to iteratively correct its own parallel predictions within a block of tokens; inter-block foresight drafting, which begins the next block before the current one is verified; and pipelined drafting and verification, which overlaps the two stages so drafting's marginal wall-clock cost approaches zero. In comparison with state-of-the-art speculative decoding methods, JetSpec++ attains a wall-clock speedup of up to $7.45\times$ over autoregressive (AR) decoding and $1.54\times$ over DSpark, with up to 1,361 tokens per second for a single request on GB200, and an average acceptance length of 8.94 across seven benchmarks, while preserving the target model's output distribution. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Zhaoxiang Feng and Lanxiang Hu contributed equally. Code and models: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec

quality.label: 高质量

papers.title_zh: JetSpec++：具有自我完善的前瞻性并行绘图
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码的有效性由两个量决定：起草令牌的接受率和生产它们的成本。我们展示了这两个目标可以通过算法系统协同设计进行协同优化，并提出了 JetSpec++，它保留了强大的学习草稿模型，同时几乎完全隐藏了其成本。 JetSpec++ 结合了三个组件： 块内自我细化，训练草案模型以迭代地纠正其在令牌块内的并行预测；区块间预见起草，在当前区块验证之前开始下一个区块；流水线起草和验证，这两个阶段重叠，因此起草的边际挂钟成本接近于零。与最先进的推测解码方法相比，JetSpec++ 的挂钟加速比自回归 (AR) 解码高达 $7.45\times$，比 DSpark 高达 $1.54\times$，GB200 上的单个请求每秒高达 1,361 个令牌，七个基准测试的平均接受长度为 8.94，同时保留目标模型的输出分布。我们的代码和模型可在 https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/JetSpec 获取。
